rows.source: Welsh AMs worried about 'looking like muppets'
rows.output: Àwọn Aṣòfin Wẹ́lísì ń ṣàníyàn nípa “ìrísí bíi àwọn ọmúdá”
rows.reference: Àwọn ϙmϙ ẹgbé ile ìgbìmò Welsh n ṣaniyan nipa ‘wÍwò bii òmὺgò’

rows.source: There is consternation among some AMs at a suggestion their title should change to MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.output: Àwọn kan nínú àwọn Mósè (Member of the Scottish Parliament) ń ṣàníyàn nípa ìmúrasílẹ̀ pé orúkọ wọn yóò yí padà sí MWP (Mẹ́m̀bà ti Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Welsh).
rows.reference: Ibẹru-bojo wa laarin awọn ϙmϙ ẹgbé kan nitori àbá kan eyiti o fẹ ki won yi àpèjẹ wọn pada si MWPs (Ọmọ Ile Aṣoju-ṣofin ti Welsh)

rows.source: It has arisen because of plans to change the name of the assembly to the Welsh Parliament.
rows.output: Ó ti wáyé nítorí àwọn ètò láti yí orúkọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ náà padà sí Ìgbìmọ̀ Welsh.
rows.reference: Àbá yíì jeyọ sita nitori awọn àgbàkalẹ ètò láti yí orúkọ ìpéjọpọ náà padà sí Ile Aṣoju-ṣofin ti Welsh.

rows.source: AMs across the political spectrum are worried it could invite ridicule.
rows.output: Àwọn Aṣòfin ní gbogbo ìtànkálẹ̀ òṣèlú ń ṣàníyàn pé ó lè mú kí wọ́n rọ̀ mọ́ ọn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ϙmϙ ẹgbé kaakiri gbogbo ọwọja òșèlú nṣaniyan wipe leè pe ìtìjú wọlé.

rows.source: One Labour AM said his group was concerned "it rhymes with Twp and Pwp."
rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Labour sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ ní ìbàjẹ́ pé “ó ń ṣe àdàpọ̀ pẹ̀lú Twp àti Pwp.”
rows.reference: Ọkón lára awon ọmọ ẹgbẹ Labour sọpé Èyí ti o kan ẹgbẹ t’ohun nipe “ó fi ara pè Twp àti Pwp.”

rows.source: For readers outside of Wales: In Welsh twp means daft and pwp means poo.
rows.output: Fun awọn oluka ni ita Wales: Ni Welsh twp tumọ si irikuri ati pwp tumọ si idọti.
rows.reference: Fun awọn onkawe lẹyin odi Wales. Ní èdè Welsh twp tumọ sí omugọ tí pwp sì tumọ sí ìgbẹẹ eniyan.

rows.source: A Plaid AM said the group as a whole was "not happy" and has suggested alternatives.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ kan tí wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀ ní Plaid Cymru sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀kan gbogbogbòò “kì í ṣe inú rere” ó sì ti dámọ̀ràn àwọn àṣàyàn mìíràn.
rows.reference: ọmọ ẹgbẹ Plaid kan sọpe inú ẹgbẹ náà l’ápapò "kò dùn" tí ó sì dá àbá àwọn àfirọ́pò miran.

rows.source: A Welsh Conservative said his group was "open minded" about the name change, but noted it was a short verbal hop from MWP to Muppet.
rows.output: Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Welsh Konsafetifu kan sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ “ṣíṣe ọkàn” nípa ìyípadà orúkọ náà, ṣùgbọ́n ó ṣe àkíyèsí pé ó jẹ́ ìrín àjò ọ̀rọ̀ tí kò pọ̀ láti MWP sí Muppet.
rows.reference: Ọmọ ẹgbẹ Conservative ti Welsh kan sọpe ẹgbẹ òun “kò pa ọkàn rẹ rárá” nipa yiyipada orúkọ náà, ṣugbọn o ṣakiyesi wipe ó jẹ ọrọ ẹnu kúkúrú ti ó fò kúrò láti MVP sí Omugọ.

rows.source: In this context The Welsh letter w is pronounced similarly to the Yorkshire English pronunciation of the letter u.
rows.output: Nínú àyè yìí Lítterè Welsh w ni a ń sọ bí èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì Yorkshire ti ń sọ lẹ́tà u.
rows.reference: Nínú àsọyé èdé yìí pípèé lẹta w ninu èdè Welsh ni o farajọ ìpè lẹta u ti èdè Geesi ti àwọn Yorkshire.

rows.source: The Assembly Commission, which is currently drafting legislation to introduce the name changes, said: "The final decision on any descriptors of what Assembly Members are called will of course be a matter for the members themselves."
rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìgbìmọ̀ náà, tí ó ń kọ ìwé òfin lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe ìfihàn àwọn orúkọ ìyípadà náà, sọ pé: “Ìpinnu ikẹhin lórí àwọn ànímọ́ èyíkéyìí tí a ń pè ní àwọn Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ yóò jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ fún àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ náà fúnra wọn.”
rows.reference: Igbimọ Amuṣẹṣe Ipejọpọ náà, èyítí ó ńṣatopọ ofin lati mu awọn ayipada orukọ naa wọle, sọpe: “Ipinnu eyi ti yòó gbẹyin lori ìṣapejuwe ohun tí a pe àwon Ọmọ Ẹgbẹ Ipejọpọ Aṣoju-ṣofin náà ni yóò jẹ ọrọ fun awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ lati yanjú funrarawọn.”

rows.source: The Government of Wales Act 2017 gave the Welsh assembly the power to change its name.
rows.output: Ìjọbá Wales Act 2017 fún àwọn ìjọba Wales ní agbára láti yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà.
rows.reference: Òfin ọdún 2017 ti Ìjọba Wales fún Ipejọpọ Aṣoju-ṣofin ti Welsh ni ágbára láti yi orúkọ rẹ padà.

rows.source: In June, the Commission published the results of a public consultation on the proposals which found broad support for calling the assembly a Welsh Parliament.
rows.output: Ni Okudu, Ile-iṣẹ naa ṣe atẹjade awọn abajade ti itupalẹ ti gbogbogbò ti awọn iṣeduro ti o rii atilẹyin ti o gbooro fun pipe apejọ naa ni Igbimọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Nínú oṣù Òkúdu, Igbimọ Amuṣẹṣe náà ṣatẹjade awọn èsì ifọrọlọ lórí awọn àbá èyí ti ó rí atilẹyin tó gbòòrò fún pípe ipejọpọ náà ní Igbimọ Aṣoju-ṣofin ti Welsh.

rows.source: On the matter of the AMs' title, the Commission favoured Welsh Parliament Members or WMPs, but the MWP option received the most support in a public consultation.
rows.output: Nípa ọ̀rọ̀ orúkọ àwọn MAM, Ìgbìmọ̀ náà fẹ́ràn àwọn Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Ilẹ̀ Wales tàbí WMPs, ṣùgbọ́n aṣayan MWP gba ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ jùlọ nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò gbogbogbò.
rows.reference: Lórí ọrọ nipa àpèjẹ́ àwọn AM, Ìgbìmọ Amúṣẹ́ṣe fojú rere wo àwọn Ọmọ Ilé Ìgbímọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin ti Welsh àbí WMP, ṣùgbọ́n pipe ẹgbẹ na ní MWP gba àtìlẹ́yìn tí ó pọ́ jùlọ nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀lọ àwọn ará ìlú.

rows.source: AMs are apparently suggesting alternative options, but the struggle to reach consensus could be a headache for the Presiding Officer, Elin Jones, who is expected to submit draft legislation on the changes within weeks.
rows.output: Àwọn AMs ń ṣe àfihàn àwọn ọ̀nà mìíràn, ṣùgbọ́n ìforígbárí láti dé ìdánilójú lè jẹ́ ìrora fún Alága Alága, Elin Jones, ẹni tí a ń retí láti fi ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n
rows.reference: Ó fi hàn pe àwọn AM ńdá àbá̀ miran, ṣugbọn ìlàkàkà láti ìfẹnukò leè jẹ́ ẹ̀fọ́rí fún ádari ìgbìmọ́, Elin Jones, ẹnití wọn ńretí láti fún wọn ní àtòpọ̀ àbádòfin lórí à̀wọn ìyípadà náà láarin ọ̀sẹ̀ pérétè.

rows.source: The legislation on the reforms will include other changes to the way the assembly works, including rules on disqualification of AMs and the design of the committee system.
rows.output: Ìdájọ́ lórí àwọn ìyípadà náà yóò ní àwọn ìyípadà mìíràn sí bí ilé ìgbìmọ̀ náà ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́, títí kan àwọn òfin lórí ìyọkúrò àwọn AMs àti àpèjọ àwọn eto ìgbìmọ̀.
rows.reference: Òfin nípa àwọn àtúnṣe náà yóò ní àwọn ìyípadà miran nípa ọna ti ipejọpọ na ńgbà fi ṣiṣẹ, pẹlu àwọn ìlànà lórí sísọ awọn AM di àpẹẹrẹ ati agbekalẹ ọna ìmúṣẹṣe ti igbimọ naa.

rows.source: AMs will get the final vote on the question of what they should be called when they debate the legislation.
rows.output: Àwọn Aṣòfin yóò gba ìdìbò ikẹhin lórí ìbéèrè ohun tí wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ ń pè wọ́n nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń jiyàn lórí òfin náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn AM yóò gba ìbò tó gbẹyin  lóri ìbéèrè nípa ohun tí a níláti máa pè wọn nígbàtí wọn bá ńṣe àríyànjiyàn lórí òfin náà.

rows.source: Macedonians go to polls in referendum on changing country's name
rows.output: Àwọn ará Masedóníà ń lọ sí ìdìbò lórí yíyí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede Masidóníà yóò lọ di ìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹẹni-bẹẹkọ lóri yíyí orúkọ orilẹ-ede náà padà.

rows.source: Voters will vote Sunday on whether to change their country's name to the "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.output: Àwọn olùdíje yóò dibo ní ọjọ́ Sunday lórí bóyá láti yí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè wọn padà sí “Orílẹ̀-èdè Àrìwá Masedóníà.”
rows.reference: Àwọn olùdìbò yóò dìbò lọjọ Àìkú lórí bóyá kí wọn yí orúkọ orilẹ-ede náà padà sí “Ilẹ Olómìnira ti Àríwá Masidóníà.

rows.source: The popular vote was set up in a bid to resolve a decades-long dispute with neighboring Greece, which has its own province called Macedonia.
rows.output: Ìdìbò olókìkí ni a dá sílẹ̀ láti yanjú ìforígbárí tí ó ti pẹ́ ní ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún pẹ̀lú orílẹ̀-èdè alágbára tó wà nítòsí, Gíríìsì, èyí tó ní ìpínlẹ̀ kan tí wọ́n ń pè ní Masedóníà.
rows.reference: Ìbò èyítí ó gbajumọ yíì ni a ṣagbekalẹ rẹ nitori èrèdí láti yanjú èdè-àìyedè atọdunmọdun kan pẹlu aláàmúlégbè orilẹ-ede Gíríkì, eyiti ó ni ẹkùn ara rẹ kan tí a ńpè ní Masidóníà.

rows.source: Athens has long insisted that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has repeatedly objected to its membership bids for the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Àténì ti ń sọ pé orúkọ aládùúgbò rẹ̀ ní àríwísí pé ó jẹ́ ẹ̀tọ́ sí ilẹ̀ rẹ̀, ó sì ti ń kọ̀ láti dije fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún EU àti NATO.
rows.reference: Ìlú Atẹẹni ni ótí ́tẹnumọọ fún ìgbà pipẹ wípé orúkọ aláàmúlégbè ní ìhà àríwá òun dúró fun ṣíṣe bi olúwa lóri ilẹ òun tí ó sì ńṣe àtakò léra-léra sí àwọn ìgbìyànjú rẹ láti di ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àjọ EU àti NATO.

rows.source: Macedonian President Gjorge Ivanov, an opponent of the plebiscite on the name change, has said he will disregard the vote.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Masedóníà Gjorge Ivanov, ẹni tí kò fẹ́ ìdìbò náà lórí ìyípadà orúkọ náà, sọ pé òun yóò kọ ìdìbò náà.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ orilẹ-ede Masidóníà Gjorge Ivanov, alátakò kan sí ìbò lóri ìyípadà orúkọ náà, ti sọpé òun kì yóò ka ìbò náà sí.

rows.source: However, supporters of the referendum, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that the name change is simply the price to pay to join the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Síbẹ̀, àwọn olùfọkànsìn ìdìbò náà, títí kan Aláṣẹ Aláṣẹ Zoran Zaev, jiyan pé ìyípadà orúkọ náà jẹ́ iye owó kan láti san láti darapọ̀ mọ́ EU àti NATO.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, àwọn alatilẹyin ìbò onibẹẹni-bẹẹkọ náà, pẹlu Adarí Igbimọ naa Zoran Zaev, jiyàn wípé ìyípadà orúkọ jẹ ihun kékeré láti ṣe lati le darapọ mọ àjọ EU àti NATO.

rows.source: The Bells of St. Martin's Fall Silent as Churches in Harlem Struggle
rows.output: Àwọn Ìkùnsín St. Martin Dákẹ́ bí Ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì ní Harlem Ṣe Ìforígbárí
rows.reference: Àwọn Agogo St. Martin dákẹ́rọrọ bí awọn Ijò Harlem ̣ṣe n ̀làkàka.

rows.source: "Historically, the old people I've talked to say there was a bar and a church on every corner," Mr. Adams said.
rows.output: "Ìtàn, àwọn àgbàlagbà tí mo ti bá sọ pé, ibi ìgbọ̀nà àti ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì wà ní gbogbo igbà."
rows.reference: ''Nínu ìtàn, àwọn àgbà tí mo ti bá sọ̀rọ̀ sọwípé́ ilé ọtí àti ilé ìjọsìn ma nwà ní káàkiri gbogbo igun,'' Ògbẹ́ni Adam ni o so bèẹ́.

rows.source: "Today, there's neither."
rows.output: "Ọjọ́ náà, kò sí."
rows.reference: ''Lóòní, kòsí ọkàn nínú wọn mọ́.''

rows.source: He said the disappearance of bars was understandable.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé ìparun àwọn ìbàdí jẹ́ ìyàlẹ́nu.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé ìpòórá àwọn ilé ọtí̀ yéni.

rows.source: "People socialize in a different way" nowadays, he said.
rows.output: "Awọn eniyan n ṣe ajọṣepọ ni ọna ti o yatọ" loni, o sọ.
rows.reference: ó wípé ''Awọn eniyan lesee àṣepọ̀ ní oríṣiríṣi ọ̀nà'', lóde òní.

rows.source: "Bars are no longer neighborhood living rooms where people go on a regular basis."
rows.output: "Àwọn ilé ìdáná kò sí ibi ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ mọ́ níbití àwọn ènìyàn ti máa ń lọ ní gbogbo ọjọ́."
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ọtí kìí ṣe iyàrá ìgbàlejò tí àwọn èniyàn máa ńlọ lóòrè-kóòrè mọ́.

rows.source: As for churches, he worries that the money from selling assets will not last as long as leaders expect it to, "and sooner or later they'll be right back where they started."
rows.output: Nípa àwọn ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì, ó ń ṣàníyàn pé owó tí wọ́n ń rí láti tà àwọn ohun ìní náà kò ní pẹ́ bí àwọn aṣáájú ṣe ń retí, “ó sì máa ń pé kí wọ́n padà sí ibi tí wọ́n ti bẹ̀rẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Àmọò fún àwọn ilé ìjọsìn, ó ńṣàníyàn wípé owó tí yóò ti ara títa àwọn dúkìá jáde kòní pẹ́ lọ títí bí àwọn adarí ti ńretí́, ''àtipé bópe bóyạ́́ wọn yóò padà sí'bi tí wọ́n ti bẹ̀rẹ̀.

rows.source: Churches, he added, could be replaced by apartment buildings with condominiums filled with the kind of people who will not help the neighborhood's remaining sanctuaries.
rows.output: Ìjọsìn, ó fi kún un, lè rọ́pò rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi ṣe ilé ìgbọ́kùgbọ́ tí wọ́n fi �
rows.reference: ó tun fikún pè a lè rọpò àwọn ilé ìjọsìn pẹlu àwọn ile tí a pín sí ojúlé̀ tí ósì kún fọ́fọ́ pẹ̀lú irufẹ àwọn eniyan tí kòní ran àwọn ibi mimọ ìyókù tówà láàdúgbò lọwọ.

rows.source: "The overwhelming majority of people who buy condominiums in these buildings will be white," he said, "and therefore will hasten the day that these churches close altogether because it is unlikely that most of these people who move into these condominiums will become members of these churches."
rows.output: "Ìpìlẹ̀ púpọ̀ jùlọ àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń ra ilé ìgbọ́kùsì nínú àwọn ilé wọ̀nyí yóò jẹ́ àwọn funfun," ó sọ, "àtipé yóò sì mú kí ọjọ́ náà wá tí àwọn ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì wọ̀nyí bá parí patapátà nítorí pé kò ṣeé ṣe kí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń gbé sínú àwọn ilé ìgbọ́kùsì wọ̀nyí di ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì wọ̀nyí."
rows.reference: "Ọpọ ninu awọn eniyan ti o nra ojule ninu awọn ile onibugbe wọnyi yoo jẹ alawọ funfun," ni o wi, "atipe nitorinaa wọn yoo mu awọn ọjọ ti awọn sọọsi wọnyi yoo kogba wọle ya kiakia nitoripe koni ṣee ṣe wipe pupọ ninu awọn eniyan ti yoo ko sinu awọn ojule wọnyi di ọmo ijọ ninu awọn sọọsi wọnyi."

rows.source: Both churches were built by white congregations before Harlem became a black metropolis - Metropolitan Community in 1870, St. Martin's a decade later.
rows.output: Àwọn ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì méjèèjì ni àwọn ará Europe kọ́ ṣáájú Harlem tó di ìlú dúdú - Ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì Alágbára ní 1870, St. Martin's ní ọgọ́rùn-ún ọdún lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìjọsìn méjeejì yìí ni àwọn ìjọ alawọ funfun kọ kí Harlem tó di ìlú tó kún fọfọ fún àwọn eniyan dúdú - Àwùjọ Ọlọpọ Eniyan lọdun 1870, St. Martin, lẹyin ọdún mẹwaa.

rows.source: The original white Methodist congregation moved out in the 1930s.
rows.output: Ìjọ ìsìn ọ̀dọ́kùnrin aláwọ̀ funfun náà lọ ní àwọn ọdún 1930.
rows.reference: Ìjọ Elétò ti àwọn aláwọ̀ funfun tójẹ́ aláàkọ́kọ́ kó jáde làárín àwọn ọdún 1930.

rows.source: A black congregation that had been worshiping nearby took title to the building.
rows.output: Ìjọ ìsìn dúdú kan tó ti ń ṣe ìsìn níbìkan gba ilé náà.
rows.reference: Ìjọ àwọn eniyan aláwọ dúdú tí o ti ńjọsin nítòsí gba ìwé-ẹrí èmi-ni-mo-ni  fún ilé náà.

rows.source: St. Martin's was taken over by a black congregation under the Rev. John Howard Johnson, who led a boycott of retailers on 125th Street, a main street for shopping in Harlem, who resisted hiring or promoting blacks.
rows.output: Ìjọ St. Martin ni àwọn ará dúdú gba, tí Rev. John Howard Johnson darí, tí ó darí ìdènà ìtajà lórí Ọ̀nà 125, ọ̀nà pàtàkì fún ìtajà ní Harlem, tí ó kọ̀ láti gba tàbí gbàgbọ́ àwọn dúdú.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìjọ eniyan aláwo dúdú gbà ìsàkóso St. Martin ni ábẹ ìdárí Àlùfáà John Howard Johnson, ẹnití ó darí ìdẹyẹsí àwọn olùtajà ọja ẹlẹyọ ní Òpópónà 125, òpópónà pàtàkì kan fun ọjà rírà ní Harlem, tí wọn kọ lati gba àwọn eniyan dúdú si iṣẹ́ tàbí lati fún wọn ní ìgbéga.

rows.source: A fire in 1939 left the building badly damaged, but as Father Johnson's parishioners made plans to rebuild, they commissioned the carillon.
rows.output: Ina kan ni ọdun 1939 ba ile naa jẹbi pupọ, ṣugbọn bi awọn ọmọ ijọsin Baba Johnson ṣe n gbero lati tun kọ, wọn gbe ẹrọ orin naa kalẹ.
rows.reference: Ìjàm̀bá iná kan lọ́dún 1939 ba ilé na ̀jẹ́ gidigan, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọ ìjọ Baba Johnson ṣe àwọn ètò láti tún un kọ́, wọ́n sì ṣí àwọn aago nạ́.

rows.source: The Rev. David Johnson, Father Johnson's son and successor at St. Martin's, proudly called the carillon "the poor people's bells."
rows.output: Olùtẹ́wọ́gbà David Johnson, ọmọ Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Johnson àti aṣáájú rẹ̀ ní St. Martin's, ní ìgbádùn pe àwọn ìkùnsín náà jẹ́ “àwọn ìkùnsín àwọn aláwọ̀dúdú.”
rows.reference: Àlùfáà David Johnson, ọmọ Baba Johnson àti ẹni tí ó gba ìsàkósọ́ lọ́wọ́ baba rẹ̀ ní St. Martin, pe àwọn aago náà, pẹ̀lú ìyangàn, ní ''àwọn aago òtòsi eniyan”.

rows.source: The expert who played the carillon in July called it something else: "A cultural treasure" and "an irreplaceable historical instrument."
rows.output: Amoye ti o n ṣe kọrin kọrin ni oṣu Keje pe e ni: “Ẹbun aṣa” ati “ohun elo itan ti a ko le rọpo.”
rows.reference: Akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ kan tí ó lu aago náà nínú oṣù Ọ̀wàwà pè é ní nǹkan miran: ''Ìṣúra àṣà'' àti ''irin-isẹ́ ìbáláyé tí kò ṣeé pààrọ̀.''

rows.source: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.
rows.output: Amoye naa, Tiffany Ng ti Yunifasiti ti Michigan, tun ṣakiyesi pe o jẹ ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ akọkọ ni agbaye ti awọn onijakidijagan dudu ṣe, Dionisio A. Lind, ti o lọ si ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ nla ni Ile-ijọsin Riverside ọdun 18 sẹhin.
rows.reference: Akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣé kaǹ, Tiffany Ng ti ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ Yunifasiti ti Miṣigaani, bakanaa so wipé ó jẹ́ agogo àkọ́kọ́ ní àgbáyé tí akorin aláwò dudù, Dionisio A. Lind lu, ẹnití o kúrò̀ lọ̀ s'ọ́dọ̀ àwọn agogo ńlá ní ilé ìjọsìn ti Riverside ní odún méjìdínlógún sẹ́yìn.

rows.source: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Merriweather sọ pé St. Martin kò rọ́pò rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ọgbéni Merriweather sọ wípé St. Martin kò pààrọ rẹ̀.

rows.source: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.
rows.output: Ìyẹn tí ó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ ní St. Martin's ní àwọn oṣù díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn jẹ́ ìtàn tó nira tó ní àwọn olùkópa, àwọn kan tí àwọn aṣáájú ìjọ ti mú wọlé, àwọn mìíràn sì nípa ìjọ ìbílè.
rows.reference: Ohun tí o ti ṣẹlẹ́ ni St. Martin láàrin àwọn oṣù díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn ti jẹ́ ìtàn àwọn ayàwòrán ilé àti àwọn agbaṣẹ́ṣé eyiti ó lójú pọ kan, àwọn kan tí àwọn adari tí kìí ṣe akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ àlùfáà mú wọlé, àwọn miran nípaṣẹ̀ àwọn ile ijo tí àwọn Bíṣọọbu ńdarí.

rows.source: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.
rows.output: Ìjọ náà - ìjọ náà, tí àwọn aṣáájú tí kò jẹ́ aláwọ̀dá ní ìpìlẹ̀ rẹ̀ - kọ̀wé sí ìjọ náà ní July pẹ̀lú àwọn ìbànújẹ́ pé ìjọ náà “ yóò wá fi owó náà lé e lórí” sí ìjọ náà, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìjọ náà kò ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ìyàsímímọ́ àwọn olùkópa àti àwọn olùkópa tí ìjọ náà fi ránṣẹ́ sí.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ aláṣẹ naa - àwọn aláàmójútó ti ẹ̀ka ìjọ náà, tí àwọn adarí tí kìí ṣe akọ́ṣémọṣẹ́ àlùfáà ti jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ - kọ lẹ́tà nínú oṣù Ọ̀wàwà pẹ̀lú ìkáyàsókè wípé ẹkùn ìṣàkóso bisọọbu náà ''yóò wá ọ̀nà láti darí gbogbo ìnáwó náà'' s'ọdọ ìgbìmọ̀ aláṣẹ náà, àni botilẹjepe ìgbìmọ̀ aláṣẹ náà kò tíì kó ipa rí nínú gbígba àwọn ayaworan ilé àti àwọn agbaṣẹ́ṣe eyiti ẹkùn ìṣàkóso bisọọbu fi ranṣẹ sí iṣẹ́ kankan rí.

rows.source: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.
rows.output: Diẹ ninu awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ ti ṣe ẹdun nipa aini akoyawo nipa apaadi.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ìjọ kan fi ẹ̀sùn kàn àwọn ìṣàkóso bisọọbu náa nípa pe kòsí ìkó-àkóyawọ lórí ipa tiwon

rows.source: Shark injures 13-year-old on lobster dive in California
rows.output: Ẹja kan farapa ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàlá nígbè California
rows.reference: Ẹja ńlá ṣè ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàla kan léṣe nípaṣẹ̀ ìbẹ̵̵́lumi fún kíkó àwọn ako edé ní ìlú Kalifóníà

rows.source: A shark attacked and injured a 13-year-old boy Saturday while he was diving for lobster in California on the opening day of lobster season, officials said.
rows.output: Ẹja kan kọlu ati farapa ọmọkunrin ọmọ ọdun mẹtadinlogun ni Satidee nigba ti o n wẹwẹ fun ẹja nla ni California ni ọjọ akọkọ ti akoko ẹja nla, awọn alabojuto sọ.
rows.reference: Ẹja ńlá kan ṣe ìkọlu tí ó sì pa ọmọkùnrin ọdún mẹtala kan lára lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta nigbati ó n ́bẹ́lumi láti mú ako edé ní ìlú Kalifónía lọjọ tí wọ́n ńsíde ayẹyẹ kiko ako edé, gẹgẹ bíi àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ se sọ.

rows.source: The attack occurred just before 7 a.m. near Beacon's Beach in Encinitas.
rows.output: Ìkùnsín náà wáyé ní ìṣéjù díẹ̀ ṣáájú ọ̀sán ní àgbègbè Beacon's Beach ní Encinitas.
rows.reference: Ìkọlù náà wáyé kí aago méje òwúrọ̀ tó lù nítòsí Etíkun Beacon ní Encinitas.

rows.source: Chad Hammel told KSWB-TV in San Diego he had been diving with friends for about half an hour Saturday morning when he heard the boy screaming for help and then paddled over with a group to help pull him out of the water.
rows.output: Chad Hammel sọ fun KSWB-TV ni San Diego pé ó ti ń lúwẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ fún bíi ìdajì wákàtí ní ọjọ́ Àarọ̀ nígbà tí ó gbọ́ ọmúdájù ọmọ náà tí ń pariwo fún ìrànwọ́ tí ó sì lọ síbè pẹ̀lú ẹgbẹ́ kan láti ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti mú un jáde nínú omi.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel sọ fún KSWB-TV ní ìlú San Diego pé ọmọdé kὺnrin náà́ ti ńbẹ́lumi pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ fún bíi ϙgbòn ìṣẹjú ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta nígbàtí òun gbọ́ tí ọmọkùnrin náà ńpariwo fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ àtipé lẹ́yìn náà ni òun tukọ̀ s’órí omi pẹ̀lú àwọn ̣́miran láti fà á jade kúrô nínú omi náà.

rows.source: Hammel said at first he thought it was just excitement of catching a lobster, but then he "realized that he was yelling, 'I got bit!
rows.output: Hammel sọ pé ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rẹ̀ ó rò pé ó jẹ́ ìdùnnú láti mú ẹja ọ̀bọ, ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́yìn náà ó “mú ìmúrasílẹ̀ pé òun ń pariwo, ‘Mo ti gé mi!’
rows.reference: Hammel sowịpé ní àkọ́kọ́ òun rò wípé ìdùnnú rírí ako edé mú lásán ni, ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́yìn náà òun ''wá ṣàkìyèsìị́ ̀pé ó ńkígbe, 'nkań ti bù mí jẹ!

rows.source: I got bit!'
rows.output: Mo ti jẹ́ kí n jẹ́!
rows.reference: nkan ti bù mí jẹ!'

rows.source: His whole clavicle was ripped open," Hammel said he noticed once he got to the boy.
rows.output: Ìyàrá ẹ̀yà ọ̀tọ̀kùú rẹ̀ ti ya sí ọ̀nà mẹ́ta, ”Hammel sọ pé ó rí nígbà tó dé ọmọ náà.
rows.reference: Gbogbo egungun èjìká rẹ̀ ló hàn síta nítorí ẹran ara tó ti fàya,'' Hammel sọpé òun ṣàkíyèsí rẹ̀ ní kété tí òun gbà ọmọkùnrin náà mú.

rows.source: "I yelled at everyone to get out of the water: 'There's a shark in the water!'" Hammel added.
rows.output: "Mo pariwo fun gbogbo eniyan lati jade kuro ni omi: 'O wa ẹja nla kan ninu omi!'" Hammel fi kun.
rows.reference: ''Mo pariwo sí gbogbo eniyan láti jáde kúrò nínú omi náà: 'Ẹja ńlá sáàki wà nínú omi!'' Hammel fi kún un.

rows.source: The boy was airlifted to Rady Children's Hospital in San Diego where he is listed in critical condition.
rows.output: Ọmọkùnrin náà ni wọ́n gbé lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn ọmọde Rady ní San Diego níbi tí wọ́n ti ń kọ́kọ́ ní ipò tó le gan-an.
rows.reference: Ọmọkùnrin náà ni a fi ọkọ òfurufú gbé lọ sí Ilé-ìwòsàn Àwọn Ọmọdé ní ìlú San Diego níbití tí a ti ṣe àtòkọ rẹ̀ wípé ó wà ní ipò tó léwu.

rows.source: The species of shark responsible for the attack was unknown.
rows.output: Ìyàtọ̀ ẹ̀yà ẹja ọ̀bọ kan tí ó fa ìkùnsín náà kò mọ̀.
rows.reference: Irú ẹ̀yà ẹja ńlá tí ó ṣe ìkọluni náà ni a kò mọ̀.

rows.source: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles said at a media briefing that a shark had been spotted in the area a few weeks earlier, but it was determined not to be a dangerous species of shark.
rows.output: Olùgbèjà omi náà, Capt. Larry Giles sọ ní ìpàdé àwọn onkọ̀wé ìròyìn pé ẹja ọ̀bọ kan ti rí ní agbègbè náà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ diẹ sẹ́yìn, ṣùgbọ́n a ti pinnu pé kìí ṣe irú ẹja ọ̀bọ tí ó lè fa ìpalára.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gágun Lifeguard LarrycGiles sọ níbi ìfitónilétí kan pẹ̀lú àwọn oníròyìn wípé ẹja ńlá sáàkì náà ni wọ́n ti rí ní agbègbè náà ní àwọn ọ̀sẹ̀ díẹ̀ saájú ìṣẹ̀lẹ́ náà, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ti pinnu wípé kìí ṣe irufẹ́ ẹ̀yà sáàkì tó léwu.

rows.source: Giles added the victim sustained traumatic injuries to his upper torso area.
rows.output: Giles fi kun awọn ipalara ti o fa irora si agbegbe ara rẹ.
rows.reference: Giles fi kún un wípé ọmọdé̀ náà gba àwọn ìpalára síbi agbègbè apá òké àgọ́ ara rẹ̀.

rows.source: Officials shut down beach access from Ponto Beach in Casablad to Swami's in Ecinitas for 48 hours for investigation and safety purposes.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà ti pa ọ̀nà ìbàjẹ́ kúrò láti Ponto Beach ní Casablanca sí Swami's ní Encinitas fún wákàtí 48 fún ìwádìí àti ìdánilójú.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ti ibi àtiwọlé sí etíkun náà pa láti Etíkun Ponto ní Casablad sí Swami ní Ecinitas fún wákàtí méjìdínláàdọ́ta fún èrèdí ìwáàdí àti ààbó.

rows.source: Giles noted that there are more than 135 shark species in the area, but most are not considered dangerous.
rows.output: Giles ṣe akiyesi pe o ju 135 eya ẹja ni agbegbe naa, ṣugbọn pupọ ninu wọn ko ka pe o lewu.
rows.reference: Giles ṣàkíyèsí pé àwọn irúfẹ́ ẹ̀yà sáàkì tó máàrùndínlógójì ni o wà ní agbègbè náà, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ ninu wọn ni àwọn kò kà sí eyiti ó léwu.

rows.source: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market
rows.output: Sainsbury's n gbero lati wọ inu ọja ẹwa UK
rows.reference: Sainsbury's ńṣàgbékalẹ̀ ètò láti wọlé sínú ọjà àwọn nǹkan afúnnilẹ́wà ti orilẹ-ede UK

rows.source: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.
rows.output: Sainsbury's n ṣe idije pẹlu Boots, Superdrug ati Debenhams pẹlu awọn ile itaja ẹwa ti o ni awọn oluranlọwọ amoye.
rows.reference: Sainsbury's ńta kàǹgbọ̀n pẹ̀lú Boots, Superdrug àti Debenhams pẹ̀lú ilé ìtajà ẹlẹ́ka-eyiti ó ní àwọn ọ̀nà láàrin ibití a to ọjà afúnnilẹ́wà sí pẹ̀lú ìrànlọwọ lati àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́.

rows.source: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan nínú ìsapá ńlá kan sí ọjà ẹ̀wà UK £2.8bn, èyí tí ń tẹ̀síwájú láti dàgbà nígbà tí àwọn tita aṣọ àti ilé ìdáná ń dínkù, àwọn ọ̀nà ẹ̀wà ńlá yóò jẹ́ ìdánwò nínú àwọn ilé ìtajà 11 ní gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè náà, a ó sì mú wọ́n lọ sí àwọn ilé ìtajà míì ní ọdún tó ń bọ̀ tí ó bá jẹ́ aṣeyọrí.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí ara ti àtiwọlé sínú ọjà nǹkan afúnnilẹ́wà tí owó rẹ̀ tó biliọọnu pọ́ùn 2.8 ti orilẹ-ede UK, eyiti ó sì ńtẹ̀síwájù láti máa dàgbà nigbati ọjà asọ̀ ati ohun èlò ilé nfà sẹ́yìn, àwọn ibití a tò àwọn érójà afúnnilẹ́wà sí ni a ó dánwò ninu awọn ilé ìtajà mọ́kànlá kaakiri orilẹ-ede náà tí a ó sì gbé e lọsí́ àwọn ilé ìtajà díẹ̀ síi lọ́dun tó ḿbọ̀ bí ó bá fihàn pé o jẹ́ àṣeyọrí.

rows.source: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.
rows.output: Ìdoko-owó nínú ẹwà ń wáyé gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ilé ìtajà ṣe ń wá ọ̀nà láti lo ààyè àpótí tí wọ́n ti ń lò fún àwọn tààrà, àwọn ẹ̀rọ amóunjẹ, àti àwọn ohun èlò ilé.
rows.reference: Ìdókòòwò sínú érójà afúnnilẹ́wà náà ńwáyé bí àwọn ilé ìtajà ńlá ṣe ńdọdẹ fún àwọn ọ̀nà láti lo àwọn àayè tí wọn ńlò tẹ́lẹ̀ fún títo àwọn ẹ̀rọ amóhùnmáwòrán àti ohun èlò ilé sí.

rows.source: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.
rows.output: Sainsbury's sọ pé yóò mú ìwọ̀n ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ẹ̀wà rẹ̀ pọ̀ sí i sí ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́ta (3,000) ọjà, pẹ̀lú àwọn àmì bíi Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman àti Dr. PawPaw fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: Sainsbury's sọpé òun yóò máa sọ ìwọn ọrẹ érójà afúnnilẹ́wà di ìlọ́poméjì tí yóò sì pèsè ọjà to ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́ta, pẹ̀lú àwọn ọjà olórúkọ bíi Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman àti Dr. PawPaw fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́.

rows.source: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.
rows.output: Àwọn ìpìlẹ̀ tó wà láti L'Oréal, Maybelline, àti Burt's Bees yóò tún ní ààyè púpọ̀ síi pẹ̀lú àwọn àgbègbè tí wọ́n fi orúkọ wọn sílẹ̀ bíi àwọn tí wọ́n rí nínú àwọn ilé ìtajà bíi Boots.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọjà tótiwà tẹ́lẹ̀ láti ọwọ́ L'Oreal, Maybelline àti Burt's Bees yóò gba àayè díẹ̀ síi pẹ̀lú àwọn agbègbè tí o lórúkọ tó farajọ àwọn eyiti a ńrí ninu àwọn ilé ìtajà bíi Boots.

rows.source: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.
rows.output: Ìtajà náà tún ń tún ìlà ìṣelọpọ rẹ̀ ṣe, Boutique, kí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọjà lè jẹ́ aláìmọtótó - ohun tí àwọn oníbárà kékeré ń béèrè fún.
rows.reference: Ilé ìtajà náà tún ńṣe àtúnfilọ́lẹ̀ àwọn ọjà ìṣojúlóge rẹ̀ kí ọ̀pọ̀ ninu àwọn ọjà rẹ̀ leè jẹ eyiti àwọn tí kìí jẹ ẹran ńfẹ́ - nǹkan ti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó ńrajà ńbèèré fún jùlọ.

rows.source: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.
rows.output: Ni afikun, olutaja oorun ti Fragrance Shop yoo n ṣe idanwo awọn ẹdinwo ni awọn ile itaja Sainsbury's meji, ti akọkọ ti ṣii ni Croydon, guusu London, ni ọsẹ to kọja, lakoko ti keji ṣii ni Selly Oak, Birmingham, nigbamii ni ọdun yii.
rows.reference: Ni àfikún, ilé ìtajà-ẹlẹ́yọ ti nǹkan olóòórùn-dídun ti Fragrance Shop náà yóò máa dán àwọn ibití a yọ̀ǹda fún wọn wò ninu àwọn ilé ìtajà Sainsbury's méjì, àkọ́kọ́ tí a sí ní Croydon, ní gúúsù ìlú Lọndọn, lọsẹ tó kọjá nigbati ikeji yo di sísí ní Selly Oak, Birmingham, láàrin ọ́dún yìí.

rows.source: Online shopping and a shift towards buying small amounts of food daily at local convenience stores means supermarkets are having to do more to persuade people to visit.
rows.output: Ìtajà lórí ìkápá ayélujára àti ìyípadà sí rira àwọn ohun èlò oúnjẹ kékeré lójoojúmọ́ ní àwọn ilé ìtajà àdúgbọ̀ lè mú kí àwọn ilé ìtajà ṣe púpọ̀ síi láti mú àwọn ènìyàn lọ síbè.
rows.reference: Ọjà rírà lórí ìtàkùn ayélujára àti sísún sí rirá àwọn oúnjẹ díẹ̀ lojoojumọ ní àwọn ilé ìtajà ìrọ̀rùn tówà lágbègbè túmọ sípé àwọn ilé ìtajà ńlá ti ńní iṣẹ́ díẹ̀ síi láti ṣe lórí pípa àrọwà fún àwọn eniyan láti ṣàbẹ̀wo sí ọdọọ wọǹ.

rows.source: Mike Coupe, the chief executive of Sainsbury's, has said the outlets will look increasingly like department stores as the supermarket chain tries to fight back against the discounters Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food.
rows.output: Mike Coupe, olùdarí Sainsbury's, ti sọ pé àwọn ibi ìtajà náà yóò máa dàbí ilé ìtajà nígbèkùgbè bí ilé ìtajà náà ṣe ń gbìyànjú láti bá àwọn olùtajà ìdínkù Aldi àti Lidl jà pẹ̀lú àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó pọ̀ sí i àti àwọn ohun èlò tí kì í ṣe oúnjẹ.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, olùdarí àgbà ni Sainsbury's, ti sọpé ìrísí àwọn ibi ìtajà náà lọna tó ńpọ̀ síi yóò jọ ti àwọn ilé ìtajà ẹlẹ́ka bí ilé ìtajà ńlá alátagbà náà ti ngbiyanju láti kọjú ìjà̀ sí àwọn adínnilówó Aldi àti Lidl pẹ̀lú àwọn iṣẹ́ díẹ̀ síi àti ohun tí kìí ṣe oúnjẹ.

rows.source: Sainsbury's has been putting Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also introduced a number of Habitats since it bought both chains two years ago, which it says has bolstered grocery sales and made the acquisitions more profitable.
rows.output: Sainsbury's ti fi awọn ibi-itaja Argos sinu awọn ile itaja ọtun ọtun ati pe o tun ti ṣafikun nọmba awọn Habitats lati igba ti o ra awọn pq mejeeji ni ọdun meji sẹhin, eyiti o sọ pe o ti mu awọn tita ounjẹ pọ si ati jẹ ki awọn rira naa jẹ anfani.
rows.reference: Ilè ìtàjà Sainsbury ti ńfi àwọn ibi ìtajà Argos sínú àwọn ilé ìtajà bii ọgọ́ọ̀rún tí o sì ti ṣe ìfinimọlé fún iye Habitats lẹ́yìn tí o ra àwọn  alátagbà méjèèjì lọ́dún méjì sẹ́yìn, eyiti ó sọpé ó ti mú ki ọjà àwọn oúnjẹ̀ tà síi tí ó sì jẹ́kí àwọn alátagbà jẹ érè díẹ̀ síi.

rows.source: The supermarket's previous attempt to revamp its beauty and pharmacy departments ended in failure.
rows.output: Ìgbìmó ilé ìtajà náà láti tún ẹ̀ka ẹ̀wà àti ilé ìtajà oògùn ṣe kò ṣàṣeyọrí.
rows.reference: Ìgbìyànjú ti ilé ìtajà ńlà yíì ṣe sẹyìn láti ṣọ àwọn ẹ̀ka afúnnilẹ́wà ati ti òògùn títà rẹ̀ jí ̀kùnà.

rows.source: Sainsbury's tested a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the tie-up ended after a row over how to split the revenues from the chemist's stores in its supermarkets.
rows.output: Sainsbury's ṣe ìdánwò ìfọwọ́sowọpọ̀ pẹ̀lú Boots ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún 2000, ṣùgbọ́n ìfọwọ́sowọpọ̀ náà parí lẹ́yìn ìforígbárí lórí bí a ṣe lè pín owó-wiwọle láti àwọn ilé ìtajà oníṣègùn nínú àwọn ilé ìtajà rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ni ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ọdún 2000,ilé ìtaja Sainsbury dán oko-òwò alájọni wò pẹ̀lu Boots sùgbọ́n àsopọ náà pári lẹ́yìn aáwọ̀ kan lórí bí wọn yóò tí máa pín owó tó ńwọlé láti ibi ìtajà oogun tówà ninu àwọn ilé ìtajà ńlá rè̀.

rows.source: The new strategy comes after Sainsbury's sold its 281-store pharmacy business to Celesio, the owner of the Lloyds Pharmacy chain, for £125m, three years ago.
rows.output: Ìmúlò tuntun náà wá lẹ́yìn tí Sainsbury ta ilé ìtajà oògùn rẹ̀ 281 sí Celesio, olùní Lloyds Pharmacy, fún mílíọ̀nù 125, ní ọdún mẹ́ta sẹ́yìn.
rows.reference: ìgbeyẹwò tuntun náà ́wáyé lẹ́yìn ti Sainsbury's ta oko-òwò ílé-ìtajà òògùn ọrìnlénigba lé kan rẹ̀ fún Celesio, ẹnití ó ni ilé ìtajà alátagbà Lloyds Pharmacy, fún miliọnu máàrúndínlọ́gojè pọ́ùn, ni ọ́dún mẹ́ta sẹ́yìn.

rows.source: It said Lloyds would play a role in the plan, by adding an extended range of luxury skincare brands including La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé Lloyds yóò kópa nínú ètò náà nípa fífi àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀yà àwọn
rows.reference: Ó sọpé Lloyds yóò kó ipa nínú ètò náà, nípa ṣíṣe àfikún àwọn ọjà itọju awọ ara olorúkọ tógbòòrò bíi La Roch-Posay àti Vichy sínú ibi ìtajà mẹ́rin.

rows.source: Paul Mills-Hicks, Sainsbury's commercial director, said: "We've transformed the look and feel of our beauty aisles to enhance the environment for our customers.
rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, Olùdarí Ìṣòwò Sainsbury, sọ pé: “A ti yí ojú àti ìmọ̀lára àwọn ọ̀nà ẹ̀wà wa padà láti mú àyè tó dára jù fún àwọn oníbárà wa.
rows.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, olùdarí oko-òwò fún Sainsbury's, sọpé: ''A ti yí ìrísí àti ìmọ̀lára ti àwọn ojú ọ̀nà ibi ìtajà èròjà afúnnilẹwà wa padà láti jẹ́kí àyíká náà dára síi fún àwọn oníìbárà wa.

rows.source: We've also invested in specially trained colleagues who will be on hand to offer advice.
rows.output: A ti nawọ́ sì nínú àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ tí wọ́n ti kọ́ ní pàtó láti ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti pèsè ìmúrasílẹ̀.
rows.reference: A tún ti dókòòwò nínú kíkọ́ àwọn alábàṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ wa lẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àkànṣe àwọn tí yóò máa wà láàrọ́wọ́tó láti fúnni ni ímọ̀ràn.

rows.source: Our range of brands is designed to suit every need and the alluring environment and convenient locations mean we're now a compelling beauty destination which challenges the old way of shopping."
rows.output: Ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ wa ti àwọn àmì ìdánimọ̀ jẹ́ fún gbogbo àwọn aini, àti àyíká ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ àti àwọn ibi tí ó rọrùn láti dé túmọ̀ sí pé a ti di ibi ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ẹwà tí ó ń fa ìpèníjà sí ọ̀nà atijọ́ ti ìrajà."
rows.reference: Àwọn oríṣiríṣi ọjà olórúkọ wa ní a ṣàgbékalẹ̀ wọn láti bá gbogbo ìlò pàdé àtipé àyíká wa tó fanimọ́ra àti àwọn ibi tí ilé ìtajà wa wà ni ó rọrùn èyí sì túmọ sípé a ti di ibi kan tó pọn dandan eyiti àwọn eniyan yóò fẹ́ dé tí ó sì ńpe ọ̀nà ọjà rírà àtijọ́ níjà.

rows.source: Peter Jones 'furious' after Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal
rows.output: Ìbínú Peter Jones lẹ́yìn tí Holly Willoughby yọ kúrò nínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ £11 mílíọ̀nù
rows.reference: Peter Jones 'bínu fùfù' lẹ́yìn ti Holly Willoughby jáde kúrò nínú àdéhùn oní-mílíọ́nù mọ́kànlá pọ́uǹ

rows.source: Dragons Den star Peter Jones left 'furious' after TV presenter Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal with his lifestyle brand business to focus on her new contracts with Marks and Spencer and ITV
rows.output: Ìtàn náà fi hàn pé Peter Jones, olùkópa nínú eré tẹlifíṣọ̀n Dragons' Den, ti fi ìbínú hàn lẹ́yìn tí olùtààbò tẹlifíṣọ̀n Holly Willoughby ti yọ kúrò nínú ìpinnu £ 11 mílíọ̀nù kan pẹ̀lú ilé-iṣẹ́ ìṣòwò ìgbésí ayé rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ìràwọ̀ Dragons Den Peter Jones kúrò pẹ̀lú 'ìbínú fùfù' lẹ́yìn tí atọ́kùn ètò Holly Willoughby jáde kúrò nínú àdéhùn oní-mílíọ̀nù mọ́kànlà pọ́ùn pẹ̀lú oko-òwò olorúkọ rẹ̀ ti ìgbésí-ayé rẹ̀ láti leè gbájúmọ́ àwọn iṣẹ́ àgbàṣe tuntun rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Marks and Spencer àti ITV

rows.source: Willoughby has no time for their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: Willoughby kò ní àkókò fún aṣọ àti àwọn ohun èlò ilé wọn, Trulily.
rows.reference: Willoughby òní àyè fún ọjà olórúkọ aso iwọ nílé àti ̀ọja àsopọ̀Truly wọn mọ́.

rows.source: The pair's business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand.
rows.output: Ìbálòpọ̀ wọn jẹ́ àfihàn sí ìmúṣẹ́ Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop.
rows.reference: Oko-òwò àwọn méjèèjì ni wọ́n fiwe ti ìdókóòwò olórúkọ Goop ti Gwyneth Paltrow.

rows.source: This Morning presenter, 37, took to Instagram to announce she is leaving.
rows.output: Olùkópa Morning, 37, lọ sí Instagram láti sọ pé ó ń lọ.
rows.reference: Atọ́kùn Òwúrọ̀ yìí, ẹni oḍún mẹ́tàdínlógòjì lọsí Instagram láti kéde wípé ó ńkúrò.

rows.source: Holly Willoughby has left Dragons" Den star Peter Jones fuming by pulling out of their lucrative lifestyle brand business at the last minute - to focus on her own new bumper contracts with Marks & Spencer and ITV.
rows.output: Holly Willoughby ti lọ kuro ni Peter Jones ti Den "Ọgbẹni" nipa yiyọkuro ni iṣẹ akanṣe igbesi aye wọn ti o ni ere ni iṣẹju to kọja - lati dojukọ lori awọn adehun tuntun rẹ ti o pọ si pẹlu Marks & Spencer ati ITV.
rows.reference: Holly Willoughby ti kúrò ni Dragons'' eni ìràwọ̀ Den Peter Jones ńbínú fùfù nípa jíjáde kúrò nínú oko-òwò elérè olórúkọ ti ọ̀nà ìgbésí-ayé ní ìṣẹ́jú tó gbẹ̀yìn - láti leè gbájúmọ́ àwọn iṣẹ́ àgbàṣe ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ tuntun rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Marks and Spencer àti ITV.

rows.source: Sources say Jones was "furious" when TV's golden girl admitted during a tense meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of his business empire in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, that her new deals - worth up to £1.5 million - meant she no longer had enough time to devote to their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: Àwọn orísun sọ pé Jones “bínú” nígbà tí ó gbọ́ pé obìnrin tó gbajúmọ̀ lórí tẹlifíṣọ̀n sọ nígbèèrè kan ní ọjọ́ Tuesday ní ilé-iṣẹ́ ìjọba rẹ̀ ní Marlow, Buckinghamshire, pé àwọn ìpinnu tuntun rẹ̀ (tí ó lè jẹ́ £1.5 mílíọ̀nù) mú kí ó má ní àkókò tó pọ̀ tó láti fi fún àwọn aṣọ ilé àti àwọn ohun èlò wọn tí wọ́n ń pè ní Truly.
rows.reference: Àwọn orísun sọ wípé Jones ''bínù fùfù'' nigbati ọmọbìnrin wúrà amóhὺnmawòràn gbà nínú ìpàdé tó le koko kan lọ́jọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun ní olú ilé-iṣẹ́ oko-òwò rẹ̀ toti gbọ̀rẹ̀gẹ̀digẹ̀ ní Marlow, Buckinghamshire. wípé àwọn àdéhùn tuntun rẹ̀ - eyiti ó tó mílíọ̀nù kan àti ààbọ̀ pọ́ùn - túmọ̀ sípé òhun kòní àkókò púpò mọ́ láti fi fún asọ íwọ̀ nílé àti àwọn àsopọ̀ olórúkọ Truly wọn mọ́.

rows.source: The business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand and was tipped to double Willoughby's estimated £11 million fortune.
rows.output: Ìṣòwò náà ti wà ní ìfọkànsìn pẹ̀lú àmì Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop àti pé a ti sọ pé yóò mú ìṣúra Willoughby pọ̀ sí i ní ìdá mẹ́wàá.
rows.reference: Oko-òwò náà ni wọ́n ti fiwé olorúkọ Oko-òwò Goop ti Gwyneth Paltrow àtipé wọ́n ti sọpé àwọn dúkìá rẹ̀ yóò di ìlọ́po méjì ti Willoughby tí wọ́n ní ó tó mílíọ̀nù mọ́kànlá pọ́ùn.

rows.source: As Willoughby, 37, took to Instagram to announce she was leaving Truly, Jones jetted out of Britain to head for one of his holiday homes.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí Willoughby, ọmọ ọdún 37, ṣe fi ìfiránṣẹ́ ìkìlọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ìkìlọ̀ lórí Instagram pé ó ń kúrò ní Truly, Jones fò kúrò ní Britain láti lọ sí ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ilé ìgbafẹ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí Willoughby, 37̀, lọsí Instagram láti kéde wípé òun ńfi Truly sílẹ̀, Jones wọ ọkọ òfurufú jáde kúrò ní ilẹ gẹẹsì ti ósì forílẹ ọ̀kan lára àwọn ilé ìsinmi rẹ̀

rows.source: A source said: "Truly was by far the top of Holly's priorities.
rows.output: Ìwé kan sọ pé: “Ó jẹ́ ìyàtọ̀ gidi sí ìṣòro tó ga jùlọ nínú àwọn ohun tó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ fún Holly.
rows.reference: Orísun kan sọpé: Truly jẹ ọkan lára àwòn ohun ti óṣe Pàtàkì fún Holly.

rows.source: It was going to be her long-term future that would see her through the next couple of decades.
rows.output: Ó máa jẹ́ ọjọ́ iwájú rẹ̀ tó péye tó máa mú un lọ́wọ́ àwọn ọdún díẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Òhun níì ìbájẹ́ èrè ọjọ́ iwájú gígùn fún un eyiti yóò  mú un là ninú àwọn ọdún tónbo níwájú́.

rows.source: Her decision to pull out left everyone involved absolutely stunned.
rows.output: Ìpinnu rẹ̀ láti jáde kúrò níbè mú gbogbo àwọn tó wà nínú rẹ̀ láàmú.
rows.reference: Ìpinnu rẹ̀ láti jáde kúrò ya gbogbo àwọn  ólὺkópa ̀lẹ́nu pátápátá.

rows.source: Nobody could believe what was happening on Tuesday, it was so close to the launch.
rows.output: Kò sí ẹni tí ó gbàgbọ́ pé ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ Tuesday, ó sì jìnnà gan-an sí ìṣípá.
rows.reference: Kòsí ẹni t́i ó̀ gba ohun tó ́ṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́jọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun naa gbọ́, lẹyìn ti oti súnmọ́ ìfilọ́lẹ̀ taǹ.

rows.source: There is a warehouse full of goods at the Marlow HQ which are ready to be sold."
rows.output: Ọ̀wọ́ ilé ìtajà kan kún fún àwọn ọjà ní ilé-iṣẹ́ Marlow, tí wọ́n ti ṣetán láti ta.
rows.reference: Ilé ìkọ́jàsí kan wà tí o kún fun àwọn ọjà ni Marlow HQ tí wọn ti ṣetán fun títà.''

rows.source: Experts believe the departure of the This Morning presenter, who is among Britain's most bankable stars, could cost the firm millions due to hefty investment in products ranging from cushions and candles to clothing and homewear, and the potential for further delays to its launch.
rows.output: Àwọn amoyé gbàgbọ́ pé ìkùnsín olùbánisọ̀rọ̀ náà, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ìrìbọmi tó níye jùlọ ní Britain, lè jẹ́ ìdààmú ọgọ́rùn-ún mílíọ̀nù nítorí ìdoko-owó tó pọ̀ nínú àwọn ọjà tó yàtọ̀ síra, lára ​​àwọn ìbora àti àwọn ìbora, aṣọ, àti àwọn ohun èlò ilé, àti ìdádúró tí ó lè ṣe sí ìbèrè ìbèrè náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ gbàgbọ́ wipe kíkúrò atọ́kùn Òwúrọ̀ yìí, enití ó wà ninu àwọn ìràwọ̀ Briteeni tó ṣeé kówó lé lori, leè ná ilé-iṣẹ́ nàà ni àwọn mílíọ̀nụ̀ pọ́ùn nitori ìdókòwò tó wúwo ninu àwọn ọjà eyiti tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti àwọn tìmù-tìmu àti àwọn àbẹ́là sí asọ àti asọ íwọ́ nílé, èyíì le mú ìdádúró siwaju bá ìfilọ́lẹ̀ rẹ̀.

rows.source: And it could mean the end of a long friendship.
rows.output: Àti pé ó lè túmọ̀ sí òpin ọ̀rẹ́ tí ó ti pé.
rows.reference: Àtipé o leè túmọ̀ sí òpin fún ìbánidọ́ọ̀rẹ́ ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́.

rows.source: Mother-of-three Willoughby and husband Dan Baldwin have been close to Jones and his wife Tara Capp for ten years.
rows.output: Ìyàwó mẹ́ta Willoughby àti ọkùnrín rẹ̀ Dan Baldwin ti jẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ pẹ̀lú Jones àti ìyàwó rẹ̀ Tara Capp fún ọdún mẹ́wàá.
rows.reference: Ìyá-ọlómọ-mẹ́ta Willoughby àti ọkọ rẹ̀ Dan Baldwin ti jẹ́ ẹniti ó súnmọ́ Jones àti aya rẹ̀ Tara Capp gidigidi fún ọdún mẹ́wàá.

rows.source: Willoughby set up Truly with Capp in 2016 and Jones, 52, joined as chairman in March.
rows.output: Willoughby ṣeto Truly pẹlu Capp ni ọdun 2016 ati Jones, 52, darapọ mọ gẹgẹbi alaga ni Oṣu Kẹta.
rows.reference: Willoughby dá Truly sílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Capp lọ́dún 2016 tí Jones, ẹni ọdún méjìléláàádọ́ta, sì darapọ̀ bí alága nínú oṣù Erénà.

rows.source: The couples holiday together and Jones has a 40 per cent stake in Baldwin's TV production firm.
rows.output: Àwọn tọkọtaya náà lọ sí ìsinmi papọ̀ àti pé Jones ní ìdá mẹ́rìnlá nínú ìdá mẹ́rìnlá nínú ilé iṣẹ́ ìṣelọ́pọ̀ tẹlifíṣọ̀n Baldwin.
rows.reference: Ìsinmi àwọn tọkọtaya náà lápapọ̀ àti Jones ní ìpín ìdóòkòwò ìdá ogójì ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti ilé iṣẹ́ aṣàgbéjáde amóhὺmáwòràán ti Baldwin.

rows.source: Willoughby is to become a brand ambassador for M&S and will replace Ant McPartlin as host of ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.output: Willoughby yóò di olùrànlọ́wọ́là fún M&K yóò sì rọ́pò Ant McPartlin gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùbàárà ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.reference: Willioughby tifẹ di aṣojú olorúkọ kan fún M&S tí yóò sì rọ́pò Ant McPartlin gẹgẹ bíi olùgbàlejò lórí ètò Mo jẹ́ Ìlúmọ̀ńká Gbajúmọ̀ ni ITV.

rows.source: A source close to Jones said last night "We wouldn't comment on his business affairs."
rows.output: Ẹnikan tí ó súnmọ́ Jones sọ láláì ní alẹ́ yìí pé “A kò ní sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ìṣòwò rẹ.”
rows.reference: Orísun kan tó súnmọ́ Jones lálẹ́ àná sowípẹ́ ''A kòní sọ ọrọ lórí àwọn ohun tó nííṣe pẹ̀lú oko-òwò rẹ̀.''

rows.source: Tough talk 'and then we fell in love'
rows.output: Ìjíròrò tí ó nira 'a sì ṣubú nínú ìfẹ́'
rows.reference: Ọ̀rọ líle ‘léyìn náà a ábẹrẹ siní n’ìfẹ arawá́'

rows.source: He joked about criticism he would get from the news media for making a comment some would consider "unpresidential" and for being so positive about the North Korean leader.
rows.output: Ó fi ẹ̀rín ṣeré nípa ìyàlẹ́nu tí wọ́n lè ní láti inú àwọn ìròyìn fún ìṣòro kan tí àwọn kan lè rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí “àṣeyọrí” àti fún ìmúdàgba rẹ̀ nípa olórí ilẹ̀ Koria.
rows.reference: Ó ṣe àwàdà nípa ọ̀rọ̀ ìfàṣìṣe-ẹnihànni eyiti ma ǹ gbà l’ọwọ́ àwọn oníròyìn fún sísọ ọ̀rọ̀ tí àwọn kan yóò rò wípé ''Kò tọ si ààrẹ̀'' àti fún níní írètí rere nipa olὺdarí orilẹ-ede Ariwa Kòríà.

rows.source: Why has President Trump given up so much?
rows.output: Kí ló dé tí Ààrẹ Trump fi fi ìwọ̀n ńlá sí?
rows.reference: Kínni ìdí tí Ààrẹ Trump fi jú awà sílẹ̀ to bẹ́ẹ̀?

rows.source: Trump said in his mock "news anchor" voice.
rows.output: Trump sọ ní ohùn rẹ̀ “ìrònú ìròyìn”.
rows.reference: Trump sọ pẹ̀lú ohùn ẹ̀fẹ̀ ''atọ́kùn ìròyìn rẹ̀.

rows.source: "I didn't give up anything."
rows.output: "Mo kò fi ohun kan sílẹ̀."
rows.reference: Èmi kò ju awà kankan sílẹ̀.''

rows.source: He noted that Kim is interested in a second meeting after their initial meeting in Singapore in June was hailed by Trump as a big step toward denuclearization of North Korea.
rows.output: Ó ṣàkíyèsí pé Kim fẹ́ràn ìpàdé kejì lẹ́yìn ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ tí wọ́n ní ní Singapore ní oṣù kẹfa, tí Trump ṣe àfihàn rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìgbésẹ̀ ńlá sí ìparun ìbàjẹ́ ní North Korea.
rows.reference: Ó pe ̣àkíyèsí pé Kim ní ìfẹ́ sí ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀keji lẹ́yìn ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ wọn ní Singapore nínú oṣu Òkúdu eyiti Trump gbóríyìn fún bí ìgbésẹ̀ ńlá láti palẹ̀ ohun ìjà àdó olóró mọ́ kúrò ní orilẹ-ede Àriwá Kòrià.

rows.source: But denuclearization negotiations have stalled.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìjíròrò ìparun ohun èlò àgbáyé ti dúró.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìfikùnlukùn nípa pípalẹ àdó olóró mọ kúrò nílẹ̀ ti dúró tiiri.

rows.source: More than three months after the June summit in Singapore, North Korea's top diplomat Ri Yong Ho told world leaders at the U.N. General Assembly Saturday that the North doesn't see a "corresponding response" from the U.S. to North Korea's early disarmament moves.
rows.output: Lójoojúmọ́ oṣù mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn ìpàdé June ní Singapore, ọ̀gá àgbègbè North Korea, Ri Yong Ho sọ fún àwọn olórí àgbáyé ní Ìgbìmọ̀ Àpapọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Satidee pé North Korea kò rí “ìdáhùn tó bá ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀” láti ọ̀dọ̀ Amẹ́ríkà sí ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ North Korea.
rows.reference: Lẹyìn oṣù mẹ́ta o le diẹ lẹyìn ìpàdé ti oṣù Òkúdu ni Singapore, aṣojú àgbà orilẹ-ede Àríwa Kòríà Ri Yong Ho sọ fún àwọn olórí àgbáyé níbi ìpàdé àjọ U.N. ti Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbòò ni ọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta wípé Àríwá náà kòrí ''ìdáhùn tó bójúmu'' láti ọwọ́ orilẹ-ede U. S. sí àwọn ìgbésẹ tóyára ti Àríwá Kòríà láti kó àwọn nǹkàn ogun dánù.

rows.source: Instead, he noted, the U.S. is continuing sanctions aimed at keeping up pressure.
rows.output: Dípò, ó ṣàkíyèsí, Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà ń tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìdènà tí ó ń ṣe láti fi ipá mú kí ó máa tẹ̀síwájú.
rows.reference: Dípò rẹ̀, ó pe àkíyèsí pé, orilẹ-ede U.S. si ńtẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú àwọn ìjẹniníyà pẹ̀lú àfojúsùn láti máa mú ìnira pọ̀síi.

rows.source: Trump took a much more optimistic view in his rally speech.
rows.output: Trump gba ọ̀nà ìdánilójú púpọ̀ síi ní ọ̀rọ̀ ìpè rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Trump lo ojú ìwòye eyiti ó nírètí nínú ọ̀rọ̀ ìmóríyá rẹ̀.

rows.source: "We're doing great with North Korea," he said.
rows.output: A ń ṣe dáadáa pẹ̀lú Koria.
rows.reference: ''À ńṣe ohun ńlá pẹ̀lú Àriwá Kòríà,'' ní o wí.

rows.source: "We were going to war with North Korea.
rows.output: A ó lọ sí ogun pẹ̀lú North Korea.
rows.reference: À fẹ́ lọ jagun pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Àríwá Kòría télẹ̀.

rows.source: Millions of people would have been killed.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀ mílíọ̀nù ènìyàn ni yóò ti pa.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ mílíọ̀nù àwọn eniyan ní kòbá di pípa.

rows.source: Now we have this great relationship."
rows.output: "Bayi a ni ibi ti o dara yii."
rows.reference: Báyìí a ní ìbáṣepọ̀ ńlá.''

rows.source: He said his efforts to improve relations with Kim have brought positive results - ending rocket tests, helping free hostages and getting the remains of American servicemen returned home.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé ìsapá rẹ̀ láti mú ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Kim ti mú àwọn abájade rere wá - ìdáwọ́lé àwọn ìdánwò rọ́kẹ́ẹ̀tì, ríran àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n lọ́wọ́, àti rípadà àwọn ìkùnsín àwọn ọmọ ogun Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé àwọn ìgbìyànjú òun láti jẹ́kí ìtẹ̀síwájú bá ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Kim ti mú àwọn èsì rere jáde - fífi òpin sí dídán àwọn àdó olóró wò, ṣíṣe ìrànwọ́ láti tú àwọn ti wọn ̀dè sílẹ̀ àti gbígba àwọn tókù nínú àwọn ọmọ ogun Amẹrika padà sílé.

rows.source: And he defended his unusual approach in talking about relations with Kim.
rows.output: Ó sì dá ààbò rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ọ̀nà àjèjì rẹ̀ láti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Kim.
rows.reference: Ó gbe ara rẹ̀ níjà lórí ọ̀nà tí kò gbajúmọ̀ tó ńgbà sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Kim.

rows.source: "It's so easy to be presidential, but instead of having 10,000 people outside trying to get into this packed arena, we'd have about 200 people standing right there," Trump said, pointing at the crowd directly in front of him.
rows.output: "Ó rọrùn gan-an láti jẹ́ ààrẹ, ṣùgbọ́n dípò pé a ní 10,000 ènìyàn níta tí wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti wọlé sí ibi ìpàdé yìí tí ó kún, a ó ní àwọn ènìyàn tó tó 200 tí wọ́n dúró síbè."
rows.reference: ''Ó rọrùn láti ṣe bí ààrẹ, sùgbọ́n dípò ki a ní àwọn ènìyàń ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́wàá ti woń ńgbìyànjú láti wọ ibi tó kún fọ́fọ́ yìí, a ó ní bíi ènìyàn igba tó ńdúró níbí,'' gẹgẹ bíi  Trump ṣe wí, ósi ́na ìka sì èrò tówà níwájú rẹ̀.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami and Quake Devastate an Island, Killing Hundreds
rows.output: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ tsunami àti ìmìtàtà ní Indonesia ti bà á jẹ́ ní erékùṣù kan, tí ó sì pa ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn.
rows.reference: Ìkún omi Tsunami ati Ilẹ̀ rírì ni orilẹ-ede Indonẹsia ṣèbàjẹ́ nlá si erékùsù kan,ti ósí pa Àwọn ènìyàn bii Ọgọ́ọ̀rún

rows.source: In the aftermath of the Lombok earthquake, for instance, foreign nongovernmental organizations were told they were not needed.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn ìkún omi Lombok, fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn àjọ aládàáni ilẹ̀ òkèèrè ni wọ́n sọ pé kò sí ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú wọn.
rows.reference: Fún àpẹẹrẹ,lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ilẹ̀ rírí tí Lombok,  àwọn àjọ tí kìí ṣe ti ìjọba láti ilẹ̀ òkèèrè ni wọ́n sọ fún àwọn kò nílò wọn.

rows.source: Even though more than 10 percent of Lombok's population had been dislocated, no national disaster was declared, a prerequisite for catalyzing international aid.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ju 10 ogorun àwọn olùgbé Lombok lọ tí wọ́n ti lé kúrò ní ilé wọn, kò sí ìṣòro orílẹ̀-èdè tí a kéde, èyí tí ó jẹ́ dandan fún ìmúṣẹ́ ìrànlọ́wọ́ àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Bótilèjẹpé ó ju ìdá mẹ́wàá nínú ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn tó ńgbé ní Lombok tó di ẹniti a mú kúrò ní ibugbe rẹ̀, kòsì ìkéde àjálù gbogbogbòò kankan tí wọ́n kéde, eyi tííṣe àmúyẹ fún mímú ìrànwọ́ wọlé láti ̀ẹka ìrànlọwọ àgbáyé.

rows.source: "In many cases, unfortunately, they've been very clear that they're not requesting international assistance, so it's a bit challenging," Ms. Sumbung said.
rows.output: "Ni ọpọlọpọ awọn ọran, laanu, wọn ti sọ ni kedere pe wọn ko n beere fun iranlọwọ kariaye, nitorina o jẹ iṣoro diẹ," Arabinrin Sumbung sọ.
rows.reference: Arábìrin Sumbung sọ wipe ó ṣeni láàánú wípé ní pụ̀pọ̀ igbà wọn ma n fihàn gbangba wípé àwọn kò béèrè ìraǹwọ́ láti ọwọ́ ̀ẹka ìrànlọwọ gbogbo àgbáyé, nitorinaa ó jẹ́ nǹkan tó peni níjà,''

rows.source: While Save the Children is putting together a team to travel to Palu, it is not yet sure whether foreign staff can work on the ground.
rows.output: Lakoko ti Save the Children n ṣeto ẹgbẹ kan lati rin irin-ajo lọ si Palu, wọn ko ni idaniloju boya oṣiṣẹ ilu okeere le ṣiṣẹ ni ilẹ.
rows.reference: Nígbàtí Save the Children ńkó ikọ̀ kan jọ láti rin ìrìn àjò lọsí Palu, kò tíì dáni lójú bóyá àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ilẹ̀ òkèèrè leè ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ilẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: Mr. Sutopo, the national disaster agency spokesman, said Indonesian officials were assessing the situation in Palu to see whether international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the aid effort.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Sutopo, agbẹnusọ ile-iṣẹ ajalu orilẹ-ede, sọ pe awọn oṣiṣẹ ile-iṣẹ Indonesia n ṣe ayẹwo ipo ni Palu lati rii boya awọn ile-iṣẹ kariaye yoo jẹ ki wọn ṣe alabapin si akitiyan iranlọwọ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Sutopo, agbẹnusọ àjọ tó ńrísí ìṣẹ́lẹ̀ àjálù lórílẹ̀ èdè náà, sọpé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ Indonesia ńṣe òdiwọ̀n bí ọ̀rọ̀ tiṣe rí ní Palu láti rii bóyá wọn yóò gba àwọn àjọ kaakiri àgbáyé láàáyé láti kópa nínú ìyànjú fún ìrànwọ́ náà.

rows.source: Given the earth shaking that Indonesia constantly endures, the country remains woefully underprepared for nature's wrath.
rows.output: Ní ti ilẹ̀ yíyí tí Indonesia ń ṣe nígbà gbogbo, orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣì wà ní ìdààmú fún ìbínú ìṣọ̀títọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Pẹlú ilẹ̀ mímí̀ tí Indonesia ńfaradà yii, orilẹ-ede náà kosì tíì múrasílẹ̀ fún ìbínú ìṣẹ̀dá.

rows.source: While tsunami shelters have been built in Aceh, they are not a common sight on other coastlines.
rows.output: Lakoko ti a ti kọ awọn ibi aabo tsunami ni Aceh, wọn kò wọpọ ni awọn etikun miiran.
rows.reference: Bótilèjẹpé a ti kọ́ àwọn ibùgbé ìkún omi tsunami ní Aceh, kìí ṣe ohun tó wọ́pọ̀́ láti rí ní àwọn ààlà etíkun miran.

rows.source: The apparent lack of a tsunami warning siren in Palu, even though a warning had been in effect, is likely to have contributed to the loss of life.
rows.output: Ìfarahàn àìsí ìkìlọ̀ tsunami ní Palu, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìkìlọ̀ wà, ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó ti kópa nínú ìpàdánù ìgbésí ayé.
rows.reference: Ó fi hàn gbangba pe aìsí ìkìlọ fún ìkún omi tsunami ni Palu, ni ó ṣeé ṣe pe ó kópạ̀ nínú ipàdánù ẹmì, botilẹjepe ìkìlọ̀ kan ti wà fún lílò.

rows.source: At the best of times, traveling between Indonesia's many islands is challenging.
rows.output: Ní àkókò tó dára jùlọ, ríronú láàrin àwọn erékùṣù Indonesia jẹ́ ìpèníjà.
rows.reference: Ní àwọn àkókò tó dára jùlọ, rínrín ìrìn-àjò láàrin àwọn erékùsù Indonesia jẹ́ eyiti ó ńpeni níjà.

rows.source: Natural disasters make logistics even more complicated.
rows.output: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lù àdánidá ń mú kí àwọn ohun èlò ìrìnnà pọ̀ sí i.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù àtọ̀runwá ńjẹ́kí eètò ìgbòkè-gbodò di eyiti o pakasọ.

rows.source: A hospital ship that had been stationed in Lombok to treat earthquake victims is making its way to Palu, but it will take at least three days to reach the site of the new calamity.
rows.output: Ọkọ́ ìtọ́jú tí wọ́n ti gbé sí Lombok láti tọ́jú àwọn olùfarapa ìkún omi náà ń lọ sí Palu, ṣùgbọ́n yóò gba ó kéré tán ọjọ́ mẹ́ta láti dé ibi ìṣòro tuntun náà.
rows.reference: Ọkọ ojú omi kan ti óní ilé ìwòsàn ti wọ́n ti wà gúnlẹ̀ si Lombok èyítí won fi máa tọ́jú àwọn tó fara káásá àjálù ilẹ̀ rírí tí wà lójú ọ̀nà si Palu, ṣùgbọ́n yóò gbà ó kéré tán ọjọ́ mẹ́ta láti dé ibi àjálù tuntun náà.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo made improving Indonesia's tattered infrastructure a centerpiece of his election campaign, and he has lavished money on roads and railways.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Joko Widodo jẹ́ kí ìmúdàgba ìpèsè amáyédẹrù Indonesia jẹ́ àkójopọ́pọ̀ ìpèníjà ìdìbò rẹ̀, ó sì ti ná owó púpọ̀ sí i lórí àwọn ọ̀nà àti àwọn ọ̀nà.
rows.reference: ọkan lárà ohun ti Ààrẹ Joko Widodo nlo fún ìpolongo ìbò láti yàn án sípo ni mímú ìgbéga bá àwọn ohun amáyédẹrùn ni Indonesia tóti bàjẹ́ tán, ó sì náwó lórí àwọn ọ̀nà àti òpópónà ọkọ̀ ojú-irin.

rows.source: But funding shortfalls have plagued Mr. Joko's administration as he faces re-election next year.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn àìlera ìnáwọ̀ ti ń bà jẹ́ ìjọba Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Joko bí ó ti ń dojú kọ ìdìbò lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i ní ọdún tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Súgbọ̀n àwọn ẹ̀dínkù́ owó́ ti kó àìsàn bá ìṣàkóso ọgbẹni Joko bí ó ti ńdojúkọ ìbò dídì láti tún yàn an sípò.

rows.source: Mr. Joko is also facing pressure from lingering sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have embraced a more conservative form of the faith.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Joko tún ń dojú kọ ìyàtọ̀ ẹ̀sìn tí ó ti pẹ́ ní Indonesia, níbi tí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ Mùsùlùmí tó pọ̀ jù lọ ti gba ẹ̀sìn tó ní ìfaradà.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Joko ńkóju ìnira látàrí àwọn aáwọ̀ aláìdúró láàrin àwọn ẹlẹ́sìn ní Indonesia, níbití àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ti Musulumi tópọ̀jù ti faramọ́ irúfẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ alákatakíti tóle díẹ̀ síi.

rows.source: More than 1,000 people were killed and tens of thousands dislocated from their homes as Christian and Muslim gangs battled on the streets, using machetes, bows and arrows, and other crude weapons.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn tó lé ní ọgọ́rùn-ún (1,000) ni wọ́n pa, àwọn ẹgbẹ́ àwọn Kristẹni àti Mùsùlùmí sì ti lé àwọn ènìyàn ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ilé tí wọ́n ń gbé, wọ́n sì ń lo àwọn ohun èlò tí wọ́n fi ń gé, àwọn ọbọ, àti àwọn ohun èlò mìíràn tí wọ́n fi ń gé.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tó lé ni ẹgbẹ̀rún kan ni wọn kú tí ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ̀run síì ti kúrò nílé wọn bii ẹgbẹ́ Kristiẹni àti Musulumi se koju ìjà ní àwọn òpópónà, pẹ̀lú àwọn àdá, ọrún àti ọfà, àti àwọn ohun ìjà àtọwọ́dá miran.

rows.source: Watch: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.output: Ìwò: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.reference: Wòran: Daniel Sturridge ti Liverpool ti ayò wọlé láti di ọ̀mì dojúkọ. Chelsea

rows.source: Daniel Sturridge saved Liverpool from a Premier League loss to Chelsea with a score in the 89th minute on Saturday at Stamford Bridge in London.
rows.output: Daniel Sturridge ti gba Liverpool là kúrò nínú ìpadàbọ̀ Premier League sí Chelsea pẹ̀lú àmì kan ní ìṣẹ́jú 89 ní ọjọ́ Satidee ní Stamford Bridge ní London.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge gba Liverpool là kúrò lọ́wọ́ ìpàdánù Líìgì Pírẹ́míà sọ́wọ́ Chelsea pẹ̀lú àmì ayò kan ní ìṣẹ́jú kọkàndínláàádọ́rún lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta ní Stamford Bridge ní Lọndọnu.

rows.source: Sturridge received a pass from Xherdan Shaqiri while about 30 yards out from the Chelsea goal with his team trailing 1-0.
rows.output: Shaqiri gba Sturridge ni ìyàrá ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nígbèyìn, ó sì fi bẹ́ẹ̀ ṣe ìlà ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́wàá (30) sí ibi ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Chelsea pẹ̀lú ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ tí ó ń ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge gba bọ́ọ̀lù tí a gbá sii láti ọ̀dọ̀ Xherdan Shakiri nigbati ó wà ní bíi ìwọ̀n yáàdì ọgbọ̀n sí ojú ilé Chelsea àti wípé ikọ̀ rẹ̀ ńtọ alátakò wọn lẹ́yìn pẹ̀lú àmì ayò 1-0.

rows.source: He tapped the ball to his left before scooping a shot toward the far post.
rows.output: Ó fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lu bọ́ọ̀lù náà sí òsì rẹ̀ kí ó tó gbé ìfọ́kànsìn kan sí ọ̀nà jínjìn.
rows.reference: Ó taari bọ́ọ̀lù sí apá òsì rẹ̀ kí ó tó tun gbá sí igun tó jiǹnà sójú ilé.

rows.source: The attempt sailed high above the box as it drifted toward the right top corner of the net.
rows.output: Ìsapá náà rìn lọ sí orí àpótí náà bí ó ti ń rìn lọ sí apá ọ̀tún-òkìtà ti àwọ̀n náà.
rows.reference: Ìgbìyànjú náà lọ sókè ju àpótí ojúlé̀ pẹnáritì lọ bí o ti ńyapa sí òkè igun apá ọ̀tún àwọn náà.

rows.source: The ball eventually dropped over a leaping Kepa Arrizabalaga and fell into the net.
rows.output: Bọ́ọ̀lù náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣubú lórí Kepa Arrizabalaga tó ń fò jáde, ó sì wọ inú àgọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Lópin rẹ̀ bọ́ọ̀lù náà jábọ́ lókè Kepa Arrizalaga tó ńfò tí ó sì bọ́ sínu àwọn náà.

rows.source: "It was just trying to get into that position, to get on the ball and players like Shaq always play it forward as much as possible, so I just tried to create myself as much time as possible," Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.output: "Ó kàn ń gbìyànjú láti wà nínú ipò yẹn, láti gba bọ́ọ̀lù náà àti àwọn eléré bíi Shaq máa ń ṣe é níwájú bí ó ti lè ṣeé ṣe, nítorí náà mo kàn gbìyànjú láti dá àkókò fún ara mi bí ó ti ṣeé ṣe."
rows.reference: ''Ó kàn ńgbiyanju láti wọ inú ipò yẹn, láti dé orí bọ́ọ̀lù náà tí àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù bíi Shaq tí wọn máa ńgbá a siwaju níwọn bí ó báti ṣée ṣe sí, nitorinaa Mo kàn gbìyànjú láti ṣẹ̀dá bí o báti ṣée ṣe sí funrami,'' Sturridge wí fún LiverpoolFC.com.

rows.source: "I saw Kante coming and took one touch and didn't think about it too much and just took the shot on."
rows.output: "Mo rí Kante tí ń bọ̀ wọ́n, mo sì gbé ìfọwọ́kù kan, mi ò sì rò pé mo ní láti ronú nípa rẹ̀ púpọ̀ síi, mo kàn gbé ìfọwọ́kù náà."
rows.reference: Mo rí Kante bi oti nbọ tí ó sì ̀fọwọ́kàn o sì gbà bọ́ọ̀lù náà ní kíakíá.''

rows.source: Chelsea led 1-0 at halftime after getting a score in the 25th minute from Belgian star Eden Hazard.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n
rows.reference: Chelsea ́saájú pẹ̀lú àmi ayò 1-0 ní ìdajì àkókò ìdíje lẹ́yìn ́ti ìràwọ̀ ọmọ Bẹlijiọmu Eden Hazard gbá àmi ayò kan ní ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́ẹ̀dọ́gbọ̀n.

rows.source: The Blues striker heeled a pass back to Mateo Kovacic on that play, before spinning off near midfield and sprinting into the Liverpool half.
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà fi ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ kan padà sí Mateo Kovacic nínú eré yẹn, kí ó tó yí padà sí àgbègbè àárín pápá, kí ó sì sáré sínú apá ìlà oòrùn Liverpool.
rows.reference: Agbábọ́ọ̀lùwọnú-àwọ̀n Blues fi gìgìrísẹ̀ rẹ̀ gbá bọ́ọ̀lu sẹ́yìn sí Mateo Kovacic lọ́jọ́ náà, kí ó tó ta á lóókòtó kúrò nítòsí ààrin-gùngùn pápá tí ó sì ta á bọ̀ùn sí ìhà Liverpool.

rows.source: Kovacic did a quick give-and-go at midfield.
rows.output: Kovacic ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ tí ó yára ní àárín pápá.
rows.reference: Kovacic yára ṣe fún-un-kó-máa-lọ ní ààrin-gùngùn.

rows.source: He then fired a beautiful through ball, leading Hazard into the box.
rows.output: Ó sì fi bọ́ọ̀lù tí ó lọ́wọ́lùwọ́lù, ó sì mú Hézàdá lọ sí àyè ìkángun.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lù gbígbóná tó rẹwà eyiti to darí Hazard wọlé sínú àpòtí pẹnáritì náà.

rows.source: Hazard outran the defense and finished into the far post netting with a left footed shot past Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.output: Ìhùwàsí náà yára kọjá àyè ààbò náà ó sì fi ìfọwọ́kù kan bọ́ọ̀lù ọwọ́ òsì sí ibi ìfọwọ́kù Liverpool Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard sáré tayọ àwọn aláààbò tí o sì pari rẹ̀ sínú igun ojúlé lọ́ọ̀hún ó sì fi sínú àwọn pẹ̀lú ẹ̣́sẹ̀ òsì kan tó tayọ Alisson Becker ti Liverpool.

rows.source: Liverpool battles Napoli in the group stage of the Champions League at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.
rows.output: Ìpèníjà Liverpool pẹ̀lú Napoli ní ipele ẹgbẹ́ Ajumọ̀ṣepó Ajumọ̀ṣepó ní ọ̀sán ọjọ́bọ̀ ní Stadio San Paolo ní Naples, Italy.
rows.reference: Liverpool maa díje pẹ̀lú Napoli ní ipele oníṣọ̀rí ti Líìgì Àwọn Aṣẹ́gun ní aago mẹ́ta ọ̀sán lọ́jọ́ 'Ru ní Stadio San Paolo ni ìlú Naples, lorilẹ-ede Itali.

rows.source: Chelsea faces Videoton in the UEFA Europa Leaguge at 3 p.m. on Thursday in London.
rows.output: Chelsea yóò dojú kọ́ Videoton nínú UEFA Europa League ní ọ̀sán ọjọ́bọ̀ ní London.
rows.reference: Chelsea maa dojúkọ Videoton nínú Líìgi ti UEFA Europa ní aago mẹ́ta ọ̀sán lọ́jọ́ ‘Bọ̀ ní ìlú Lọndọnu.

rows.source: Death toll from Indonesia tsunami rises to 832
rows.output: Ìṣirò àwọn tí wọ́n pa ní ìjì líle Indonesia ti dé 832
rows.reference: Iye àwọn eniyan tókú nítorí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkún omi tsunsmi ni Indonesia tí fò sókè sí ẹgbẹ̀rinlélọ́gbọn àti méji.

rows.source: The death toll in Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami has climbed to 832, the country's disaster agency said early Sunday.
rows.output: Ìṣirò àwọn tí wọ́n kú ní ìbúgbùùkù ilẹ̀ Indonesia àti ìjì líle ti pọ̀ sí i ní 832, ilé-iṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣíṣẹ́ ìṣ
rows.reference: Iye àwọn eniyan tókú nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ilẹ̀ rírì àti ìkún omi tsunami ní Indonesia ti fò sóke sí ẹgbẹ̀rinlélọ́gbọ̀n àti méjì, àjọ tó ńrísí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù lorilẹ-ede náà sọ ní kùtùkùtù ọjọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: Many people were reported trapped in the rubble of buildings brought down in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake which struck Friday and triggered waves as high as 20 feet, agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho told a news conference.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ni wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n wà nínú ìdọ̀tí àwọn ilé tí wọ́n ti fọ́ tí ìmìtìtì ilẹ̀ 7.5 ṣe ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ tí ó sì fa ìkún omi tó ga tó ẹsùn 20 ẹsẹ̀, agbẹnusọ àjọ náà sọ pé Sutopo Purwo Nugroho ní ìpàdé àwọn onkọ̀wé ìròyìn.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ eniyan ní ìròyìn sọ wípé wọ́n há sínú ògiri àwọn ilé tó wó lulẹ̀ nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ilẹ̀ rírì oníwọ̀n 7.5  eyiti ó ṣe ọṣẹ́ lọjọ Ẹtì tí ó sì ṣokùnfà ìrusókè omi tóga tó ìwọ̀n ẹsẹ̀ bàtà ogún, agbẹnusọ àjọ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho ni o sọ fún ìpéjọpọ̀ àwọn oníròyìn kan.

rows.source: The city of Palu, which has more than 380,000 people, was strewn with debris from collapsed buildings.
rows.output: Ìlú Palu, tí ó ní àwọn ènìyàn tó ju 380,000 lọ, ni a ti bo pẹ̀lú àwọn ìdọ̀tí láti inú àwọn ilé tí wọ́n ti ṣubú.
rows.reference: Ìlú Palu náà, eyiti ó ní ju ẹgbẹ̀rún-lọ́nà-irinwódínlógún eniyan lọ, ni ó bò bámúbámú pẹ̀lú ògiri àlàpà láti ara àwọn ilé tówó lulẹ̵̀.

rows.source: Police arrest man, 32, on suspicion of murder after woman is stabbed to death
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá mú ọkùnrin kan, 32, lórí ìfura ìpànìyàn lẹ́yìn tí obìnrin kan ti pa.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá mú ọkùnrin, ẹni ọdùn méjìlélọ́gbọ̀n, lórí ìfurasí ìpànìyàn lẹ́yín ikú obìnrin tí a gún lọ́bẹ

rows.source: A murder investigation has been launched after woman's body was found in Birkenhead, Merseyside this morning.
rows.output: Ìwádìẹ́wọ́ ìpànìyàn ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí a ti rí ara obìnrin kan ní Birkenhead, Merseyside ní òwúrọ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: Ìwáàdí ìpànìyàn kan ni wọ́n ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n rí àgọ́-ara obìnrin kaǹ ní Birkenhead, Merseyside ní òwúrọ̀ yìí.

rows.source: The 44-year-old was found at 7.55am with stab wounds on Grayson Mews on John Street, with a 32-year-old man being arrested on suspicion of murder.
rows.output: Ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìnlá [44] ni wọ́n rí ní ọ̀sán ọ̀sán 7.55 pẹ̀lú ọgbọ́n ọgbọ́n ní Grayson Mews ní John Street, pẹ̀lú ọkùnrí mẹ́rìnlá [32] tí wọ́n mú lórí ìfura ìpànìyàn.
rows.reference: Ẹni ọdún mẹ́rìnlélógójì náà ni wọ́n rí ní aago mẹ́jọ òwúrọ̀ ku ìṣẹ́jú máàrún pẹ̀lú àwọn ojú-ọgbẹ́ lára rẹ̀ ni ́Grayson Mews ní òpòpóna John, pẹ̀lú ọkùnrin ẹni ọdún méjilélọ́gbọ̀n tí wọ́n mú lórí ìfurasì wípé ó pànìyàn.

rows.source: Police have urged people in the area who saw or heard anything to come forward.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti rọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ní agbègbè náà láti wá síwájú.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ti rọ àwọn eniyan lágbègbè náà tí wón rí tàbí gbọ́ ohunkóhun latí jáde wa.

rows.source: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation is in the early stages but I would appeal to anyone who was in the vicinity of John Street in Birkenhead who saw or heard anything suspicious to contact us.
rows.output: Ọga-ọlọpa Brian O'Hagan sọ pé: 'Ìwádìì náà wà ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ṣùgbọ́n mo fẹ́ kígbe sí àwọn ẹni tí ó bá wà ní àgbègbè John Street ní Birkenhead tí wọ́n rí tàbí gbọ́ ohunkóhun àjèjì láti kànsí wa.
rows.reference: Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ́ Inspector̀ Brian O'Hagan sọpé: 'Ìwáàdí ṣèṣẹ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ṣùgbọ́n Èmi yóò rawọ́ ẹ̀bẹ̀ sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó wà ní àyíká Òpópónà John ní Birkenhead tí ó rí tàbí gbọ́ ohunkóhun tí ó mú ìfura dání láti kàn sí wa.

rows.source: I would also appeal to anyone, particularly taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on dashcam footage to contact us as they may have information which is vital to our investigation.'
rows.output: Mo tun pe gbogbo eniyan, paapaa awakọ takisi, ti wọn ba ti ya ohun kan sori kamẹra ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ wọn, lati kan si wa nitori pe wọn le ni alaye pataki fun iwadii wa.
rows.reference: Mo tún ńrawọ́ ẹ̀bẹ̀ sí ẹnikẹ́ni, pàápàá jὺlọ́ àwọn awakọ̀ elérò́, tí ó leè tí gba àwòrán sílẹ̀ sórí kámẹ́rà ọpọ́n iwájú ọkọ̀ láti kàn sí wa nítorí wọn leè ní ìròyìn eyiti ó ṣe pàtàkì fún ìwáàdí wa.

rows.source: A police spokesman has confirmed the woman whose body was found is local to Birkenhead and she was found inside a property.
rows.output: Ọmọ́ ogun kan tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀gọ̀ọ̀rọ̀ kan ti sọ pé obìnrin tí ara rẹ̀ rí ní ibi tí ó wà ní Birkenhead, ó sì wà nínú ilé.
rows.reference: Agbẹnusọ àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá kan ti fìdí rẹ múlẹ̀ wípé obìnrin náà ẹniti wọ́n rí àgọ́-ara rẹ̀ jẹ ará Birkenhead àtipé wọn ríi nínú ilé kan.

rows.source: This afternoon friends who believe they know the woman have arrived at the scene to ask questions about where she was found this morning.
rows.output: Ní ọ̀sán yìí, àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ tí wọ́n gbà pé wọ́n mọ̀ ọ́n ni wọ́n ti dé ibi tí wọ́n rí i ní òwúrọ̀ yìí láti béèrè àwọn ìbéèrè nípa ibi tí wọ́n rí i.
rows.reference: Ní ọ̀sán yìí àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ tí ó gbàgbọ́ wípé ̀wọn mọ obìnrin náà ti dé ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà láti bèèrè  ibití wọ́n ti rí i ni òwúrọ̀ yìí.

rows.source: Investigations are ongoing as police have said they are in the process of informing the victim's next of kin.
rows.output: Àwọn ìwádìí ń lọ lọ́wọ́ bí àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣe sọ pé wọ́n ń ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí tó kù.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìwáàdí sì ńlọ lọ́wọ́í àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá naa ti sọ wípé àwọn fẹgbé́ ìgbésẹ̀ láti jẹ́kí ẹnití ó súnmọ́ arábìnrin ọhúṇ mọ̀ nípa ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ naa.

rows.source: A taxi driver who lives in Grayson Mews has just tried to get back into his flat but is being told by police no one is allowed in or out of the building.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin tí ó ń wakọ̀ takisí tí ó ń gbé ní Grayson Mews ti gbìyànjú láti padà sínú ilé rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti sọ fún un pé kò sí ẹni tí a gbà láti wọlé tàbí jáde nínú ilé náà.
rows.reference: Awàkọ akérò kan tó ńgbé ní Grayson Mewṣ gbìyànjù láti wọ inú ibùgbé rẹ ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ńsọ fún un wípé wọn kògba ́ẹnikẹ́nì láàyè láti wọlé tàbí jáde kúrò nínú ilé náà.

rows.source: He was speechless when he discovered what happened.
rows.output: Ó dúró ṣinṣin nígbà tí ó rí ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Kó lèe sọ̀rọ̀ kankan nigbati ó ṣàwárí ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.source: Residents are now being told it will be hours until they are allowed back in.
rows.output: Àwọn olùgbèé ni a ń sọ fún wọn báyìí pé yóò jẹ́ wákàtí mẹ́ta kí wọ́n tó lè padà sí inú.
rows.reference: Báyìí wọ́n ńsọ fún àwọn olùgbé agbègbè naa wìpè yóò tó wákàtí diẹ kí wọn tó leè fààyè gbà wọ́n láti wọlé padà.

rows.source: A police officer was heard telling one man that the entire area is now being treated as a crime scene.
rows.output: Ọlùfẹ́sọ́nà kan ni wọ́n gbọ́ tí ó ń sọ fún ọkùnrin kan pé gbogbo agbègbè náà ti di ibi ìwà ọ̀daràn báyìí.
rows.reference: Òṣìṣẹ́ ọlọ́ọ̀pá kan ni wọn gbọ́ tí ó ńsọ fún ọkùnrin kan wípé gbogbo agbègbè náà ni wọn ńfọwọ́ mú bíi ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ọ̀ràn.

rows.source: A woman appeared at the scene in tears.
rows.output: Obìnrin kan hàn ní ibi tí ó ń sunkún.
rows.reference: Obìnrin kan farahàn níbí ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà pẹ̀lú omijé lójú.

rows.source: She keeps repeating 'it's so awful'.
rows.output: Ó máa ń tún sọ pé “ó burú jù”.
rows.reference: Ó sáà ńtẹnumọ́ 'ó burú jáì'.

rows.source: At 2pm two police vans were inside the cordon with another van just outside.
rows.output: Ní ọ̀sán méjì, àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ọlọ́pàá méjì wà nínú àgọ́ pẹ̀lú ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ mìíràn níta.
rows.reference: Ní aago méjì ọ̀sán ọkọ̀ ọlọ́ọ̀pá méji ti wà nínú ibití ìṣẹlẹ náà pẹ̀lú ọkọ̀ miran ní ìta.

rows.source: A number of officers were stood inside the cordon monitoring the block of flats.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọlọ́pàá ni wọ́n dúró sí inú àgọ́ náà tí wọ́n ń ṣọ́ àwọn ilé ìgbọ̀nà náà.
rows.reference: ọ̀ṕọ̀́ àwọn òṣìṣe ọlọ́ọ̀pá ̣́ kan ni wọ́n dúró sínú ibití ìṣẹlẹ naa fun ìmójútó ojúle ní ìbùgbé náà.

rows.source: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.
rows.output: Ẹnikẹni ti o ni alaye ni a beere lati fi ranṣẹ si DM @MerPolCC, pe 101 tabi kan si Crimestoppers ni anonymously lori 0800 555 111 ti n tọka si log 247 ti 30th September.
rows.reference: Ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bání ìròyìn ni a rọ̀ láti DM @MerPoICC, pe 101 tàbí kàn sí Crimestoppers láìdárúkọ lórí 08000 555 111 kí ó sì ́lo ọ̀rọ̀ àyọlò log 247 ti Ọgbọ́njọ́ọ́ Oṣù Ọwara.

rows.source: Parliament's statue of Cromwell becomes latest memorial hit by 'rewriting history' row
rows.output: Ìjọ̀sọ̀rí ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin ti Cromwell di ìṣòro tuntun nínú ìforígbárí nípa ‘títún ìtàn ṣe’
rows.reference: Èère ti ile Aṣojú-ṣòfin ti Cromwell ti ńdi nǹkan ìrántí táyénwí tó tuntun jùlọ nípa awuye-wuye 'títún ìtàn kọ'

rows.source: Its banishment would be poetic justice for his Taliban-like destruction of so many of England's cultural and religious artefacts carried out by his fanatical Puritan followers.
rows.output: Ìjìyà rẹ̀ yóò jẹ́ ìdájọ́ ìtànjẹ́ fún ìparun Taliban rẹ̀ ti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ohun ìṣọ̀kan àti ẹ̀sìn England tí àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ Puritan tí ó ní ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ ṣe.
rows.reference: Ìlékúróní-ìlú rẹ̀ yóò jẹ́ ìdájọ̀ eléwì fún ìparun bíi ti àwọn ẹlẹ́sìn Taliban tí ó gbé ṣe lóri ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn nǹkan ìṣẹ̀ḿbáyé àṣà àti ẹ̀sìn ilẹ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nípaṣẹ̀ àwọn olùtẹ̀lé Ẹlẹ́sìn alákatakí tirẹ̀.

rows.source: But the Cromwell Society described Mr Crick's suggestion as "folly" and "attempting to rewrite history."
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n, Ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell ṣàpèjúwe ìmúlò Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Crick gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìbàjẹ́” àti “ìgbìyànjù láti tún ìtàn ṣe.”
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell ṣàpèjúwe àbà Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Crick bíi ''ìwà òmùgọ̀'' àti ''ìgbìyànjú láti tún ìtàn kọ.''

rows.source: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "It was inevitable in the present debate about the removal of statues that the figure of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster would become a target.
rows.output: Olóyè John Goldsmith, alága ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell Society, sọ pé: “Ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí nínú ìjíròrò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ nípa ìyọkúrò àwọn àwòrán, ìrísí Oliver Cromwell níta Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin Westminster yóò di ibi ìfọkànsìn.
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, alága ti Ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell, sọpé: “Ó jẹ́ ohun tí kò ṣée dènà nínú àríyànjiyàn tó ńlọ lọ́wọ́ nípa ìyọkúrò àwọn èère wípé àwòrán èèrè ti Oliver Cromwell tówà níta Ààfin ti Westminster ni yóò di àfojúsùn kan.

rows.source: The iconoclasm of the English civil wars was neither ordered nor carried out by Cromwell.
rows.output: Ìkórìra àwọn ìjìyà ìjọba Gẹ̀ẹ́sì kò jẹ́ ìtọ́nisọ́nà tàbí ìmúṣẹ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ Cromwell.
rows.reference: Ìwòye àwọn tí ńpa àwòrán èère run ti àwọn ogun abẹ́lé ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ni a kò pàṣẹ rẹ̀ tàbí gbé wọn ṣe láti ọwọ́ Cromwell.

rows.source: Perhaps the wrong Cromwell would be sacrificed for the actions of his ancestor Thomas in the previous century.
