rows.output: Ìwọ̀n Lartín: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà farapa nínú ìdàrúdàpọ̀
rows.reference: Ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n Long Lartin: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà farapa nínú ìdàrúdàpọ̀

rows.source: Six prison officers have been injured in a disturbance at a high security men's jail, the Prison Office has said.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀gá ẹ̀wọ̀n mẹ́fà ni wọ́n farapa nínú ìforígbárí kan ní ẹ̀wọ̀n ọkùnrí tó ga jùlọ, ọ́fíìsì ẹ̀wọ̀n ti sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ ogbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n mẹ́fà níwọn farapa níbi ìdàdarádàpọ̀ kan nínú ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n aláààbò gíga ti àwọn ọkùnrin, Ọ́fíìsì Ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà ti sọ.

rows.source: Disorder broke out at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire at about 09:30 BST on Sunday and is ongoing.
rows.output: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní HMP Long Lartin ní Worcestershire ní àwọn wákàtí mẹ́sàn-án ní ọjọ́ Sọ́ndé, ó sì ń lọ lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ bẹ́ sílẹ̀ ní HMP Long Lartin ní Worcestershire ní bíi aago mẹ́ẹ̀sán àti ààbọ̀ Àkókò Gẹ̀ẹ́sì lọ́jọ́ Àìkú àtipé ó sì ńlọ lọ́wọ́.

rows.source: Specialist "Tornado" officers have been brought in to deal with the disturbance, which involves eight inmates and is contained to one wing.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ “Tornado” tí wọ́n ní ìmúrasílẹ̀ ti wà níbè láti yanjú ìdàrúdàpọ̀ náà, èyí tí ó ní àwọn ẹ̀wọ̀n mẹ́jọ àti pé ó wà ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan ṣoṣo.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ ''Tornado'' níwọ́n ti kó wọlé láti yanjú aáwọ̀ náà, eyiti o nííṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n mẹ́jọ tí ó sì dáwà ní apá kan ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà.

rows.source: The officers were treated for minor facial injuries at the scene.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlùṣẹ́ náà gba itọju fún àwọn ìfarapa ojú kékeré ní ibi tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ti ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ náà níwọ́n tọ́jú àwọn ìfarapa ojú tómọ̀ níwọ̀nba níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: A Prison Service spokesperson said: "Specially trained prison staff have been deployed to deal with an ongoing incident at HMP Long Lartin.
rows.output: Ẹ̀rù ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ kan sọ pé: “Ẹ̀rù ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ kan ti ṣe ìgbọ́kùnlé láti yanjú ìṣòro kan tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ ní HMP Long Lartin.
rows.reference: Agbẹnusọ Ìṣẹ́ Ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n kan sọ: ''Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ọgbà-ẹ̀wọn tí a ti kọ́ lẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àkànṣ̵e ní a ti kó lọ láti yanjú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tó ńwáyé lọ́wọ́ ní HMP Long Lartin.

rows.source: Six members of staff have been treated for injuries.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà ni wọ́n ti tọ́jú fún àwọn ìfarapa.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà ni a ti tọ́jú fún àwọn ìpalára.

rows.source: We do not tolerate violence in our prisons, and are clear that those responsible will be referred to the police and could spend longer behind bars."
rows.output: A kò ní farada ìwà ipá nínú àwọn ẹ̀wọ̀n wa, a sì mọ̀ pé àwọn tó jẹ́ ẹni tó jẹ́ ẹni náà yóò fi hàn sí àwọn ọlọ́pàá, wọ́n sì lè lo àkókò púpọ̀ síi nínú ẹ̀wọ̀n.
rows.reference: A kò fààyè gba ìwà ipá nínú àwọn ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n wa, tí a sì fihàn gbangba pé àwọn tí ó ṣe é ni a o fà lé àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá lọ́wọ́ tí wọ́n sì leè lo àkókó  tó gùn díẹ̀ síi lẹ́yìn àwọn irin àhámọ́.

rows.source: HMP Long Lartin holds more than 500 prisoners, including some of the country's most dangerous offenders.
rows.output: HMP Long Lartin mu ju 500 ẹlẹwọ, pẹlu diẹ ninu awọn ẹlẹwọ ti o lewu julọ ni orilẹ-ede naa.
rows.reference: HMP Long Lartin ńtọ́jú àwọn ẹlẹ́wọn tóju ẹ̀ẹ́dẹ̀gbẹ̀ta lọ, pẹ̀lú àwọn kan nínú àwọn ọ̀daràn náà tóléwu jùlọ ní orilẹ-ede.

rows.source: In June it was reported that the prison's governor received hospital treatment after being attacked by a prisoner.
rows.output: Ni Okudu, o ti royin pe oluṣẹ́ ẹ̀wọ̀n náà gba itọju ile-iwosan lẹ́yìn tí wọn kọlu ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀wọ̀n kan.
rows.reference: Nínú oṣù Òkúdu níwọ́n ròyìn wípé gómìnà ọgba-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà gba ìtọ́jú ilé-ìwòsàn lẹ́yìn tí ẹlẹ́wọn kan kọ lù ú.

rows.source: And in October last year riot officers were called to the prison to deal with a serious disturbance in which staff were attacked with pool balls.
rows.output: Ní October ọdún tó kọjá, àwọn ọlùfẹ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́f
rows.reference: Àtipé nínú oṣù Ọ̀wàrà lọ́dún tó kọjá wọ́n pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ apaná-ọ̀tẹ̀ sínú ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà láti yanjú aáwọ̀ líle kan nínú eyiti wọ́n ti kọlu àwọn òṣìsẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn bọ́ọ̀lù alekoko-bí-irin.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa Threatening Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City With Flash Flooding (Drought Areas May Benefit)
rows.output: Ìjì líle Rosa ń halẹ̀ mọ́ Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City Pẹ̀lú Ìjì líle (Àwọn agbègbè ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ lè jẹ́ àǹfààní)
rows.reference: Ìjì-líle Hurricane Rosa ńdúnkòokò mọ́ Phoenix, Las Vegas, Ìlú Salt Lake pẹ̀lú Ìkún-omi aláyalù (Àwọn agbègbè Ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ leè jẹ́ Àǹfààní)

rows.source: It's rare for a tropical depression to hit Arizona, but that's exactly what's likely to happen early happen early next week as Hurricane Rosa's remaining energy tracks across the Desert Southwest, delivering flash flooding risks.
rows.output: Ó ṣòro fún ìjì líle tó ń lọ sí Arizona, ṣùgbọ́n ìyẹn ni ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbára ìjì líle Rosa ṣe ń lọ sí Desert Southwest, tí ń mú ewu ìjì líle wá.
rows.reference: ṣọ̀wọ́n fún ìjìnwọnú ilẹ̀ olóoru kan láti kọlu Arizona, ṣùgbọn ìyẹn gan-an ní ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó ṣẹlẹ̀  níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ńbọ bí agbara Ìjì líle Hurricane Rosa tóṣẹ́kù ṣe ńtọ ipa lọ láti la Asálẹ Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Gúúsù já, tí ó sì àwọn ewu ìkún-omi aláyalù sílẹ̀.

rows.source: The National Weather Service has already issued flash flood watches for Monday and Tuesday for western Arizona into southern and eastern Nevada, southeastern California and Utah, including the cities of Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka Ìṣirò Ìjìnlára ti Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà ti ti jáde ní ìwífún ìjì líle fún ọjọ́ Aarọ̀ àti ọjọ́ Ẹtì fún ìwọ̀ oòrùn Arizona sí gúúsù àti ìlà oòrùn Nevada, gúúsù ìwọ̀ oòrùn California àti Utah, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìlú Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, àti Salt Lake City.
rows.reference: Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ojú-ọjọ́ ti Orilẹ-ede náà ti ṣàgbéjáde àwọn ìṣọ́nà fún ìkún-omi aláyalù fún ọjọ́ Ajé àti ọjọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun fún apà ìwọ-oòrùn Arizona sínu gúùsù àti ìlà-oòrùn Nevada, ìlà-oòrùn gúúsù California àti Utah, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìlú ti Phoenix. Flagstaff, Las Vegas, ati Ìlú Salt Lake.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to take a direct path over Phoenix on Tuesday, approaching late Monday with rain.
rows.output: Rosa ni a nireti lati gba ọna taara lori Phoenix ni ọjọ Tuesday, ti o n sunmọ ni alẹ ọjọ Aiku pẹlu ojo.
rows.reference: Rosa ni a retí láti gba ọ̀nà tààrà kan lórí Phoenix lọjọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun, tósì ńsúnmọ́ alẹ́ ọjọ́ Ajé pẹ̀lú òjò.

rows.source: The National Weather Service in Phoenix noted in a tweet that only "ten tropical cyclones have maintained tropical storm or depression status within 200 miles of Phoenix since 1950!
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka Ìjìnláàdúrà ti Orílẹ̀-èdè ní Phoenix ṣe àkójọpọ̀ pé àwọn ìjìnláàdúrà mẹ́wàá nìkan ni wọ́n ti pa ìjìnláàdúrà tàbí ìpìlẹ̀ ìjìnláàdúrà mọ́ ní ìwọ̀n 200 kìlómítà sí Phoenix láti ọdún 1950!
rows.reference: Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ojú-ọjọ́ ti Orilẹ-ede ní Phoenix ṣàkíyèsí nínú àtẹ̀jade tuwiti kan wípé ''àwọn ìjì-líle cyclone mẹ́wàá nìkan níwọn nmú ẹ̀fúùfú lílé tilẹ̀ olóoru tàbi ìjìnwọnú-ilẹ̀ dání láàrin igba máìlì ti Phoenix láti ọdún 1950!

rows.source: Katrina (1967) was a hurricane within 40 miles of the AZ border."
rows.output: Katrina (1967) jẹ́ ìjì líle kan tó wà ní ìwọ̀n 40 kìlómítà sí ààlà AZ.
rows.reference: Katrina (1967) jẹ́ ìjì-líle hurricane kan laàrin ogójì máìlì ti ààlà AZ náà.''

rows.source: The latest National Hurricane Center models predict 2 to 4 inches of rainfall, with isolated amounts up to 6 inches in the Mogollon Rim of Arizona.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣọtẹ́lẹ̀ tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ṣẹ̀dá láti ọ̀dọ̀ Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣ
rows.reference: Àwọn àṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀jáde àwòkọ́ṣe ti Ibùdó Ìjì-líle ti Orilẹ-ede ṣàsọtẹ́lẹ̀ àwọn ìwọn íǹsì 2 sí 4 ti òjò-rírọ, pẹ̀lú iye àwọn ìwọn ínsí tí ó le tó 6 oníkéle-kèle ní Mologon Rim ti Arizona.

rows.source: Other areas of the Desert Southwest including the central Rockies and the Great Basin are likely to get 1 to 2 inches, with isolated totals up to 4 inches possible.
rows.output: Àwọn agbègbè mìíràn ní Àárín Gbùngbùn Àárín Gbùngbùn, pẹ̀lú àwọn apá àárín Rocky àti Basin Gíga, lè rí 1 sí 2 íńsì, pẹ̀lú àwọn àpapọ̀ tó pọ̀ jù lọ sí 4 íńsì.
rows.reference: Àwọn agbègbè miran ti Ìwọ-oòrùn Gúúsù pẹ̀lú ààrin gúngún Rockies àti Great Basin náà ní ó ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n gba ìwọn íǹsì 1 sí 2, pẹ̀lú àwọn àropọ̀ onísége-sège tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó tó íǹsì 4.

rows.source: For those out of flash flood risk, Rosa's rain may be a blessing since the region is drought-stricken.
rows.output: Fun awọn ti o wa ni ewu iṣan omi, ojo Rosa le jẹ ẹbun nitori agbegbe naa ti bajẹ.
rows.reference: Fún àwọn tí kòsí níbiti ewu ìkún-omi aláyalù wà, òjò Rosa leè jẹ́ ìbùkún níwọ́n bí agbègbè náà ti jẹ́ eyiti ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ ńbá jà.

rows.source: Although flooding is a very serious concern, some of this rainfall will likely be beneficial since the Southwest is currently experiencing drought conditions.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìkún omi jẹ́ ìṣòro tó ṣe pàtàkì, àwọn apá kan nínú ìkùukùu yìí lè jẹ́ àǹfààní nítorí pé Gúúsù ìwọ̀ oòrùn ń dojú kọ ìṣòro ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Botilẹjẹpe ìkùn-omi jẹ ohun tó fúnni ní ìpayà gidi, àwọn òjò-rírọ̀  kan yóò jẹ́ eyiti yóò ṣeni láǹfààní níwọ̀n igbati Iwọ-oòrùn gúúsù ti ńní ìrírí àwọn ipò ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.

rows.source: According to the U.S. Drought Monitor, just over 40 percent of Arizona is experiencing at least extreme drought, the second highest category," weather.com reported.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí U.S. Ìṣòro Ìgbóná, ó lé ní 40 ogorun Arizona tí ó ń dojú kọ́ àìní omi tó le gan-an, ẹ̀ka kejì tó ga jùlọ,” weather.com sọ.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí orilẹ-ede U.S. ti wí Aláàmójútó Ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀, ó lé ní ìdá ogójì nínú ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti Arizona ló ńní ìrírì ó kéré tán ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ tó bọ́ sódì, ìṣọ̀rí tóga jùlọ ẹlẹ́ẹ̀keji,'' ní weather.com sọ níròyìn.

rows.source: First, Hurricane Rosa's path leads to landfall across the Baja California peninsula of Mexico.
rows.output: Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, ìjì líle Rosa ń lọ sí ilẹ̀ ní àárín Baja California peninsula ti Mexico.
rows.reference: Àkọ́kọ́, ipa ọ̀nà Ìjì-líle Hurricane Rosa ńdarí lọsí  àkọ́rí ilẹ láti inú òkun wọ gbogbo erékùsù Baja California ti Mẹ́síkò.

rows.source: Rosa, still at hurricane strength Sunday morning with maximum winds of 85 miles per hour, is 385 miles south of Punta Eugenia, Mexico and moving north at 12 miles per hour.
rows.output: Rosa, tí ó ṣi ń lọ ní agbára ìjì líle ní ọjọ́ Aiku pẹ̀lú ìjìnlá ìjìnlá ìjìnlá 85 kìlómítà ní wákàtí kan, ó jẹ́ 385 kìlómítà sí ìlà oòrùn Punta Eugenia, Mexico, ó sì ń lọ sí àríwá ní 12 kìlómítà ní wákàtí kan.
rows.reference: Rosa, tósì wà síbẹ̀ pẹ̀lú agbára hurricane lọ́jọ́ Àìkú pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹ̀fúùfù tóga jùlọ ti máìlì máàrúnlélọ́gọ́rin ní wákàtí kan, ńbẹ ní máìlì irinwó-dín-mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún gúúsù ti Punta Eugenia, Mẹ́ṣíkò tí ó sì ńlọ sí àríwá ní máìlì mẹ́wàá ní wákàtí kan.

rows.source: The storm is encountering cooler waters in the Pacific and therefore powering down.
rows.output: Ìjì líle náà ń bá omi tó tutù ní Pásífíìkì, nítorí náà ó ń dínkù.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀fúùfù náà ńpàdé àwọn omi tó tutú díẹ̀ síi lọ́nà ní Pacific tí agbára rẹ̀ sì ńdínkù nitori ìdí èyí.

rows.source: Thus, it's expected to make landfall in Mexico at tropical storm strength in the afternoon or evening on Monday.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, a máa retí pé yóò dé ilẹ̀ Mexico ní agbègbè ìjì líle ní ọ̀sán tàbí alẹ́ ọjọ́ Aarọ̀.
rows.reference: Nitorinaa, a ńretí wípé yóò forí sọlẹ̀ ní Mẹ́ṣíkò nínú agbára ẹ̀fúùfù ti olóorun ní ọ̀sán tábi ìrọ̀lẹ́  lọ́jọ́ Ajé.

rows.source: Rainfall across portions of Mexico could be heavy, posing a significant flooding risk.
rows.output: Ìjì líle lè ṣẹlẹ̀ ní àwọn apá kan ní Meksíko, èyí tó lè fa ìkún omi tó ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Òjò-rírọ̀ káàkiri àwọn ìpin ti Mẹ́ṣíkò leè pọ púpọ̀, tí ó sì ńfi ewu ìkún-omi tóṣe pàtakì kàn hàn.

rows.source: "Rainfall totals of 3 to 6 inches are expected from Baja California into northwestern Sonora, with up to 10 inches possible," weather.com reported.
rows.output: "Ìwọ̀n òjò 3 sí 6 inches ni a ń retí láti Baja California sí ariwa iwọ-oorun Sonora, pẹ̀lú tó 10 inches lè ṣeé ṣe," weather.com royin.
rows.reference: Àwọn àropọ òjò-rírọ̀ ti ìwọn íǹsì 3 sí 6 ni a retí láti Baja California wọ inú ìwọ̀-oòrùn àríwá Sonora tí eyiti ó tó íǹsì 10 sì ṣeé ṣe.

rows.source: Rosa will then track north across Mexico as a tropical storm before reaching the Arizona border in the early morning hours Tuesday as a tropical depression, which will then track up through Arizona and into southern Utah by late Tuesday night.
rows.output: Rosa yóò tẹ̀ síwájú sí àríwá ní orílẹ̀-èdè Mẹ́kísìkò gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìjì líle, kí ó tó dé ààlà Arizona ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọjọ́ Tuesday gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìjì líle, èyí yóò sì tẹ̀ síwájú ní Arizona àti sí gúúsù Utah ní alẹ́ Tuesday.
rows.reference: Rosa yóò la ipa lẹ́yìn náà sí apá àríwá láti la Mẹ́síkò já bíi ẹ̀fùúfú olóoru kan kí ó tó dé ààlà Arizona ní àwọn wákàtí ìsáájú ti òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun bíi ìjìnwọnú-ilẹ̀ olóoru kan, eyiti yóò la ipa lẹ́yìn náà gòkè gba inú Arizona àti sínú gúúsù Utah kí ó tó di alẹ́ ọjọ Ìṣẹ́gun.

rows.source: "The main hazard expected from Rosa or its remnants is very heavy rainfall in Baja California, northwestern Sonora, and the U.S. Desert Southwest," the National Hurricane Center said.
rows.output: "Ìpèníjà pàtàkì tí a ń retí láti ọ̀dọ̀ Rosa tàbí àwọn ẹ̀yà rẹ̀ ni ìjì líle ní Baja California, àrìwísí Sonora, àti Àárín Gbùngbùn Amẹ́ríkà Gbàgede.”
rows.reference: Okùnfà ewu gbòógì náà tí a reti láti ọwọ́ Rosa tàbí àwọn ìyókù rẹ̵̀ ni ọ̀pọ̀ òjò-rírọ̀ gidi ní Baja California, ní ìwọ-oòrùn àríwá Sonora, àti orilẹ-ede U.S. Asálẹ Ìlà-oòrùn Gúúsù,'' ni Ibùdó Ìjì-líle Hurricane ti Orilẹ-ede náà sọ.

rows.source: These rains are expected to produce life-threatening flash flooding and debris flows in the deserts, and landslides in mountainous terrain.
rows.output: Àwọn òjò wọ̀nyí ni a ń retí pé yóò mú ìjì líle àti ìkún omi ní àwọn aginjù, àti ìkún omi ní ilẹ̀ òkè.
rows.reference: Àwọn òjò ni a rètí wípé wọn yóò fa ìkún-omi aláyalù àti àwọn ìsàn pàǹtí eyiti ó leè gba ẹ̀mí eniyan nínú àwọn asálẹ̀, àti àwọn ilẹ̀ yíya ní awọn ibití ó jẹ́ òkè.

rows.source: Midsomer Norton attack: Four attempted murder arrests
rows.output: Ìkìlọ̀ Midsomer Norton: Àwọn ìfipá mú mẹ́rin
rows.reference: Ìkọlù Midsomer Norton: wọn tì awon mẹ́rin ́sátìmọ́lé fún gbìgbìyànjú láti pànìyàn

rows.source: Three teenage boys and a 20-year-old man have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was found with stab wounds in Somerset.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọkùnrin mẹ́ta tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ àti ọkùnrin kan tó jẹ́ ọdún ogún ni wọ́n ti mú ní ìfura pé wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti pa ẹni nígbèkùndùgbè Somerset.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọkùnrin màjèsín mẹ́ta àti ọkùnrin ẹni ogún kan ni wọ́n ti mú sátìmọ́lé lórí ìfurasínì fún ìgbìyànjú láti pàniyàn lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n rí ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìndínlógún kan pẹ̀lú àwọn ojú-ọgbẹ́ ọ̀bẹ ní Somerset.

rows.source: The teenage boy was found injured in the Excelsior Terrace area of Midsomer Norton, at about 04:00 BST on Saturday.
rows.output: Ọmọkùnrin náà tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ ni wọ́n rí ní ìfarapa ní àgbègbè Excelsior Terrace ní Midsomer Norton ní bíi ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.
rows.reference: Ọmọkùnrin màjèsín náà ni wọn ri pẹ̀lú ìpalára ní agbègbe Excelsior Terrace ti Midsomer Norton, ní bíi aago mẹ́rin Àkókò Gẹ̀ẹ́sì lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.source: He was taken to hospital where he remains in a "stable" condition.
rows.output: Wọ́n gbé e lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn, níbi tí ó ti wà ní “ìpamọ́” lọwọlọwọ.
rows.reference: Wọ́n gbé e lọsí ilé-ìwòsàn níbití ó gbé wà ní ipò ''àìléwu'' kan.

rows.source: A 17-year-old, two 18-year-olds and a 20-year-old man were arrested overnight in the Radstock area, Avon and Somerset Police said.
rows.output: Ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàdínlọ́gbọ̀n [17], méjì [2] ọmọ ọdún méjìdínlógọ́rin [18] àti ọkùnrin kan tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún ogún [20] ni wọ́n mú ní alẹ́ yìí ní àgbègbè Radstock, Avon and Somerset Police sọ.
rows.reference: Gẹgẹ bíi àwọn Ọlọ́ọ̀pá Avon àti Somerset ṣe sọ,ẹni ọdún mẹ́tadínlógún kan,àwọn ẹni ọdún méjìdínlógún méji àti ọkùnrin ẹni ogún ọdún kan ní wọ́n mú ṣátìmọ́lé ní agbègbe Radstock.

rows.source: Officers have appealed for anyone who may have any mobile phone footage of what happened to come forward.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti ń bèèrè lọ́wọ́ ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bá ní fọ́tò fọ́tò alágbèéká èyíkéyìí nípa ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀ láti wá wá.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ ti rawọ́ ẹ̀bẹ̀ sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó leè ní ìgbàsílẹ̀ fídíò ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ sórí fóònù aláàgbéká láti jáde wá.

rows.source: Trump says Kavanaugh 'suffered, the meanness, the anger' of the Democratic Party
rows.output: Trump sọ pé Kavanaugh “ní ìrora, ìbínú, ìbínú” ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democratic
rows.reference: Trump sọpé Kavanaugh 'jìya, ìkó-ìrira náà, ìbínú náà' ti Ẹgbé Òṣèlú Àwọn Democrat

rows.source: "A vote for Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to reject the ruthless and outrageous tactics of the Democratic Party," Trump said at a rally in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: "Ìdìbò fún Alága Kavanaugh jẹ́ ìdìbò láti kọ́ ìwà ìkórìra àti ìwà ìkórìra ti Ẹgbẹ́ Ìjọpọ̀."
rows.reference: Ìbò kan fún Adájọ́ Kavanaugh jẹ́ ìbò kan láti kọ àwọn ètò agbékalẹ̀ aláìláàánú tí ó burú ti Ẹgbé Òṣèlú Àwọn Democrat,'' ni Trump sọ níbi ìpéjọpọ̀ kan ní Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: Trump said that Kavanaugh has "suffered the meanness, the anger" of the Democratic Party throughout his nomination process.
rows.output: Trump sọ pé Kavanaugh ti “ní ìrora, ìbínú” ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democratic Party nígbà gbogbo ìlana ìdìbò rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Trump sọpé Kavanaugh ti ''jìya ìkórìíra náà, ìbínú náà'' ti Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Àwọn Democrat nínú gbogbo ìgbésẹ̀ ìfanikalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ rẹ̀.

rows.source: Kavanaugh testified before Congress on Thursday, forcefully and emotionally denying an allegation from Christine Blasey Ford that he sexually assaulted her decades ago when they were teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh sọ̀rọ̀ níwọ̀n ìgbàtọ́ ní ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin ní ọjọ́ Tọ́kà, ó sì fi agbára àti ìmọ̀lára hàn pé ẹ̀sùn tí Christine Blasey Ford fi kan an pé ó fà á lọ́wọ́ ní ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún sẹ́yìn nígbà tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọ̀dọ́langba.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh jẹ́ ẹ̀rí niwaju Ìgbìmọ̀ lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀, pẹ̀lú ipá àti ìmọ̀lára tí ó sì ńṣẹ́ sí ẹ̀sùn kan láti ọwọ́ Christine Blasey Ford wípé ó kọlu òun nitori ìbálòpọ̀ ní awọn ọdún sẹ́yìn nígbàti àwọn jẹ́ màjèsín.

rows.source: Ford also testified at the hearing about her allegation.
rows.output: Ford tún jẹ́ ẹlérìjà nígbèyìn tó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀sùn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bákannáà ni Ford jẹ́ ẹ̀rí níbi ìgbẹ́jọ́ nípa ẹ̀sùn rẹ̀.

rows.source: The President said on Saturday that the "American people saw the brilliant and quality and courage" of Kavanaugh that day.
rows.output: Ààrẹ náà sọ ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta pé àwọn “àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà rí ìmúrasílẹ̀ àti ìmúrasílẹ̀ àti ìgboyà” Kavanaugh ní ọjọ́ yẹn.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ náà sọ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta pé ''Àwọn eniyan Amẹ́ríkà rí ọpọlọ pípé àti ìsọwọ́dára àti ìgboyà'' ti Kavanaugh lọ́jọ́ yẹn.

rows.source: "A vote to confirm Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to confirm one of the most accomplished legal minds of our time, a jurist with a sterling record of public service," he told the crowd of West Virginia supporters.
rows.output: "Ìdìbò láti jẹ́rìsí Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Kavanaugh jẹ́ ìdìbò láti jẹ́rìsí ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ọpọlọ ìdájọ́ tó ga jùlọ nínú àkókò wa, agbẹjọ́rò kan pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀n àṣeyọrí ìjìyà gbogbogbò."
rows.reference: ''Ìbò kan láti ṣàtìlẹ́yìn fún Adájọ́ Kavanaugh jẹ́ ìbò kan ṣàtìlẹ́yìn fún ọ̀kan ninu àwọn onímọ òfin tó ṣàṣeyọrí jùlọ ni àkokó wa, adájọ́ tí àkọsílẹ̀ ìsìnrú ìlú tó yanranntì,'' ní ó sọ fún ìpéjọpọ̀ àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn rẹ̀ ní West Virginia.

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to Kavanaugh's nomination while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Ààrẹ náà fi ẹ̀sùnlú kan hàn sí ìdìbò Kavanaugh nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìjìyà tí ó wà nínú ìdìbò àpérò.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ náà fi ìyapa kuro lọ́nà tí ó tọ́ tọ́kasí ìfanikalẹ fún iṣẹ́ Kavanaugh nigbati ó ńsọrọ nípa bí jíjáde síta àwọn ẹgbẹ́ Republican tiṣe pàtakì tó ninu àwọn ìdìbò ti ààrin-sáà.

rows.source: "Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: "Ìdá mẹ́wàá oṣù lọ́wọ́ ìdìbò tó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ nínú ìgbé ayé wa.
rows.reference: Ọ̀sẹ mẹ́fa lókù sí ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ìdìbò tóṣe pàtàkì jùlọ nínú àwọn àkóko ìgbésí-ayé wa.

rows.source: I'm not running, but I'm really running," he said.
rows.output: Mi ò ń sáré, ṣùgbọ́n mo ń sáré gan-an," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Emi ko díje, ṣùgbọn Mo ńdíje nítòótọ́,'' ni ó sọ.

rows.source: "That's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates."
rows.output: "Ìdí nìyí tí mo fi ń gbé gbogbo ibi tí mo bá ń jà fún àwọn olùdíje ńlá."
rows.reference: ''Ìdí nìyí tí Mo fi ńlọsí ibi gbogbo tí Mo sì ńjà fún àwọn olùdíje ńlá.''

rows.source: Trump argued that Democrats are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Trump jiyan pe awọn Democrats wa lori iṣẹ́ kan lati “resist ati idiwọ.”
rows.reference: Trump wí àwíjàre wípé àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrat wà nínú ìlépa láti ''dojúkọ̀ni àti láti dínilọ́wọ̀.''

rows.source: The first key procedural vote on the Senate floor on Kavanaugh's nomination is expected to take place no later than Friday, a senior GOP leadership aide has told CNN.
rows.output: Ìdìbò pàtàkì àkọ́kọ́ lórí ilẹ̀ Sínẹ́ǹtì lórí ìdìbò Kavanaugh ni a ń retí pé yóò wáyé ní àkókò tí ó pọ̀ ju ọjọ́ Jimọ́, ẹni tí ó ga jùlọ nínú ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican ti sọ fún CNN.
rows.reference: Ìbò oníìgbésẹ̀ tóṣe pàtàkì àkọ́kọ́ tí yóò wáyé nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà lórí ìfàkalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ Kavanaugh ni a réti lati waye nígbàtí kò gbọdọ̀ ju ọjọ́ Ẹtì lọ, ni olùránlọ́wọ́ fún adarí àgbà ti ẹgbẹ́ GOP kan sọ fún CNN.

rows.source: Hundreds killed by Indonesian quake, tsunami, with toll seen rising
rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún ni àwọn tí wọ́n pa ní ìbúgbàmù ilẹ̀ Indonesia, tsunami, pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀n tí a rí pé ó ń pọ̀ sí i.
rows.reference: Ọgọ-ọgọ́ọ̀rún eniyan ló kú nípaṣẹ̀ ilẹ̀ rírì, ìkún-omi tsunami ti ilẹ Indonesia, tí a sì ńríi pé iye náà sì ńga síi

rows.source: At least 384 people were killed, many swept away as giant waves crashed onto beaches, when a major earthquake and tsunami hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, authorities said on Saturday.
rows.output: O kere ju 384 eniyan ni o pa, ọpọlọpọ ninu wọn ni a fọwọkan bi awọn igbi nla ti kọlu etíkun, nigbati iwariri nla kan ati tsunami ba kọlu erekusu Sulawesi ti Indonesia, awọn alaṣẹ sọ ni Satidee.
rows.reference: Ó kéré tán eniyan irinwó-dínní-mẹ́rindínlógún ló kú, ọ̀pọ̀ nísàn omi gbé lọ bí ìjì ńlá ti kọlu àwọn etíkun. nigbati ilẹ̀ rírì púpọ̀ kan àti ìkún-omi tsunami kọlu erékùsù orilẹ-ede Indonesia ti Sulawesi, ni àwọn aláṣẹ sọ lọ́jọ́ Àbamẹ́ta.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a festival on the beach in the city of Palu on Friday when waves as high as six meters (18 feet) smashed onshore at dusk, sweeping many to their deaths and destroying anything in their path.
rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn ènìyàn ni wọ́n ti péjọ fún ayẹyẹ kan ní etíkun ìlú Palu ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ nígbà tí ìjì líle tó ga tó mítà mẹ́fà (ìwọ̀n ẹsẹ̀ méjìdínlógún) ti fọ́ sí etíkun ní ìsálẹ̀ ọ̀sán, tí ó sì fọ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn lulẹ̀ tí ó sì bàjẹ́ ohun gbogbo tí ó wà ní ọ̀nà rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ọgọ-ọgọ́ọ̀rún eniyan niwọń tipéjọ fun àjọ̀dún kan ní etíkun ti ìlú Palu lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì nigbati àwọn ìjì òkun tóga tó ìwọ̀n mítà mẹ́fà (ẹsẹ̀ bàtà 18) fagbára wólulẹ̀ létíkun ní àásálẹ́, tí wọ́n sì gba ọ̀pọ̀ lọ sínú ikú wọn tí wọ́n sì pa ohunkóhun tówà ní ipa ọ̀nà wọn.

rows.source: The tsunami followed a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
rows.output: Ìjì líle náà tẹ̀lé ìkùukùu 7.5.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà tẹ̀lé ilẹ̀ rírì oníwọ̀n agbara 7.5 kan.

rows.source: "When the tsunami threat arose yesterday, people were still doing their activities on the beach and did not immediately run and they became victims," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, the spokesman for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency BNPB said in a briefing in Jakarta.
rows.output: "Nígbà tí ìhalẹ̀ tsunami ti wáyé lana, àwọn ènìyàn ṣì ń ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn ní etíkun tí wọ́n kò sì sáré lọ́wọ́ lọ́wọ́ tí wọ́n sì di àwọn olùfarapa," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún ilé-iṣẹ́ ìdènà ìjàm̀bá orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia BNPB sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní Jakarta.
rows.reference: ''Nigbati ìdúnkoòkò tsunami náà dìde ní àná, àwọn eniyan sì ńṣe iṣẹ́ wọn létíkun tíwọn kòsì sá kuro lójú-ẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì di ẹniti o farakó-áásá,'' ni Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ tó ńrísí díndín ewu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù kù lorilẹ-ede Indonesia BNPB sọ nínú ìfitónilétí kan Jarkata.

rows.source: "The tsunami didn't come by itself, it dragged cars, logs, houses, it hit everything on land," Nugroho said, adding that the tsunami had traveled across the open sea at speeds of 800 kph (497 mph) before striking the shoreline.
rows.output: "Ìjì líle náà kò wá níbìkan, ó mú àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀," Nugroho sọ pé, ó fi kún un pé ìjì líle náà ti rin ìrìn àjò lórí òkun ṣíṣe ní iyara 800 km/h (497 mph) kí ó tó kọlu etíkun.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà kòwá nípa ara rẹ̀, ó wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀,'' ni Nugroho sọ, tí ó sì fikún un pé ìkún-omi tsunami náà ti rin ìrìn-àjò kọjá gbangba òkun ní àwọn ìwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́sáré kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀jọ̀ ní wákàtí kan (máìlí 497 ní wákàtí kan) kí ó tó kọlu bèbè òkun.

rows.source: Some people climbed trees to escape the tsunami and survived, he said.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn kan gun igi láti sá lọ kúrò nínú ìkún omi náà, ó sì wà láàyè.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan kan gun igi láti sá àsálà kuro lọ́wọ́ ìkún omi tsunami náà tí wọ́n sì yè, ni ó sọ.

rows.source: Around 16,700 people were evacuated to 24 centers in Palu.
rows.output: Ní àgbègbè 16,700 ènìyàn ni wọ́n gbé lọ sí àwọn ibi ìgbèkùlé 24 ní Palu.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan bíi ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́tadínlógúndín-lọ́ọ̀dún ni wọn yára gbélọ sí àwọn ibùdó ní Palu.

rows.source: Aerial photographs released by the disaster agency showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges twisted and collapsed and a mosque surrounded by water.
rows.output: Àwọn fọ́tò afẹ́fẹ́ tí ilé iṣẹ́ ìṣípayá ti ṣí sílẹ̀ fi hàn pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé àti ilé ìtajà ti bàjẹ́, àwọn afara ti yí padà àti ti ṣubú, àti mọ́ṣáláṣí kan tí omi yí ká.
rows.reference: Àwọn fọ́tò àtòkèya tí àjọ tó ńrísí ìṣẹ̀lẹ àjálù náà gbéjáde fi ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ilé àti àwọn sọ́ọ̀bù tí o ti bàjẹ́, àwọn afárá tí ó ti wọ́ tí ó sì wọ́ lulẹ̀ àti mọ́sálásí kan tí omi ti yípo.

rows.source: Aftershocks continued to rock the coastal city on Saturday.
rows.output: Àwọn ìjì líle ń bá ìlú etíkun náà jẹ́ ní ọjọ́ Satide.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìmìtìtì-ilẹ̀ tẹ̀síwájú láti máa mú ìlú ẹ̀bá òkun náà rọ́kẹ̀kẹ̀ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.source: The series of earthquakes were felt in an area with 2.4 million people.
rows.output: Àwọn ìṣàn omi náà ni a rí ní àgbègbè tí ó ní ènìyàn 2.4 mílíọ̀nù.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilẹ̀ rírì oní-ṣiṣẹ̀-ń-tẹ̀lé náà ní wọ́n mọ̀lára ní agbègbe kan tóní mílíọ̀nù méjí àti irinwó eniyan.

rows.source: Indonesia's Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in statement the energy released by Friday's massive quake was around 200 times the power of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War Two.
rows.output: Ìjọbá fún Àyèwọ̀ àti Ìmúlò Ìmọ̀ Ẹ̀rọ (BPPT) ti Indonesia sọ pé ìmúra agbára tí ìkún omi ńlá náà ṣe ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ jẹ́ tó 200 ìgbà agbára bọmbù àtòmíkì tí wọ́n ju sí Hiroshima nígbá Ogun Àgbáyé Kejì.
rows.reference: Àjọ tó Ńse Àgbéléwọ̀n àti Ìsàmúlò Ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ ti ilẹ̀ Indonesia (BPPT) sọ ninu gbólóhùn wipe agbára tí ọ̀pọ̀ ilẹ̀-rírì ọjọ́ Ẹtì náà tú síta tó bíi i̇̀lopọ̀ igba ti àdó-olóró tí wọ́n jù sórí ìlú Hiroshima nigba Ogun Àgbáyé Kejì.

rows.source: The geography of the city, which sits at the end of a long, narrow bay, could have magnified the size of the tsunami, it said.
rows.output: Ìṣirò ìlú náà, tí ó wà ní òpin òkun tí ó gùn jù, lè ti pọ̀ sí i ní ìwọ̀n ìkún omi, ó sì sọ.
rows.reference: Ìṣẹ̀dá orí-ilẹ̀ ìlú náà, eyiti ó jókòó sí òpin ilẹ̀ tówọnú òkun, gíguǹ kan, leè ti mú ìwọ̀n ìkún-omi tsunami náà gbòòrò síi, ní ó wí.

rows.source: Nugroho described the damage as "extensive" and said thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels had collapsed.
rows.output: Nugroho ṣe apejuwe ibajẹ naa gẹgẹbi “to gaju” o si sọ pe ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun awọn ile, awọn ile-iwosan, awọn ile itaja, ati awọn hotẹẹli ti ṣubu.
rows.reference: Nugroho ṣàpèjúwe ìdibàjẹ́ náà bíi eyiti ''ó kọjá ààlà'' tí ó sì sọpé ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ̀rún àwọn ilé, àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn, àwọn ilé ìtaja ńlá àti àwọn ilé-ìtura niwọ́n ti wó lulẹ̀.

rows.source: Bodies of some victims were found trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings, he said, adding 540 people were injured and 29 were missing.
rows.output: Àwọn ara àwọn olùfarapa kan ni a rí pé wọ́n wà lábẹ́ ìpìlẹ̀ àwọn ilé tí wọ́n ti ṣubú, ó sọ pé, ó fi kun pé 540 ènìyàn farapa àti 29 sì sọnù.
rows.reference: Àwọn àgọ́-ara ti àwọn tó farakó-áásá niwọ́n rí lábẹ́ àlàpà àwọn ilé tówó lulẹ̀, ní ó sọ, tí ó sì fi kún un pé ẹgbẹ̀tadínlọ́gọ́tá eniyan ló farapa tí ọ̀kaǹdińlọ́gbọ̀n sì ṣọnù.

rows.source: Nugroho said the casualties and the damage could be greater along the coastline 300 km (190 miles) north of Palu, an area called Donggala, which is closer to the epicenter of the quake.
rows.output: Nugroho sọ pé àwọn ìṣòro àti ìbàjẹ́ náà lè pọ̀ sí i ní etíkun, tó jẹ́ 300 km (190 miles) ní ìhà àríwá Palu, àgbègbè kan tí a ń pè ní Donggala, tó sì jìnnà sí àárín ìbúgbàmù náà.
rows.reference: Nugroho sọpé àwọn tó farakó áásá àti ìdibàjẹ́ náà leè pọ̀jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ ní àwọn bèbè òkun  kílòmìtà 300 (máìlì 190) àríwá ti Palu, agbègbe kan tíwọn ńpè ní Donggala, eyiti ó súnmọ́ ààrin gungun agbára ilẹ̀ rírì náà.

rows.source: Communications "were totally crippled with no information" from Donggala, Nugroho said.
rows.output: Ìbáraẹnisọ̀rọ̀ “pàtàkì” ni wọ́n ṣe pẹ̀lú ìsọfọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́fọ́f
rows.reference: Àwọn ìkànsíra-ẹni ni ''di àrọ aláìlẹ́sẹ̀ pátápátá láìsì ìròyìn kankan'' láti Donggala, ni Nugroho sọ.

rows.source: There are more than 300,000 people living there," the Red Cross said in a statement, adding that its staff and volunteers were heading to the affected areas.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn tó ju 300,000 lọ ni wọ́n ń gbé níbẹ̀, ni ìsọfọ́fọ́ àwọn agbègbè tí wọ́n ń ṣe, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àti àwọn olùfọkànsìn wa ń lọ síbẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó lé ni ẹgbẹ̀run lọ́nà ọ̀ọ́dún àwọn eniyan tó ńgbé níbẹ̀, ni Ẹgbẹ́ Aláàgbéléèbú Pupa sọ ninu gbólóhùn kan, tí wọn sì fi kún un pe àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wọn àti awọn tó yọ̀ǹda ara wọn fún iṣẹ́ niwọ́n ti ńlọ sí àwọn agbègbe tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ti wáyé.

rows.source: "This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse," it said.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn ni ìbànújẹ́ báyìí, ṣùgbọ́n ó lè burú si."
rows.reference: ''Èyí ti di ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù buburú kan, ṣùgbọ́n o leè tún burú síwájú síi,'' ni o wí.

rows.source: The agency on Saturday was widely criticized for not informing that a tsunami had hit Palu, though officials said waves had come within the time the warning was issued.
rows.output: Ìjọ náà ni ọjọ́ Sátidé ni wọ́n ti ṣàtakò fún pé kò sọ fún àwọn ènìyàn pé ìjì líle kan ti kọlu Palu, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà sọ pé àwọn ìjì líle ti dé ní àkókò tí wọ́n ti gbé ìkìlọ̀ jáde.
rows.reference: Àjọ náà ni ọ̀pọ̀ bu ẹnu àtẹ́ lù lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta nitoripe kò fitó àwọn eniyan létí pe ìkún-omi tsunami ti kọlu Palu, botilẹjẹpe àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ sọpé àwọn ìjì òkun ti dé láàrin àkókò náà tí wọ́n ṣe àgbéjáde ìkìlọ̀ náà.

rows.source: In amateur footage shared on social media a man on the upper floor of a building can be heard shouting frantic warnings of the approaching tsunami to people on the street below.
rows.output: Ni fidio alafaramo ti a pin lori media awujọ, ọkunrin kan lori ilẹ oke ti ile kan le gbọ ti n pariwo ni iyara awọn ikilọ ti tsunami ti n bọ si awọn eniyan ni opopona ni isalẹ.
rows.reference: Nínú àwòrán fídíò tí kìí ṣe ti akọṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ tíwọn pín lórì ojú-òpò ìbáṣepọ̀ ti ayelujara ni eniyan ti leè gbọ́ ti ọkùnrin kan tówà ní àjà òkè ilé kan ti ńpariwo ìkìlọ̀ nípa ti ìkún-omi tsunami tó ńbọ̀ sí àwọn eniyan tówà ní òpópóna nísàlẹ̀.

rows.source: Within minutes a wall of water crashes onto the shore, carrying away buildings and cars.
rows.output: Ní ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀, òkùnkùn omi kan ń fọ́ sí etíkun, tí ń gbé àwọn ilé àti àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ lọ.
rows.reference: Láàrin àwọn ìṣẹ́jú ògiri omi kan wó sí bèbè òkun náà, tí ó sì ńgbé àwọn ilé àti àwọn ọkọ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ lọ.

rows.source: Reuters was not able to immediately authenticate the footage.
rows.output: Reuters kò lè dáwọ́ dọ́gba fídíò náà ní kíákíá.
rows.reference: Reuters kò leè fi ìdí àwòrán fídíò náà múlẹ̀ lójú-ẹṣẹ̀ wípé ó jẹ òtítọ́.

rows.source: The quake and tsunami caused a major power outage that cut communications around Palu making it difficult for authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.
rows.output: Ìjì líle àti ìjì líle náà fa ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí ó fà ìjì líle tí
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ rírì àti ìkún-omi tsunami ṣe okùnfà àìsí iná mànàmáná eyiti ó gé àwọn okùn ìkànsí-ara-ẹni ní àyíká ìlú Palu tí ó sì jẹ́kí ó ṣòro fun àwọn aláṣẹ lati darí àwọn igbiyanju fún ìdóòlà-ẹ̀mí àwọn eniyan.

rows.source: The military has started sending in cargo planes with aid from Jakarta and other cities, authorities said, but evacuees still badly need food and other basic necessities.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í fi àwọn ọkọ̀ òfurufú ọkọ̀ ojú omi tí wọ́n fi àwọn ohun èlò ìrànwọ́ láti Jakarta àti àwọn ìlú mìíràn ránṣẹ́ sí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn aláṣẹ ṣe sọ, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn tí wọ́n ti gbé kúrò níbè ṣi nílò oúnjẹ àti àwọn ohun èlò pàtàkì mìíràn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ológun ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí fi àwọn ọkọ̀ òfurufú akẹ́rù ránṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìrànwọ́ lati Jarkata àti àwọn ìlú miran, ni àwọn aláṣẹ sọ, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn eniyan tíwọn sáré gbé kúro níbí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà sì nílò oúnjẹ àti àwọn ohun tójẹ́ dandan miran.

rows.source: The city's airport has been reopened only for relief efforts and will remain closed until Oct.
rows.output: Ìbúgbàmù ìlú náà ti ṣí sílẹ̀ nígbèkùgbè fún ìgbèjà, yóò sì wà ní ìpamọ́ títí di October.
rows.reference: Ibùdókọ̀ ọkọ̀ òfurufú ti ìlu náà ni wọ́n ti tún sí padà fún àwọn iṣẹ́ ìtura nìkan tí yóò sì wà ní títìpa títí di oṣù Ọ̀wàrà.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit evacuation centers in Palu on Sunday.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Joko Widodo ti ṣètò láti ṣèbàá sí àwọn ibi ìgbèjà ní Palu ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Joko Widodo ni wọ́n ti ṣààtò rẹ̀ láti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí àwọn ibùdó tí àwọn tíwọn gbé kuro níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami Toll Soars Above 800.
rows.output: Ìṣàn omi tsunami ní Indonesia ti pọ̀ sí i ju 800 lọ.
rows.reference: Iye eniyan tóku nínu Ìkún-omi Tsunami ti Indonesia ti fò sòke ju ẹ̣gbẹ̀rin lọ

rows.source: It Is Very Bad.
rows.output: Ó burú jù.
rows.reference: Ó burú púpọ̀

rows.source: While World Vision's staff from Donggala have made it safely to Palu city, where employees are sheltering in tarpaulin shelters set up in the courtyard of their office, they passed scenes of devastation on the way, Mr. Doseba said.
rows.output: Lakoko ti o jẹ pe oṣiṣẹ́ Agbaye Wiwo lati Donggala ti de lailewu si ilu Palu, nibiti awọn oṣiṣẹ ti n sinmi ni awọn ibi aabo ti a fi tarpaulin ṣe ni ile-iṣẹ wọn, wọn kọja awọn iṣẹlẹ iparun ni ọna, Ọgbẹni Doseba sọ.
rows.reference: Nigbati àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ World Vision láti Donggala ti dé ìlú Palu lálàáfía, níbití àwọn abániṣiṣẹ́ tí ńgbé nínú àwọn àgọ́ oní-tapóólì tí wọn ṣe àtòpọ̀ rẹ̀ ninu ọgbà ọ́fíìsì wọn, wọ́n gba àwọn ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù náà kọjá lójú ọ̀nà, ni Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Doseba sọ.

rows.source: "They told me they saw lots of houses that were destroyed," he said.
rows.output: Wọ́n sọ fún mi pé wọ́n rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé tí wọ́n ti bàjẹ́.
rows.reference: ''Wọ́n sọ fuńmi wipe àwọn rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ilé tí wọn ti parun, ni ó wí.

rows.source: It is very bad.
rows.output: Ó burú jù.
rows.reference: Ó burú púpọ̀ ju.

rows.source: Even as aid groups began the grim motions of starting the gears of disaster relief, some complained that foreign aid workers with deep expertise were being prevented from traveling to Palu.
rows.output: Lakoko ti awọn ẹgbẹ alaanu bẹrẹ awọn iṣẹ ti o ni ibanujẹ ti ṣiṣe awọn ẹrọ ti iderun ajalu, diẹ ninu awọn kan pe awọn oṣiṣẹ iranlọwọ ajeji ti o ni imọran jinlẹ ni a dènà lati rin irin-ajo lọ si Palu.
rows.reference: Àní bí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ onírànlọ́wọ́ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ìrìn àìsinmi fún bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ láti pèsè ìtura fún àjálù, àwọn kan fẹ̀sùn kan pé wọ́n dínà mọ́ àwọn oníṣẹ́ ìrànwọ́ láti ilẹ̀-òkèèrè láti máṣe rin ìrìn-àjò sí Palu.

rows.source: According to Indonesian regulations, funding, supplies and staffing from overseas can only start flowing if the site of a calamity is declared a national disaster zone.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ìlànà ìlà oòrùn Indonesia, ìnáwọ́, ohun èlò, àti ìṣíṣẹ́ láti ilẹ̀ òkèèrè lè bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ṣàn nìkan tí a bá kéde ibi ìbànújẹ́ kan sí agbègbè ìṣòro orílẹ̀-èdè.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn òfin ilẹ̀ Indonesia ti wí, fífúnnilówó, àwọn ìpèsè àti fífúnnilóṣìṣẹ́ láti òkè-òkun leè bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí wọlé nìkan bí wọ́n bá kéde ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kan bíi agbègbè ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù ti orilẹ-ede.

rows.source: That has not happened yet.
rows.output: Ó ṣẹlẹ̀ síbè.
rows.reference: Síbẹ̀ èyí kò tìí ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.source: "It's still a province level disaster," said Aulia Arriani, a spokesperson for the Indonesian Red Cross.
rows.output: "Ó ṣì jẹ́ ìṣòro ìjọba ìpínlẹ̀ kan," ni Aulia Arriani, agbẹnusọ fún Ìgbìmọ̀ Pupa Ìdánilójú ti Indonesia.
rows.reference: ''Ó sí jẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù onípele tí ẹkùn kan síbẹ̀,'' ni Aulia Arriani, agbẹnusọ kan fún Ẹgbẹ́ Aláàgbéléèbú Pupa ti Indonesia ni o so bẹẹ̣.

rows.source: "Once the government says, "O.K., this is a national disaster," we can open for international assistance but there's no status yet."
rows.output: "Ni kété ti ijọba ba sọ pé, "O.K., eyi jẹ́ ìṣòro orílẹ̀-èdè," a lè ṣí sílẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ àgbáyé ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ipò sibẹsibẹ."
rows.reference: ''Ní kété tí ìjọba bá sọpé, ''Ó dára, èyí jẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lù àjálù ti orilẹ-ede kan,'' a leè sílẹ̀kùn sílẹ̀ fún ìrànwọ́ àgbáyé ṣùgbọ́n kò tìí sí irú ipò yẹn síbẹ̀.

rows.source: As the second night fell on Palu after Friday's earthquake and tsunami, friends and family of those still missing were holding out hope that their loved ones would be the miracles that leaven the bleak story lines of natural disasters.
rows.output: Ni alẹ kejì tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ sí Palu lẹ́yìn ìjì líle náà ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ àti ìkún omi, àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ àti ẹbí àwọn tí wọ́n ṣì wà nípamọ́ ń retí pé àwọn olólùfẹ́ wọn yóò jẹ́ àwọn ìyàlẹ́nu tí yóò mú ìtànkálẹ̀ ìtànkálẹ̀ ìṣọ̀wọ́wọ́ tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ìṣọ̀wọ́wọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Bí alẹ́ ọjọ́ kejì  ti ńlẹ́ ní Palu lẹ́yìn ilẹ̀ rírì àti ìkún-omi tsunami ti ọjọ́ Ẹtì, àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ ati ìdílé àwọn tí  ó ṣọnù sì ńní ìrèti wipe àwọn olùfẹ́ wọn yóò jẹ́ àwọn iṣẹ́ ìyanu náà tí ó leè wú àkàrà àwọn ìlà ìtàn aláìnírètí ti àwọn iṣ̵ẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù àtọ̀runwá náà.

rows.source: On Saturday, a little boy was plucked from a sewer.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ Aiku, ọmọ kékeré kan ni a yọ kúrò nínú ihò ìkùukùu.
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, wọ́n fa ọmọkùnrin kékeré kan yọ jáde láti inú egboro tó ńgbé ìgbọ̀nṣẹ̀ kan.

rows.source: On Sunday, rescuers freed a woman who had been pinned under rubble for two days with the body of her mother next to her.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ Aiku, àwọn olùgbèjà ti dá obìnrin kan tí ó ti wà lábẹ́ ìdọ̀tí fún ọjọ́ méjì pẹ̀lú ara ìyá rẹ̀ lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, àwọn adóòlà-ẹ̀mí yọ obìnrin kan ti ògiri àlàpà ti mú mọ́lẹ̀ sábẹ́ fún ọjọ́ méjì pẹ̀lú àgọ́-ara ìyá rẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀gbẹ́ rẹ̀

rows.source: Gendon Subandono, the coach of the Indonesian national paragliding team, had trained two of the missing paragliders for the Asian Games, which wrapped up earlier this month in Indonesia.
rows.output: Gendon Subandono, olùkópa ẹgbẹ́ agbábọ́ọ̀lù orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia, ti kọ́ àwọn olùgbèjà méjì tí wọ́n sọnù fún àwọn ìdíje Àṣíá, èyí tí ó parí ní oṣù yìí ní Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, akọ́nilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti àwọn ikọ̀ tó ńlo àpò-alátẹ́gùn lórí omi ti orilẹ-ede Indonesia, ti kọ́ méjì ninu awọn tó ńlo àpò-alátẹgùn náà tó ṣọnù fún Àwọn Ìdíje Asia, eyiti wọ́n parí ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù yìí ní Indonesia.

rows.source: Others of those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel, Mr. Mandagi included, were his students.
rows.output: Àwọn mìíràn tí wọ́n wà nínú ìdènà ní ilé ìtàjà Roa Roa, Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mandagi sì wà lára ​​wọ́n, ni àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn miran ninu àwọn tó bọ́há sínú Ilé Ìtura Roa Roa, tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mandagi wà ninu wọn, jé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀.

rows.source: "As a senior in the paragliding field, I have my own emotional burden," he said.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tó ti pé ọmúdàgbà nínú pápá ìfọ́kànsí, mo ní ẹ̀rù ọkàn ti ara mi.
rows.reference: ó wipe ''Gẹ́gẹ́bí ọ̀gá kan nínú iṣẹ́ lílo àpò alátẹ́gùn lórí omi, Mo ní ẹrù ìmọ̀lára tèmi''́.

rows.source: Mr. Gendon recounted how, in the hours after the news of the Roa Roa Hotel collapse circulated among the paragliding community, he had desperately sent WhatsApp messages to the Palu competitors, who were taking part in the beach festival.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Gendon sọ̀rọ̀ nípa bí, ní àwọn wákàtí lẹ́yìn tí ìroyìn ìparun ilé ìtaja Roa Roa ti tan kaakiri láàárín àwùjọ paragliding, ó ti ń fi àwọn ìfiranṣẹ́ WhatsApp ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn olùdíje Palu, tí wọ́n ń kópa nínú ayẹyẹ etíkun.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Gendon tún sọ bí, ninu àwọn wákàtí lẹ́yìn ti ìròyìn ìwólulẹ̀ Ilé Ìtura Roa Roa tàn kalẹ̀ láàrin àwùjọ àwọn tó ńlo àpò alátẹ́gùn lórí omi, òun ti sáré rán àwọn àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ WhatsApp sí àwọn olùdíje Palu, tí wọ́n ńkópa ninu àjọ̀dún etíkun náà.

rows.source: His messages, though, only resulted in one gray check mark, rather than a pair of blue checks.
rows.output: Ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò rẹ̀, bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé, kò mú kí ó ní àmì àwọ̀ ewé, ṣùgbọ́n àmì àwọ̀ grẹ́yì kan.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe, àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ rẹ̀, kàn yọrísí àmì ìṣàmi aláwọ̀ eérú kan, dípò àwọn ìṣàmì aláwọ̀ aró oníbejì kan.

rows.source: "I think that means the messages were not delivered," he said.
rows.output: "Mo lérò pé ó túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ náà kò dé," ni ó sọ.
rows.reference: Mó ròpé ìyẹn túmọ̀sí pé àwọn ìfirańṣẹ́ náà ni wọn kò fi jíṣẹ́,'' ni ó sọ.

rows.source: Thieves take $26,750 during ATM refill at Newport on the Levee
rows.output: Àwọn olè jí $26,750 nígbà tí wọ́n ń tún ATM ṣe ní Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Àwọn olè gba ẹgbẹ́rùn lọ́nà mẹ́rìndínlọ́gbọ̀n àti ẹgbẹ̀rindínláàádọ́ta dọ́là níbití wọ́n ti ńkówósí inú ẹ̀rọ pọwọ́-pọwọ́ ATM ní Newport lórí Levee

rows.source: Thieves on Friday morning stole $26,750 from a Brink's worker refilling an ATM at Newport on the Levee, according to a news release from the Newport Police Department.
rows.output: Àwọn olè ní ọjọ́ Friday ní wọ́n jí $26,750 lọ́wọ́ òṣìṣẹ́ Brink's tó ń tún ATM ṣe ní Newport on the Levee, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtànkálẹ̀ ìròyìn láti ọ́fíìsì ọlọ́pàá Newport.
rows.reference: Àwọn olè ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ẹti gba ẹgbẹ́rùn lọ́nà mẹ́rìndínlọ́gbọ̀n àti ẹgbẹ̀rindínláàádọ́ta dọ́là lọ́wọ́ òṣìṣẹ́ Brink kan tó ńkówó sínú ẹ̀rọ pọwó-pọwó ATM ní Newport lórí Levee, gẹ́gẹ́bí àgbéjáde ìròyìn kan láti Ẹ̀ka Ilé iṣẹ́ Ọlọ́ọ̀pá Newport.

rows.source: The car's driver had been emptying an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deliver more money, Det. Dennis McCarthy wrote in the release.
rows.output: Awakọ ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ naa ti n ṣe awọn iṣẹlẹ ti o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o jẹ ki o
rows.reference: Awạko ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ náà ti ńjẹ́kí ẹ̀rọ pọwó-pọwó náà sófo ninu ilé ìdánilárayá ńlá náà tí ó sì ńgbaradì láti kó owó púpọ̀ síi, ni Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ Dennis McCarthy kọ sínú àgbéjáde náà.

rows.source: While he was occupied, another man "ran up from behind the Brink's employee" and stole a bag of money meant for delivery.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó ń ṣe iṣẹ́ náà, ọkùnrin mìíràn “gun wá láti ẹ̀yìn òṣìṣẹ́ Brink” ó sì jí àpò owó tí wọ́n ń fi ránṣẹ́ lọ.
rows.reference: Níbití ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ti kún fún iṣẹ́, ọkùnrin miran ''sáré gòkè láti ẹ̀yìn òṣìṣẹ́ Brink náà'' tí ó sì jí àpò owó kan tí ó wà fún ìfijíṣẹ́ gbé.

rows.source: Witnesses spotted multiple suspects fleeing the scene, according to the release, but police did not specify the number involved in the incident.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹlẹ́rìndò náà rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn afurasi tí wọ́n ń sá lọ láti ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtúsílẹ̀ náà ti sọ, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọlọ́pàá kò sọ ìwọ̀n àwọn tó kópa nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹlẹ́ẹ̀rí rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn afurasí tíwọn ńsá kúrò níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, gẹ́gẹ́bí àgbéjadé náà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá kò sọní pàtó iye àwọn tíwọ́n kópa ninu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: Anyone with information about their identities should contact Newport police at 859-292-3680.
rows.output: Ẹnikẹni ti o ni alaye nipa idanimọ wọn yẹ ki o kan si awọn ọlọpa Newport ni 859-292-3680.
rows.reference: Ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bání ìwífúnni nípa àwọn ìdánimọ̀ wọn kí ó kàn sí àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá Newport ní 859-292-3680.

rows.source: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye
rows.output: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye
rows.reference: Kanye West: Akọrinbíẹnití-ńsọ̀rọ̀ yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padá sí Ye

rows.source: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.
rows.output: Olórin Kanye West ń yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà - sí Ye.
rows.reference: Akọrinbíẹnití-ńsọ̀rọ̀ Kanye West ńyí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà - sí Ye.

rows.source: Announcing the change on Twitter on Saturday, he wrote: "The being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Ìkede ìyípadà náà lórí Twitter ní ọjọ́ Satide, ó kọ: "Ẹni tí a mọ̀ sí Kanye West."
rows.reference: Bóti ńkéde ìyípadà náà lórí Twitter lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ó kọ̀wé: ''Ẹni náà tí a mọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ nípa ti iṣẹ́ bíi Kanye West.''

rows.source: West, 41, has been nicknamed Ye for some time and used the moniker as the title for his eighth album, which was released in June.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀, 41, ni wọ́n ti ń pè ní Ye fún ìgbà díẹ̀ báyìí, ó sì lo orúkọ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí akọle fún àlbum kẹjì, tí wọ́n ṣe ní Okudu.
rows.reference: West, ẹni ọdún mẹ́rinlélógójì, ni wọ́n ti sọ ní orúkọ ìnagijẹ Ye fún àwọn àkókò kan tí ó sì lo orúkọ àpèjẹ́ náà bíi àkọlé fún àwo orin ìkẹjọ rẹ̀, eyiti ó gbéjáde ninu oṣù Òkúdu.

rows.source: The change comes ahead of his appearance on Saturday Night Live, where he is expected to launch his new album Yandhi.
rows.output: Ìyípadà náà ń bọ̀ ṣáájú ìfarahàn rẹ̀ ní Saturday Night Live, níbi tí a ti ń retí láti ṣètò àlbum tuntun rẹ̀ Yandhi.
rows.reference: Àyípadà náà wáyé saájú ìfarahàn rẹ̀ lórí Saturday Night Live, níbití wọ́n ti ńreti rẹ̀ láti fi àwo orin rẹ̀ tuntun Yandhi lọ́lẹ̀.

rows.source: He replaces singer Ariana Grande on the show who cancelled for "emotional reasons," the show's creator said.
rows.output: Ó rọ́pò akọrin Ariana Grande lórí eré náà tí ó fà sọ́dọ̀ “àwọn ìdí ìmọ̀lára,” gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùdásílẹ̀ eré náà ti sọ.
rows.reference: Ó ńrọ́pò akọrin Ariana Grande lórí ètò náà ẹniti ó fagilé e fún ''àwọn ìdí ìmọ̀lára,'' ni aṣẹ̀dá ètò náà sọ.

rows.source: As well as being an abbreviation of his current professional name, West has previously said the word has religious significance for him.
rows.output: Pẹlupẹlu, bi akọtọ ti orúkọ ọjọgbọn rẹ lọwọlọwọ, West ti sọ pe ọrọ naa ni pataki ẹ̀sìn fun u.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú wípé ó jẹ́ ìkékúrú ti orúkọ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ rẹ̀ tó ńlò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, West ti sọ saájú wípé ọ̀rọ̀ náà  ní ìṣepàtàkì nípa ti ẹsìn fún òun

rows.source: "I believe 'ye' is the most commonly used word in the Bible, and in the Bible it means 'you,'" West said earlier this year, discussing his album title with radio host Big Boy.
rows.output: Mo gbà pé “ìwọ” ni ọ̀rọ̀ tí a máa ń lò jùlọ nínú Bíbélì, àti nínú Bíbélì, ó túmọ̀ sí “ìwọ,” ni West sọ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí, nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa akọle rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Big Boy.
rows.reference: ''Mo gbàgbọ́ pe 'ye' ni ọ̀rọ̀ náà tí́ a lò tí o ́wọ́pò jùlọ nínú Bíbélì, àtipé nínú Bíbélì ó túmọ̀ sí 'ìwọ,''' ni West sọ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí, nígbàtí ó ńsọ̀rọ̀ nípa àkọlé àwo orin rè pẹ̀lú olùgbàlejò rédíò Big Boy.

rows.source: "So I'm you, I'm us, it's us.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, èmi ni ọ, èmi ni wa, ó jẹ́ wa.
rows.reference: ''Nítorínáà Èmi ni ìwọ, Èmi ni àwa, òhun ni àwa.

rows.source: It went from Kanye, which means the only one, to just Ye - just being a reflection of our good, our bad, our confused, everything.
rows.output: Ó yí padà láti Kanye, èyí tó túmọ̀ sí ẹni nìkan, sí Ye nìkan - sí ìmúrasílẹ̀ wa tó dára, tó burú, tó yípadà, ohun gbogbo.
rows.reference: Ó lọ láti Kanye, tí ó túmọ̀ sí ọ̀kan ṣoṣo náà, sí Ye nìkan - nìkan jẹ́ àwòrán ti ire wa, ti ìpòrúùru  wa, ohun gbogbo.

rows.source: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."
rows.output: Àlbum náà jẹ́ ìfihàn ìdánimọ̀ wa.
rows.reference: Àwo orin náà lọ́pọ̀lọ́pọ̀ jẹ́ àwòrán ẹnití a jẹ́.''

rows.source: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn akọrin tó gbajúmọ̀ tó ti yí orúkọ wọn padà.
rows.reference: Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú òǹka àwọn akọrinbíẹnití-ńsọ̀rọ̀ tó yí orúkọ wọn padà.

rows.source: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.
rows.output: Sean Combs ti wa ni a mọ̀ si Puff Daddy, P. Diddy tàbí Diddy, ṣùgbọ́n ní ọdún yìí, ó kéde ìfẹ́ rẹ̀ fún orúkọ Love àti Brother Love.
rows.reference: Sean Combs ni wọń ti mọ lóríṣiríṣi ọ̀nà bíi Puff Daddy, P. Diddy tàbí Diddy, ṣùgbọn lọ́dún yìí kéde ìfẹ́ tóga jùlọ rẹ̀ fún àwọn orúkọ Love and Brother Love.

rows.source: A former West collaborator, JAY-Z, has also made do with or without a hyphen and capitals.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó ti ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀ oòrùn, JAY-Z, tún ti ṣe pẹ̀lú tàbí láìsí àmì ìdánilójú àti àwọn lẹ́tà ńlá.
rows.reference: Abániṣàjọṣepọ̀ West kan tẹ́lẹ̀rí, JAY-Z, bákannáà ti ṣe nǹkan rí pẹ̀lú tàbi láìsí àmì ìdánudúró láàrin àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ kan àti àwọn álífábẹ̵́ẹ̀tì ńlá.

rows.source: Mexico's AMLO vows not to use military against civilians
rows.output: Ìdánilójú Mexico's AMLO láti má lo ológun lòdì sí àwọn aráàlú
rows.reference: AMLO ti Mẹ́ṣíkò jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ̵́ láti máṣe lo àwọn ọmọ ogun lòdì sí àwọn ara ìlú.

rows.source: Mexican President-elect Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has vowed to never use military force against civilians as the country approaches the 50th anniversary of a bloody reprisal against students.
rows.output: Ààrẹ orílẹ̀-èdè Mẹ́xíkò tí ń bọ̀, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, ti ṣe ìpè láti má lo agbára ológun lòdì sí àwọn aráàlú bí orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣe ń súnmọ́ ọdún 50th tí ìbínú kan ṣẹlẹ̀ sí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ-tíwọnṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀-dìbòyàn ti orilẹ-ede Mẹ́ṣíkò Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ti jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ́ láti máṣe lo àwọn ọmọ ogun lòdì sí àwọn ara ìlú láíláí bí orilẹ-ede náà ti ńsúnmọ́ ayẹyẹ àjọ̀dún àádọ́tá ti ìgbẹ̀san òdì sí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan nínú eyiti ẹ̀jẹ̀ ti sàn.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador promised Saturday at Tlatelolco Plaza to "never ever use the military to repress the Mexican people."
rows.output: Lopez Obrador ṣe ileri ni Satidee ni Tlatelolco Plaza lati “ma lo ogun lati tọju awọn ara ilu Mexico.”
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ṣe ìlérí lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹta nì Gbàgede Tlatelolco láti ''máṣe lo àwọn ọmọ ogun fún ìfipatẹ-orí àwọn eniyan Mẹ́ṣíkò náà ba.''

rows.source: Troops fired on a peaceful demonstration at the plaza on Oct. 2, 1968, killing as many as 300 people at a time when leftist student movements were taking root throughout Latin America.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun náà yọ̀ lórí ìfihàn aláàánú kan ní pápá ní ọjọ́ 2, oṣù kọkànlá, ọdún 1968, tí wọ́n sì pa àwọn ènìyàn tó lé ní 300 ní àkókò kan nígbà tí àwọn ìṣọ̀kan akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ òsìwọ̀n ń dàgbà káàkiri Latin America.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ogun yìnbọn lu ìwọ́de alálàáfíà kan ni gbàgede náà lọ́jọ́ kejì oṣù Ọ̀wàrà, lọ́dún 1968, tíwọ́n sì pa ọ̀pọ̀ tí ó tó bíi ọ̀ọ́dúrun ènìyàn ní àkókò kan tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ àkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ òṣèlú ọlọ́wọ́-òsì ńfi gbòǹgbò múlẹ̀ jákè-jádò ilẹ̀ Látìnì Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support young Mexicans by giving monthly subsidies to those who study and opening more free public universities.
rows.output: Lopez Obrador ti ṣe ileri lati ṣe atilẹyin fun awọn ọmọ Mexico ti o wa ni ọjọ-ori nipasẹ fifun awọn ẹbun oṣiṣẹ oṣiṣẹ ni oṣiṣẹ oṣiṣẹ ati ṣiṣe awọn ile-ẹkọ giga ti gbogbo eniyan diẹ sii.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ti jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ́ láti ṣàtìlẹ́yîn fun àwọn ọ̀dọ́ orilẹ-ede Mẹ́ṣíkò nípa fífún àwọn tó ńkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní owó ìrọ̀rùn olóoṣooṣù àti sísí àwọn ilẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ yunifásitì ọlọ́ọ̀fẹ́ ti ara ìlú díẹ̵̀ síi.

rows.source: He has said that unemployment and a lack of educational opportunities draws youth to criminal gangs.
rows.output: Ó ti sọ pé àìrìṣẹ́ àti àìní àǹfààní ẹ̀kọ́ ń fa àwọn ọ̀dọ́ lọ sí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀daràn.
rows.reference: O tí sọpé àìríṣẹ́ṣe àti àìsí àwọn àǹfààní ètò-ẹ̀kọ́  ńfa àwọn ọ̀dọ́ wọnú àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀daràn.

rows.source: U.S. should double A.I. funding
rows.output: U.S. yẹ kí ó mú ìdá méjì A.I. ìnáwọ́
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede U.S. níláti sọ ìfúnnilówó ti A.I di ìlọ́poméjì

rows.source: As China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount it spends on research in the field, says investor and AI practitioner Kai-Fu Lee, who has worked for Google, Microsoft and Apple.
rows.output: Bí China ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ púpọ̀ síi nínú ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ àtinúdá, orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà gbọ́dọ̀ mú iye owó tí ó ń ná lórí ìwádìí nínú ẹ̀ka yìí pọ̀ sí i, ni Kai-Fu Lee sọ, olùkópa owó àti olùṣàkóso AI, ẹni tí ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ fún Google, Microsoft àti Apple.
rows.reference: Olùdóko-òwò àti òṣìṣẹ́ AI kan, Kai-Fu Lee, ẹniti ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ fún Google, Microsoft àti Apple tí sọ wipe bí orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ti ǹṣíṣẹ́ tákútákún ninu ọpọlọ àtọwọ́dá, orilẹ-ede U.S níláti sọ iye owó tí ó ńná lórí ìwáàdí ninu ẹ̀ka ìmọ̀ náà di ìlọ́po méjì.

rows.source: The comments come after various parts of the U.S. government have made AI announcements, even as the U.S. overall lacks a formal AI strategy.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdánilójú náà wá lẹ́yìn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ apá ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà tí wọ́n ti ṣe àfihàn AI, nígbà tí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà gẹ́gẹ́ bí gbogbo rẹ̀ kò ní ìlànà AI tó dọ́gba.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọ̀rọ náà jáde lẹ́yìn tí oríṣiríṣi àwọn ẹ̀ka ìjọba orilẹ-ede U.S. tiṣe àwọn ìkéde AI, àní bíi orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́nà gbogbo tisẹ aláìní ọ̀nà àgbékalẹ̀ fun àtiṣe AI.

rows.source: Meanwhile, China introduced its plan last year: it's aiming to be No.1 in AI innovation by 2030.
rows.output: Nígbàmíràn, Ṣáínà ṣe ìfilọ́lẹ̀ ètò rẹ̀ ní ọdún tó kọjá: ó ń wá láti jẹ́ No.1 nínú ìmúṣẹ AI ní 2030.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, orilẹ-ede Ṣáìnà ti ṣàfihàn àgbékalẹ̀ ètò rẹ̀ lọ́dún tó kọjá: ó ńlépa láti wàní ipò ìkínní nínú ọgbọ́n ìṣàgbéjáde AI kí ó tó di ọdún 2030.

rows.source: "Double the AI research budget would be a good start, given that all other countries are so much farther behind U.S., and we're looking for the next breakthrough in AI," said Lee.
rows.output: "Ìdá méjì owó ìwádììjì AI yóò jẹ́ ìbọ̀wọ̀ tó dára, níwọ̀n bí gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ti jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìgbésí ayé lẹ́yìn U.S., a sì ń wá ìbọ̀wọ̀ tó ń bọ̀ ní AI," ni Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Lee tunb́o ̣so wipẹ ''Sísọ owò tí a ńyà ṣọ́tọ̀ fún ìwáàdí AI di ìlọ́pòméjì yóò jẹ́ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rere kan, pẹ̀lú wipe àwọn orilẹ-ede miran wà lọ́nà tójìnnà púpọ̀ lẹ́yìn orilẹ-ede U.S., tí àwá sì ńfojú sójú sọ́nà fún àlùyọ tókan ninu AI.

rows.source: Doubling funding could double the chances that the next big AI achievement will be made in the U.S., Lee told CNBC in an interview this week.
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lè mú kí ìṣírí pé àṣeyọrí AI tó tóbi jù lọ tó ń bọ̀ ní U.S.
rows.reference: Sísọ ìfúnnilówó dí ìlọ́poméjì leè sọ àwọn ìṣọwọṣéeṣe náà di méjì láti ríi pé àṣeyọrí AI títóbi tókàn ní yóò di ṣíṣe ní orilẹ-ede U.S., gẹgẹ bíi Lee ṣe sọ fún CNBC ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan lọ̣́̀sẹ́ yìí.

rows.source: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is CEO of Sinovation Ventures, which has invested in one of the most prominent AI companies in China, Face++.
rows.output: Lee, tí ìwé rẹ̀ “AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order” jáde ní oṣù yìí, jẹ́ CEO ti Sinovation Ventures, ilé-iṣẹ́ tí ó ti nawọ́ nínú ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ AI tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ ní China, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, ẹnití ìwé rẹ̀ ''AI Superpowers”: Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà, Àfonífojì Silikọn ati Ààtò Ayé Tuntun'' ni wọ̀n ṣàgbéjáde lóṣù yìí láti ọwọ́ Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, tójẹ́ Olùdarí Àwọn Ìdókòòwò Sinovation, eyiti ó ti dókòòwò ninu ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ AI tó gbajú-gbajà ní orilẹ-ede Ṣáìnà, Face++.

rows.source: In the 1980s at Carnegie Mellon University he worked on an AI system that beat the highest-ranked American Othello player, and later he was an executive at Microsoft Research and president of Google's China branch.
rows.output: Ni awọn ọdun 1980 ni Ile-ẹkọ giga ti Mellon University, o ṣiṣẹ lori eto AI kan ti o lu oṣere Othello Amẹrika ti o ga julọ, ati nigbamii o jẹ alabojuto ni Microsoft Research ati alaga ti ẹka Google ti China.
rows.reference: Ní àwọn ọdún 1980 sí 1989 ní Yunifásítì Carnegie Mellon ó ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ìlànà ètò àmúlòṣiṣẹ́ kan eyiti ó tayọ ti elére Othelo ti Amẹ́ríkà tówà lókè jùlọ, àtipé lẹ́yìn náà ó di aláṣẹ ti Ìwáàdí Microsoft àti ààrẹ ti ẹ̀ka Google ní orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà.

rows.source: Lee acknowledged previous U.S. government technology competitions like the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge and asked when the next one would be, in order to help identify the next visionaries.
rows.output: Ìmọ̀rìnlé jẹ́wọ́ àwọn ìpèníjà imọ̀-ẹ̀rọ ti ìjọba Amẹ́ríkà tẹ́lẹ̀, bíi Ìpèníjà Robotics ti Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, ó sì béèrè nígbà tí ìpèníjà tó kàn yóò wà, láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti mọ àwọn onímọ̀ ẹ̀rọ tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Lee ṣe ìdánimọ àwọn ìdíje ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ ti ìjọba orilẹ-ede U.S. bíi Ìpèníjà ti Àwọn Ẹ̀rọ Aláàdáṣiṣẹ́ ti Àjọ Àwọn Ìṣẹ́ Àkànṣe Ìwáàdí Tójinlẹ̀ nípa ààbò tí ó sì bèèrè igbati òmíràn tókàn jáde, láti leè ṣe ìrànwọ dídá àwọn eniyan oníran mọ̀.

rows.source: Researchers in the U.S. often have to work hard in order to win government grants, Lee said.
rows.output: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ní U.S. sábà máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ káríra láti gba owó ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ìjọba, Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn oní-ìwáàdí ní orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà níláti ṣiṣẹ́ takun-takun láti leè rí àwọn owó ìjọba gbà, ni Lee sọ.

rows.source: "It's not China that is taking away the academic leaders; it's the corporates," Lee said.
rows.output: "Kò Ṣáínà ni ó ń gbé àwọn olórí ẹ̀kọ́ lọ; ó jẹ́ àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ àjèjì." Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Lee tun so wipe ''Kì í ṣe orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ló ńkó àwọn adarí ninu ẹ̀kọ́ lọ; bíkoṣe wipe àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ nla''.

rows.source: Facebook, Google and other technology companies have hired luminaries from universities to work on AI in recent years.
rows.output: Facebook, Google, ati awọn ile-iṣẹ imọ-ẹrọ miiran ti gba awọn ọmọ ile-iwe giga lati awọn ile-ẹkọ giga lati ṣiṣẹ lori AI ni awọn ọdun to ṣẹṣẹ.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google àti àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ miran ti gba àwọn ìlúmọ̀ọ́ká ṣiṣẹ́ láti àwọn yunifásitì kí wọn leè ṣiṣẹ́ lórí AI ní àwọn ọdún àìpẹ́.

rows.source: Lee said immigration policy changes could also help the U.S. bolster its AI efforts.
rows.output: Lee sọ pé àwọn ìyípadà nínú ètò ìbàjẹ́ lè ràn orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà lọ́wọ́ láti mú agbára rẹ̀ pọ̀ sí i ní ìmúlò AI.
rows.reference: Lee sọpé àwọn ìyípadà ninu ìlàna lórí ìjáde àti ìwọlé àwọn àlejò bákannáà leè ran orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́wọ́ láti mú ìgbéga bá àwọn ipá rẹ̀ lórí AI.

rows.source: "I think green cards should automatically be offered to PhD's in AI," he said.
rows.output: "Mo ro pe awọn kaadi alawọ ewe yẹ ki o funni ni laifọwọyi si awọn PhD ni AI," o sọ.
rows.reference: ''Mo lérò wípé wọ́n nílatí máa fún àwọn tó kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gboyè PhD ninu AI ni àwọn káàdi ìwé ìgbé-ìlú aláwọ̀ ewé láìsí tàbí-ṣùgbọ́n, ni ó sọ.

rows.source: China's State Council issued its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan in July 2017.
rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọ̀ba ní Ṣáínà ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ Ìdàgbàsọ̀kànsí Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmú
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ṣàgbéjáde Àgbékalẹ Ètò Ìdàgbàsókè Ọpọlọ Àtọwọ́dá ti Ìran Tókàn nínú oṣù Agẹmọ lọ́dún 2017.

rows.source: China's National Natural Science Foundation provides funding to people at academic institutions similar to the way that the National Science Foundation and other government organizations dole out money to U.S. researchers, but the quality of academic work is lower in China, Lee said.
rows.output: Ìjọ̀ba China ń pèsè owó fún àwọn ènìyàn ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga, bíi ti National Science Foundation àti àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ìjọba mìíràn ń ṣe fún àwọn olùṣèwádìí ní U.S., ṣùgbọ́n ìwà ìmúdàgba iṣẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ ní China kéré, Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Àjọ Ìmọ̀ Sáyẹ́ńsì fún Nǹkan Àtọ̀runwá ti Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ńpèsè owó fún àwọn eniyan ní àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ní ọ̀nà tó farajọ bí Àjọ Ìmọ̀ Sáyẹ́ńsì ti Orilẹ-ede àti àwọn àjọ miran ṣe ńfún àwọn oníṣẹ́-ìwáàdí orilẹ-ede U.S., ṣùgbọ́n ìṣọwọ́dára iṣẹ́ ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wá nílẹ̀ lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà, gẹgẹ bíi Lee ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Earlier this year the U.S. Defense Department established a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which is meant to involve partners from industry and academia, and the White House announced the formation of Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
rows.output: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí, U.S. Department of Defense dá Joint Artificial Intelligence Center sílẹ̀, èyí tí ó ní ìfojúsùn láti ní àwọn alábàáṣepọ̀ láti ilé iṣẹ́ àti ilé ẹ̀kọ́, àti pé White House kéde ìdásílẹ̀ ti Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
rows.reference: Níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí orilẹ-ede U.S. Ẹ̀ka ti Ààbò ṣe ìdásílẹ̀ Ibùdó Ọpọlọ Àtọwọdá Alájọni kan, eyiti tó ní àwọn alájọ́ṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ láti ilé iṣẹ́ àti ilé ẹ̀kọ́ nínú, ti Ilé Ìjọba Funfun sì kéde ìṣẹ̀dá Ìgbìmọ̀ Àsàyàn lórí Ọpọlọ Àtọwọ́dá kan.

rows.source: And this month DARPA announced a $2 billion investment in an initiative called AI Next.
rows.output: Ní oṣù yìí, DARPA kéde ìdoko-owó $2 bilionu kan nínú ìgbìmọ̀ kan tí wọ́n ń pè ní AI Next.
rows.reference: Àtipé lóṣù yìí DARPA kéde ìdókòòwò oní-bílíọ̀nù méjì dọ́là nínú ìrònú-dọgbọ́n kan tí wọ́n pè ni AI Tókàn.

rows.source: As for the NSF, it currently invests more than $100 million per year in AI research.
rows.output: Fun NSF, o n nawọ si ju $100 milionu lọdọọdun lori iwadi AI.
rows.reference: Nípá ti NSF náà, ó ńdóoko-òwò ọgọ́ọ̀rún mílíọ̀nù dọ́là lọ́dọ́ọdún nínú ìwáàdí AI.

rows.source: Meanwhile, U.S. legislation that sought to create a National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence has not seen action in months.
rows.output: Lákòókò yìí, ìdájọ́ ìjọba Amẹ́ríkà kan tí ó ń wá láti dá Ìgbìmọ̀ Aabo Orílẹ̀-èdè kan sílẹ̀ lórí Ìmúlò Ẹ̀rọ Ìmúlò ti kò rí ìgbọ́kànlé fún oṣù mẹ́ta.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, òfin orilẹ-ede U.S. tí ó ńwá láti ṣẹ̀dá Ìgbìmọ̀ Amúṣẹ́ṣe ti Ààbò Orilẹ-ede lórí Ọpọlọ Àtọwọ́da kan kò tíì rí iṣẹ́ ṣe ninu awọn oṣù.

rows.source: Macedonians vote in referendum on whether to change country's name
rows.output: Àwọn ará Masedóníà ń dibo lórí ìdìbò nípa bóyá láti yí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede Macedonia ńdìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ lórí bóyá kí wọn yí orúkọ orilẹ̵-ede padà

rows.source: The people of Macedonia voted in a referendum on Sunday on whether to change its name to "Republic of North Macedonia," a move that would resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece which had blocked its membership bids for the European Union and NATO.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Masedóníà dibo lórí ìdìbò ní ọjọ́ Aiku lórí bóyá kí wọ́n yí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà sí “Orílẹ̀-èdè Àrìwá Masedóníà,” ìgbésẹ̀ kan tí yóò yanjú ìforígbárí tí ó ti pẹ́ pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì tí ó ti dènà ìbọ̀wọ̀ rẹ̀ fún Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù àti NATO.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan Macedoni dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́èni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ kan lọ́jọ́ Àìkú lórí bóyá kí wọ́n yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà si ''Ilẹ̀ Olómìnira ti Àríwá Masidónià,'' ìgbésẹ kan tí yóò yanjú èdè-àìyedè atọdunmọdun kan pẹlu orilẹ-ede Gíríkì eyiti ó ti dínà mọ́ àwọn ìgbìyànjú rẹ̀ lati di ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu àti NATO.

rows.source: Greece, which has a province called Macedonia, maintains that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has vetoed its entrance into NATO and the EU.
rows.output: Greece, tí ó ní ìpínlẹ̀ kan tí wọ́n ń pè ní Macedonia, sọ pé orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè alágbára rẹ̀ jẹ́ ẹ̀rí pé ó ń fẹ́ ilẹ̀ rẹ̀, ó sì ti dáwọ́ ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede Gíríkì, eyiti ó ni ẹkùn tí a ńpè ni Masidóníà, ńtẹnumọ fún ìgbà pipẹ wípé orúkọ aláàmúlégbè òun ní ìhà àríwá ńdúró fun ṣíṣe bi olúwa lóri ilẹ̀ òun tí ó sì ti dìbò láti dínà mọ́ wíwọlé rẹ sínú àjọ NATO àti EU.

rows.source: The two governments struck a deal in June based on the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents argue the change would undermine the ethnic identity of Macedonia's Slavic majority population.
rows.output: Àwọn ìjọba méjèèjì náà fọwọ́ sí ìpinnu kan ní Okudu tí ó dá lórí orúkọ tuntun náà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn alátakò orílẹ̀-èdè náà ń jiyàn pé ìyípadà náà yóò ba ìdánimọ̀ ẹ̀yà àwọn olùgbé Macedonià pọ̀ jù.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìjọba méjèèjì náà ṣe àdéhùn kan ninu oṣù Òkúdu ní ìdúró lórí orúkọ tuntun náà tí wọn dá àbá rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede tójẹ́ alátakò wí àwíjàre pé orúkọ náà yóò dín agbára ìdánimọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀yà Slavic ti Masidóníà tíwọ́n pọ̀ jùlọ kù.

rows.source: President Gjorge Ivanov has said he will not be voting in the referendum and a boycott campaign has cast doubts on whether turnout will meet the minimum 50 percent required for the referendum to be valid.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọ pé òun kò ní dibo nínú ìdìbò náà, àwọn ìgbèjà ìdìbò ti sọ pé ìdìbò tó kéré ju 50% tí a nílò fún ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́wọ́ kò ní ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọpé òun kòní dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àtipé ìpolongo fún ìdẹ́yẹsí kan ti jẹ́kí àwọn ìsiyèméjì wà lórí bóyá ìjádedìbò yóò tó ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún eyiti i ṣe iye tó kéré jùlọ tí wọ́n nílò fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ eyiti ó wúlò.

rows.source: The question on the referendum ballot read: "Are you for NATO and EU membership with acceptance of the agreement with Greece."
rows.output: Ìbéèrè lórí kíkọ̀ láti inú ìwé ìdìbò náà ni: "Ṣé o fẹ́ NATO àti ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì."
rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.source: Supporters of the name change, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that it is a price worth paying to pursue admission into bodies such as the EU and NATO for Macedonia, one of the countries to emerge from the collapse of Yugoslavia.
rows.output: Àwọn olùfọkànsìn fún ìyípadà orúkọ náà, títí kan Aláṣẹ Aláṣẹ Zoran Zaev, jiyan pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó yẹ kí wọ́n san láti lè lépa ìbọ̀wọ̀ nínú àwọn ara bíi EU àti NATO fún Mẹ́sídóníà, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jáde kúrò nínú ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.source: "I came today to vote for the future of the country, for young people in Macedonia so they can be live freely under the umbrella of the European Union because it means safer lives for all of us," said Olivera Georgijevska, 79, in Skopje.
rows.output: "Mo wá l'ónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masedóníà kí wọn lè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ àpáta Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Ì
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.source: Although not legally binding, enough members of parliament have said they will abide by the vote's outcome to make it decisive.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó pọ̀ tó ti sọ pé wọ́n á tẹ̀lé àbájáde ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ ìpinnu tó ṣeé ṣe.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.source: The name change would requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.
rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì nínú mẹ́ta nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.source: The state election commission said there had been no reports of irregularities by 1 p.m.
rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìrònú nípa àìbọ̀wọ̀ tàbí àìbọ̀wọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.source: However, turnout stood at only 16 percent, compared to 34 percent in last parliamentary election in 2016 when 66 percent of the registered voters cast their ballot.
rows.output: Síbẹ̀, ìdìbò náà jẹ́ 16%, ní ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú 34% nínú ìdìbò àpérò tó kọjá ní ọdún 2016 nígbà tí 66% àwọn olùdíbò tí wọ́n forúkọ sílẹ̀ dibo.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.source: "I came out to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe," said Gjose Tanevski, 62, a voter in the capital, Skopje.
rows.output: "Mo jade lati dibo nitori awọn ọmọ mi, ibi wa ni Yuroopu," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, olùdìbò ni olú ìlú, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Welsh AMs worried about 'looking like muppets'
rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Wales sun damu da "yadda suke kama"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.source: There is consternation among some AMs at a suggestion their title should change to MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu 'yan majalisar a wani shiri da ake yi na canza sunan su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.source: It has arisen because of plans to change the name of the assembly to the Welsh Parliament.
rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shiri na canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.source: AMs across the political spectrum are worried it could invite ridicule.
rows.output: AMs a faɗin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa hakan na iya jawo wa su kunya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.source: One Labour AM said his group was concerned "it rhymes with Twp and Pwp."
rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "ya damu da cewa yana kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.source: For readers outside of Wales: In Welsh twp means daft and pwp means poo.
rows.output: Ga masu karanta a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft kuma pwp yana nufin feces.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.source: A Plaid AM said the group as a whole was "not happy" and has suggested alternatives.
