rows.source: Midsomer Norton attack: Four attempted murder arrests
rows.output: Harin Midsomer Norton: An kama mutane hudu da laifukan yunƙurin kisan kai
rows.reference: Harin Midsomer Norton:  Kame mutane huɗu da suka yi ƙoƙarin kisa

rows.source: Three teenage boys and a 20-year-old man have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was found with stab wounds in Somerset.
rows.output: An kama wasu yara maza uku masu shekaru 17 da kuma wani mutum mai shekaru 20 bisa zargin yunkurin kisan kai bayan an samu wani yaro mai shekaru 16 da raunuka a Somerset.
rows.reference: An kame wasu yara su uku da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 a kan zargin ƙoƙarin yin kisa bayan an sami wani mai shekaru 16 da raunukan caka wuka a cikin Somerset.

rows.source: The teenage boy was found injured in the Excelsior Terrace area of Midsomer Norton, at about 04:00 BST on Saturday.
rows.output: Wani yaro mai shekaru 16 da ya ji rauni an samu a yankin Excelsior Terrace na Midsomer Norton, a kusan karfe 04:00 na safe a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An sami yaron ne da raunin a cikin yankin Farfajiyar Excelsior na Midsomer Norton, da kusan ƙarfe 04:00 BST na ranar Asabar.

rows.source: He was taken to hospital where he remains in a "stable" condition.
rows.output: An kai shi asibiti inda yake cikin "yanayi mai kyau".
rows.reference: An ɗauke zuwa asibiti inda yake cikin wani yanayi “mai ƙarko.”

rows.source: A 17-year-old, two 18-year-olds and a 20-year-old man were arrested overnight in the Radstock area, Avon and Somerset Police said.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 17, mutane biyu masu shekaru 18, da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 an kama su a cikin yankin Radstock, a cewar ‘yan sanda na Avon da Somerset.
rows.reference: An kama wani mai shekaru 17, biyu masu shekaru 18 da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 da dare a cikin yankin Radstock, Avon inji ‘Yan Sandan Somerset.

rows.source: Officers have appealed for anyone who may have any mobile phone footage of what happened to come forward.
rows.output: Jami'an sun yi kira ga duk wanda zai iya samun bidiyo na wayoyin salula na abin da ya faru ya zo gaba.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun roƙi duk wani wanda ƙila ke da ƙaramin bidiyo na wayar hannu na abin da ya faru da ya zo.

rows.source: Trump says Kavanaugh 'suffered, the meanness, the anger' of the Democratic Party
rows.output: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya sha wahala, rashin mutunci, fushi na jam'iyyar Democrat
rows.reference: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ‘ya sha wahala, bakin hali, fushi’ na Jam’iyyar Democrat

rows.source: "A vote for Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to reject the ruthless and outrageous tactics of the Democratic Party," Trump said at a rally in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: "Kuri'a ga Alkalin Kavanaugh kuri'a ce ta kin karɓar dabarun da ba su da mutunci da kuma mugun halin da jam'iyyar Democrat ke yi," Trump ya ce a wani gangami a Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kuri’a don Alkali Kavanaugh kaɗa kuri’a ne don ƙin rashin tausayi da dabarun fin ƙarfi na Jam’iyyar Democrat,” inji Trump a wani gangami a cikin Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: Trump said that Kavanaugh has "suffered the meanness, the anger" of the Democratic Party throughout his nomination process.
rows.output: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya "jira rashin mutunci, fushi" na jam'iyyar Democrat a duk lokacin tsarin zaɓensa.
rows.reference: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya sha “wahalar rashin tausayi, fushi” na Jam’iyyar Democrat ta hanyar tura sunansa.

rows.source: Kavanaugh testified before Congress on Thursday, forcefully and emotionally denying an allegation from Christine Blasey Ford that he sexually assaulted her decades ago when they were teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ya yi shaida a gaban Majalisar Dokoki a ranar Alhamis, yana mai cewa da karfi da tausayi, cewa wata zargi daga Christine Blasey Ford cewa ya yi mata fyade shekaru da yawa da suka wuce lokacin da suke matasan.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh ya ba da shaida a gaban Congress a ranar Alhamis, da ƙarfi yana kuma cikin fushi na ƙin wani ƙage daga Christine Blasey Ford cewa ya far mata ta hanyar jima’i shekaru da yawa da suka wuce suna samari.

rows.source: Ford also testified at the hearing about her allegation.
rows.output: Ford kuma ta shaida a lokacin da aka yi magana game da zargin da take yi.
rows.reference: Ford ita ma ta ba shaida a jin bahasin game da ƙagen nata.

rows.source: The President said on Saturday that the "American people saw the brilliant and quality and courage" of Kavanaugh that day.
rows.output: Shugaban ya ce a ranar Asabar cewa "mutanen Amurka sun ga kyawu da ingancin da kuma jaruntaka" na Kavanaugh a wannan rana.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya faɗa a rana Asabar cewa “Amurkawa sun ga fasaha da kyau da ƙarfin hali” na Kavanaugh wannan ranar.

rows.source: "A vote to confirm Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to confirm one of the most accomplished legal minds of our time, a jurist with a sterling record of public service," he told the crowd of West Virginia supporters.
rows.output: "Wani kuri'a na tabbatar da Alkalin Kavanaugh yana nufin tabbatar da daya daga cikin mafi kyawun tunanin shari'a a zamaninmu, alkalin da ke da tarihin hidima ga jama'a mai kyau," ya gaya wa taron masu goyon bayan West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to Kavanaugh's nomination while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya yi nuni da nadin Kavanaugh a fili yayin da yake magana kan muhimmancin fitar da jam'iyyar Republican a zaben tsakiya.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.source: "Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: "Kwanaki biyar daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da suka fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.source: I'm not running, but I'm really running," he said.
rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina ta gudu sosai," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.source: "That's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates."
rows.output: "Ina yin hakan ne saboda ina da ra'ayi mai kyau game da 'yan takara masu kyau."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.source: Trump argued that Democrats are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat suna da niyyar "juriya da toshewa."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.source: The first key procedural vote on the Senate floor on Kavanaugh's nomination is expected to take place no later than Friday, a senior GOP leadership aide has told CNN.
rows.output: An yi zato cewa za a yi zabe na farko na tsari a kan bene na Majalisar Dattijai kan gabatarwar Kavanaugh ba gaba ba fiye da Juma'a, wani jami'in shugaban jam'iyyar GOP mai girma ya gaya wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.source: Hundreds killed by Indonesian quake, tsunami, with toll seen rising
rows.output: An kashe mutane da dama a cikin girgizar ƙasar Indonesia, tsunami, tare da yawan mamacin da ake sa ran zai karu
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.source: At least 384 people were killed, many swept away as giant waves crashed onto beaches, when a major earthquake and tsunami hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, authorities said on Saturday.
rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa aka yi wa su feshi da manyan igiyoyin ruwa da suka yi ta kutsawa cikin bakin teku, lokacin da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar jami'an da ke kula da harkokin.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a festival on the beach in the city of Palu on Friday when waves as high as six meters (18 feet) smashed onshore at dusk, sweeping many to their deaths and destroying anything in their path.
rows.output: Mutane da yawa sun taru domin bikin a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a lokacin da igiyoyin da suka kai mita shida (ƙafa 18) suka yi kaca-kaca a bakin teku a lokacin fari, inda suka kwashe mutane da yawa kuma suka lalata duk wani abu da ke kan hanyarsu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.source: The tsunami followed a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
rows.output: An bi tsunami bayan girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.source: "When the tsunami threat arose yesterday, people were still doing their activities on the beach and did not immediately run and they became victims," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, the spokesman for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency BNPB said in a briefing in Jakarta.
rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazana na tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su gaggauta gudu ba, kuma sun zama wadanda suka ji rauni," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kare bala'i ta Indonesia BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.source: "The tsunami didn't come by itself, it dragged cars, logs, houses, it hit everything on land," Nugroho said, adding that the tsunami had traveled across the open sea at speeds of 800 kph (497 mph) before striking the shoreline.
rows.output: "Tsunami bai zo da kansa ba, ya ja motoci, itatuwan katako, gidajen, ya bugi komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, inda ya kara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai bude ido da saurin kilomita 800 a kowace sa'a (497 mph) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.source: Some people climbed trees to escape the tsunami and survived, he said.
rows.output: Wasu mutane sun haura bishiyoyi don tserewa daga tsunami kuma sun tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.source: Around 16,700 people were evacuated to 24 centers in Palu.
rows.output: Kusan mutane 16,700 an kai su sansani 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.source: Aerial photographs released by the disaster agency showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges twisted and collapsed and a mosque surrounded by water.
rows.output: Hotunan sama da aka fitar da su daga hukumar bala'i sun nuna cewa an lalata da yawa daga cikin gine-gine da shaguna, an murɗa da kuma rugujewa gadoji, kuma an rufe wani masallaci da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.source: Aftershocks continued to rock the coastal city on Saturday.
rows.output: An ci gaba da girgizar kasa a birnin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: The series of earthquakes were felt in an area with 2.4 million people.
rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar ƙasa a yankin da mutane miliyan 2.4 ke zaune.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.source: Indonesia's Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in statement the energy released by Friday's massive quake was around 200 times the power of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War Two.
rows.output: Hukumar Indonesia ta Kimanta da Aiwatar da Fasaha (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, karfin da aka saki a lokacin girgizar kasa mai girma a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.source: The geography of the city, which sits at the end of a long, narrow bay, could have magnified the size of the tsunami, it said.
rows.output: Yankin birnin, wanda ke a ƙarshen wani kogon da ya yi tsayi da kuma bakin teku, zai iya kara girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.source: Nugroho described the damage as "extensive" and said thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels had collapsed.
rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai faɗi" kuma ya ce dubban gidajen mutane, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.source: Bodies of some victims were found trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings, he said, adding 540 people were injured and 29 were missing.
rows.output: An samu gawar wasu wadanda suka mutu a karkashin tarkacen ginin da ya ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.source: Nugroho said the casualties and the damage could be greater along the coastline 300 km (190 miles) north of Palu, an area called Donggala, which is closer to the epicenter of the quake.
rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an yi wa mutanen da suka mutu da kuma lalacewar gine-gine na iya zama mafi girma a bakin teku mai nisan kilomita 300 (190 mil) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ke kusa da tsakiyar girgizar.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.source: Communications "were totally crippled with no information" from Donggala, Nugroho said.
rows.output: Hadarurruwan "sun lalace gaba ɗaya ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.source: There are more than 300,000 people living there," the Red Cross said in a statement, adding that its staff and volunteers were heading to the affected areas.
rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa da Red Cross ta yi, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa na tafiya zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.source: "This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse," it said.
rows.output: "Wannnan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya ƙara tsananta."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.source: The agency on Saturday was widely criticized for not informing that a tsunami had hit Palu, though officials said waves had come within the time the warning was issued.
rows.output: Ma'aikatar ta yi fushi a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokacin da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.source: In amateur footage shared on social media a man on the upper floor of a building can be heard shouting frantic warnings of the approaching tsunami to people on the street below.
rows.output: A cikin bidiyo na masu sha'awar da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na wani gini yana ihu da gargaɗi na firgita game da tsunami mai zuwa ga mutane a titin da ke ƙasa.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.source: Within minutes a wall of water crashes onto the shore, carrying away buildings and cars.
rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katanga na ruwa ya yi kaca-kaca a bakin teku, yana ɗaukar gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.source: Reuters was not able to immediately authenticate the footage.
rows.output: An ba da damar yin amfani da wannan bayanai ga Reuters, amma ba a tabbatar da shi ba nan take.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.source: The quake and tsunami caused a major power outage that cut communications around Palu making it difficult for authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.
rows.output: Girgizar ƙasa da tsunami sun haifar da wani babban katsewar wutar lantarki da ya katse sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wuya ga hukumomin da za su tsara aikin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.source: The military has started sending in cargo planes with aid from Jakarta and other cities, authorities said, but evacuees still badly need food and other basic necessities.
rows.output: An fara aika jiragen kaya da kayan agajin sojojin daga Jakarta da sauran biranen, a cewar jami'an, amma 'yan gudun hijira har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran abubuwan da suke buƙata.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.source: The city's airport has been reopened only for relief efforts and will remain closed until Oct.
rows.output: An bude filin jirgin a matsayin wani bangare na kokarin taimakon da ake yi, kuma za a ci gaba da rufe shi har zuwa watan Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit evacuation centers in Palu on Sunday.
rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya yi shiri ya ziyarci sansanonin da ake fitar da su daga Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami Toll Soars Above 800.
rows.output: Indoneshiya ta fuskanci tsunami mai ban mamaki, wanda ya haifar da mutuwar sama da 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.source: It Is Very Bad.
rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.source: While World Vision's staff from Donggala have made it safely to Palu city, where employees are sheltering in tarpaulin shelters set up in the courtyard of their office, they passed scenes of devastation on the way, Mr. Doseba said.
rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan World Vision daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikatan ke zaune a wajen tarpaulin da aka kafa a filin gidan su, sun ga abubuwan da suka lalata a hanya, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.source: "They told me they saw lots of houses that were destroyed," he said.
rows.output: "Suka gaya mini sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.source: It is very bad.
rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.source: Even as aid groups began the grim motions of starting the gears of disaster relief, some complained that foreign aid workers with deep expertise were being prevented from traveling to Palu.
rows.output: Koda yake, yayin da ƙungiyoyin agajin farko suka fara yin aikin da za su yi na fara aikin agajin bala'i, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agajin kasashen waje masu ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.source: According to Indonesian regulations, funding, supplies and staffing from overseas can only start flowing if the site of a calamity is declared a national disaster zone.
rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesia, ba za a iya fara ba da kuɗi, kayan aiki da ma'aikatan ƙasashensu ba, sai dai idan an bayyana wurin bala'in a matsayin yankin bala'in kasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.source: That has not happened yet.
rows.output: Har yanzu hakan bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.source: "It's still a province level disaster," said Aulia Arriani, a spokesperson for the Indonesian Red Cross.
rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'in larduna ne," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agajin jama'a ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.source: "Once the government says, "O.K., this is a national disaster," we can open for international assistance but there's no status yet."
rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wata matsala ce ta kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu babu wata matsaya."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.source: As the second night fell on Palu after Friday's earthquake and tsunami, friends and family of those still missing were holding out hope that their loved ones would be the miracles that leaven the bleak story lines of natural disasters.
rows.output: A lokacin da dare na biyu ya sauko a Palu bayan girgizar kasa da tsunami da suka faru a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na wadanda har yanzu ba a samu ba suna fatan cewa masu son su za su zama abin al'ajabi da zai sa labarun da suka shafi bala'o'i na halitta su yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.source: On Saturday, a little boy was plucked from a sewer.
rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani yaro danaram a cikin wani bututu.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.source: On Sunday, rescuers freed a woman who had been pinned under rubble for two days with the body of her mother next to her.
rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ceto wata mata da aka binne ta a karkashin tarkacen gida na kwanaki biyu tare da jikarta a gefen ta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.source: Gendon Subandono, the coach of the Indonesian national paragliding team, had trained two of the missing paragliders for the Asian Games, which wrapped up earlier this month in Indonesia.
rows.output: Gendon Subandono, kocin tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da 'yan paragliding biyu da suka bace don gasar Asiya, wanda ya kare a watan da ya gabata a Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.source: Others of those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel, Mr. Mandagi included, were his students.
rows.output: Sauran wadanda aka kama a Otal din Roa Roa, wanda ya hada da Mista Mandagi, dalibai ne.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.source: "As a senior in the paragliding field, I have my own emotional burden," he said.
rows.output: "A matsayin babban ɗan wasan da ke cikin fannin paragliding, ina da nauyina na motsa rai," ya ce.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.source: Mr. Gendon recounted how, in the hours after the news of the Roa Roa Hotel collapse circulated among the paragliding community, he had desperately sent WhatsApp messages to the Palu competitors, who were taking part in the beach festival.
rows.output: Mr. Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a cikin sa'o'i bayan labarun rugujewar otal din Roa Roa ya bazu a cikin al'ummar paragliding, ya yi yunƙurin aikawa da saƙonni na WhatsApp ga 'yan wasa na Palu, waɗanda ke halartan bikin bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.source: His messages, though, only resulted in one gray check mark, rather than a pair of blue checks.
rows.output: Saƙonninsa, duk da haka, ya haifar da alamar duba mai launin toka guda ɗaya, maimakon alamun shuɗi biyu.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.source: "I think that means the messages were not delivered," he said.
rows.output: "Ina ganin hakan yana nufin sakonnin ba a kai su ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.source: Thieves take $26,750 during ATM refill at Newport on the Levee
rows.output: An yi sata da $26,750 a lokacin cajin ATM a Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Ɓarayi sun ɗauki dala 26,750 a lokacin sake cika ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe

rows.source: Thieves on Friday morning stole $26,750 from a Brink's worker refilling an ATM at Newport on the Levee, according to a news release from the Newport Police Department.
rows.output: An yi sata a ranar Juma'a da safe, an sace dala 26,750 daga ma'aikacin Brink da ke cikin ATM a Newport on the Levee, a cewar wani sanarwa daga sashen 'yan sanda na Newport.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.source: The car's driver had been emptying an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deliver more money, Det. Dennis McCarthy wrote in the release.
rows.output: Direban motar ya kasance yana fitar da wani ATM a cikin cikin cikin nishaɗi kuma yana shirya isar da ƙarin kudi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.source: While he was occupied, another man "ran up from behind the Brink's employee" and stole a bag of money meant for delivery.
rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin hargitsi, wani mutum ya yi gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudi da za a kai.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.source: Witnesses spotted multiple suspects fleeing the scene, according to the release, but police did not specify the number involved in the incident.
rows.output: Shaidu sun lura da wasu masu laifi da dama da suka gudu daga wurin, a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su bayyana adadin wadanda suka shiga lamarin ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.source: Anyone with information about their identities should contact Newport police at 859-292-3680.
rows.output: Dukkan mutanen da ke da bayanai game da asusun su su tuntubi 'yan sanda na Newport a 859-292-3680.
rows.reference: Ya kamata duk wani da ke da bayani game da shaidarsu ya tuntuɓi ‘yan sandan Newport a kan 859-292-3680.

rows.source: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye
rows.output: Kanye Yamma: Rapper ya canza sunansa zuwa Ye
rows.reference: Kanye West: Mawaƙin Rap ya canza sunansa zuwa Ye

rows.source: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.
rows.output: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.
rows.reference: Mawaƙin Rap yana canza sunan - zuwa Ye.

rows.source: Announcing the change on Twitter on Saturday, he wrote: "The being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Sanar da canjin a Twitter a ranar Asabar, ya rubuta: "Wanda aka sani da Kanye West."
rows.reference: A sanar da canza sunan ta Twitter a ranar Asabar, ya rubuta: “A da an san ni a matsayin Kanye West.”

rows.source: West, 41, has been nicknamed Ye for some time and used the moniker as the title for his eighth album, which was released in June.
rows.output: Yamma, 41, an yi masa lakabi da Ye tsawon lokaci kuma ya yi amfani da wannan sunan a matsayin taken kundin sa na takwas, wanda aka fitar a watan Yuni.
rows.reference: Ana yi wa lakabi da Ye ga West, mai shekaru 41 na tsawon wani lokaci kuma ya yi amfani da moniker a sunan faifansa na takwas, wanda aka sake a cikin Yuni.

rows.source: The change comes ahead of his appearance on Saturday Night Live, where he is expected to launch his new album Yandhi.
rows.output: Canjin ya zo ne kafin bayyana a ranar Asabar da Daddare, inda ake sa ran zai ƙaddamar da kundin sa na Yandhi.
rows.reference: Canjin yana zuwa ne kafin bayyanarsa a cikin shirin Saturday Night Live, inda ake tsammanin zai ƙaddamar da sabon faifansa Yandhi.

rows.source: He replaces singer Ariana Grande on the show who cancelled for "emotional reasons," the show's creator said.
rows.output: Ya maye gurbin mawakiya Ariana Grande a wasan kwaikwayo wanda ya soke saboda "dalilan motsa rai," kamar yadda mai shirya wasan ya ce.
rows.reference: Yana maye gurbin mawaƙi Ariana Grande a shirin wanda ya soke don “dalilin ɓacin rai,” inji maƙirƙirin shirin.

rows.source: As well as being an abbreviation of his current professional name, West has previously said the word has religious significance for him.
rows.output: Haka nan yana nufin gajarta sunan sana'arsa na yanzu, kuma West ya ce kalmar tana da ma'ana ta addini a gare shi.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda ya zama abu gajartacce na sunansa na sana’a na yanzu, West a da ya ce kalmar tana da wata ma’anar addini a gare shi.

rows.source: "I believe 'ye' is the most commonly used word in the Bible, and in the Bible it means 'you,'" West said earlier this year, discussing his album title with radio host Big Boy.
rows.output: Na yi imani "ku" shine mafi yawan kalmomin da ake amfani da su a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki, kuma a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki yana nufin "kai," in ji West a baya a wannan shekara, yayin da yake magana da mai gabatar da rediyo Big Boy.
rows.reference: “Na yi imani ‘ye’ kalma ce da aka fi amfani sosai a cikin Baibul, kuma a cikin Baibul tana nufin ‘kai,” inji West a farkon wannan shekarar, yana tattauna sunan faifan ɗinsa tare da mai karɓan baƙi na rediyo Big Boy.

rows.source: "So I'm you, I'm us, it's us.
rows.output: "Don haka ni ku ne, ni mu ne, mu ne.
rows.reference: “Don haka ni ku ne, mu ne.

rows.source: It went from Kanye, which means the only one, to just Ye - just being a reflection of our good, our bad, our confused, everything.
rows.output: Ya samo asali ne daga Kanye, wanda ke nufin mutum ɗaya kawai, zuwa kawai Ye - kawai zama wani tunatarwa na abin da muke da kyau, munanan, munanan, komai.
rows.reference: Ya wuce ne daga Kanye, wanda ke nufin guda ɗaya, zuwa kaɗai Ye - kawai wani manuni na kyawunmu, ruɗaninmu, kowane abu.

rows.source: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."
rows.output: Likitoci sun yi imani da cewa za a iya amfani da maganin su wajen warkar da cutar.
rows.reference: Faifan kamar wani nuni ne na su wane ne mu.”

rows.source: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.
rows.output: Yana ɗaya daga cikin fitattun rappers da suka canza suna.
rows.reference: Yana daga cikin sanannun rappers da suka canza sunansu.

rows.source: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.
rows.output: Sean Combs an san shi da Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma a wannan shekarar ya bayyana sonansa na suna Love da Brother Love.
rows.reference: An san Sean Combs da sunaye iri-iri a matsayin Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma wannan shekarar ya sanar cewa fifikonsa na sunayen Love da Brother Love ne.

rows.source: A former West collaborator, JAY-Z, has also made do with or without a hyphen and capitals.
rows.output: Wani tsohon abokin yammaci, JAY-Z, ya kuma yi amfani da shi ko ba tare da haɗin kai da manyan haruffa ba.
rows.reference: Wani abokin haɗin gwiwa na West, JAY-Z, shi ma ya sha yi da ko ba tare da wani layi gajere na tsakiyar kalma da manyan baƙaƙe.

rows.source: Mexico's AMLO vows not to use military against civilians
rows.output: Mexico's AMLO ya yi alkawari ba zai yi amfani da sojojin soja a kan fararen hular ba.
rows.reference: AMLO na Mexico ya yi alkawarin ba zai yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba

rows.source: Mexican President-elect Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has vowed to never use military force against civilians as the country approaches the 50th anniversary of a bloody reprisal against students.
rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Mexico mai zuwa, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, ya yi alƙawarin ba zai taɓa amfani da karfinsa a kan fararen hular ba yayin da ƙasar ke gab da cikar shekaru biyar da suka gabata da wani mummunan hari da aka kai wa ɗalibai.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador promised Saturday at Tlatelolco Plaza to "never ever use the military to repress the Mexican people."
rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alƙawarin a ranar Asabar a filin Tlatelolco cewa "ba za a taɓa amfani da sojojin soja wajen murkushe mutanen Mexico ba."
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.source: Troops fired on a peaceful demonstration at the plaza on Oct. 2, 1968, killing as many as 300 people at a time when leftist student movements were taking root throughout Latin America.
rows.output: Sojoji sun harbe wani gangamin zaman lafiya a filin wasa a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe mutane daga 300 zuwa 1,000. A lokacin ne aka fara samun motsin matasa na hagu a duk fadin Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support young Mexicans by giving monthly subsidies to those who study and opening more free public universities.
rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari zai tallafa wa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar ba da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda suke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'i na jama'a kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.source: He has said that unemployment and a lack of educational opportunities draws youth to criminal gangs.
rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi na jawo matasa zuwa ƙungiyoyin masu aikata laifi.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.source: U.S. should double A.I. funding
rows.output: Ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudin da ake kashewa akan A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.source: As China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount it spends on research in the field, says investor and AI practitioner Kai-Fu Lee, who has worked for Google, Microsoft and Apple.
rows.output: Yayin da Sin ke kara yawan aikin basirar ɗan adam, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka adadin kuɗin da take kashewa wajen bincike a fannin, in ji mai zuba jari kuma mai aiki da AI, Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.source: The comments come after various parts of the U.S. government have made AI announcements, even as the U.S. overall lacks a formal AI strategy.
rows.output: An yi sharhi ne bayan an yi wasu sanarwar AI a sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka, duk da cewa Amurka gaba ɗaya ba ta da wani tsari na haramtacciyar AI.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.source: Meanwhile, China introduced its plan last year: it's aiming to be No.1 in AI innovation by 2030.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, Sin ta gabatar da shirin ta na shekarar da ta gabata: tana da burin zama No.1 a fannin kirkire-kirkire na AI nan da 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.source: "Double the AI research budget would be a good start, given that all other countries are so much farther behind U.S., and we're looking for the next breakthrough in AI," said Lee.
rows.output: "Kudin bincike na AI ya ninka zai zama kyakkyawan fara'a, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa dukkan sauran kasashe suna da nisa a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman ci gaban AI na gaba," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.source: Doubling funding could double the chances that the next big AI achievement will be made in the U.S., Lee told CNBC in an interview this week.
rows.output: Kawai ku ninka kuɗin da za a iya ninka yiwuwar samun babban nasara a fannin AI a Amurka, in ji Lee a wata hira da CNBC a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.source: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is CEO of Sinovation Ventures, which has invested in one of the most prominent AI companies in China, Face++.
rows.output: Lee, wanda littafin sa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley da Sabuwar Tsarin Duniya" ya fito a wannan watan da Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga, shi ne shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.source: In the 1980s at Carnegie Mellon University he worked on an AI system that beat the highest-ranked American Othello player, and later he was an executive at Microsoft Research and president of Google's China branch.
rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya kasance shugaban Microsoft Research da kuma shugaban rassan Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.source: Lee acknowledged previous U.S. government technology competitions like the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge and asked when the next one would be, in order to help identify the next visionaries.
rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasa da gwamnati ta Amurka ta yi a baya a fannin fasaha kamar gasar da Cibiyar Bincike ta Sojan Sama ta Advanced Robotics ta yi, kuma ta tambayi lokacin da za a yi na gaba, don taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.source: Researchers in the U.S. often have to work hard in order to win government grants, Lee said.
rows.output: Masana kimiyya a Amurka sau da yawa suna aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.source: "It's not China that is taking away the academic leaders; it's the corporates," Lee said.
rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ke ɗaukar shugabannin ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.source: Facebook, Google and other technology companies have hired luminaries from universities to work on AI in recent years.
rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanoni na fasaha sun dauki fitattun malamai daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekaru da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.source: Lee said immigration policy changes could also help the U.S. bolster its AI efforts.
rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canje a cikin manufofin shiga ƙasa na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen ƙara ƙarfafa ƙoƙarin ta na AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.source: "I think green cards should automatically be offered to PhD's in AI," he said.
rows.output: "Ina ganin katunan koren ya kamata a ba wa masu digiri na uku a fannin basirar wucin gadi," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.source: China's State Council issued its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan in July 2017.
rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar Jihohin kasar Sin ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar basirar ɗan Adam na zamani a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.source: China's National Natural Science Foundation provides funding to people at academic institutions similar to the way that the National Science Foundation and other government organizations dole out money to U.S. researchers, but the quality of academic work is lower in China, Lee said.
rows.output: Asusun Kimiyyar Halitta ta Kasa ta China tana ba da tallafi ga mutane a cikin cibiyoyin ilimi kamar yadda Asusun Kimiyyar Halitta da sauran kungiyoyin gwamnati ke fitar da kuɗi ga masu bincike a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa a China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.source: Earlier this year the U.S. Defense Department established a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which is meant to involve partners from industry and academia, and the White House announced the formation of Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali na Wucin Gadi, wadda aka yi niyya don haɗa masu amfani daga masana'antu da jami'o'i, kuma Fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓin Hankali na Wucin Gadi.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.source: And this month DARPA announced a $2 billion investment in an initiative called AI Next.
rows.output: Kuma wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri da ake kira AI Na Gaba.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.source: As for the NSF, it currently invests more than $100 million per year in AI research.
rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana zuba sama da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a cikin bincike na AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.source: Meanwhile, U.S. legislation that sought to create a National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence has not seen action in months.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, dokokin Amurka da ke da niyyar kafa wata hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan fasahar wucin gadi ba a ga an yi wani abu a cikin watanni ba.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.source: Macedonians vote in referendum on whether to change country's name
rows.output: Macedoniyawa suna zabar a zaben kan ko za su canza sunan kasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.source: The people of Macedonia voted in a referendum on Sunday on whether to change its name to "Republic of North Macedonia," a move that would resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece which had blocked its membership bids for the European Union and NATO.
rows.output: Mutanen Masedoniya sun yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Masedoniya," wanda zai warware rikicin da ya dade da yawa da Girka, wanda ya hana neman shiga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.source: Greece, which has a province called Macedonia, maintains that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has vetoed its entrance into NATO and the EU.
rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardin da ake kira Macedonia, tana da'awar cewa sunan kawarta ta arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankin ta, kuma ta hana ta shiga NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.source: The two governments struck a deal in June based on the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents argue the change would undermine the ethnic identity of Macedonia's Slavic majority population.
rows.output: Gwamnatin biyu sun yi yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da kishin kasa sun ce canza sunan zai raunana asalin al'adunabilan da ke da rinjaye a cikin al'ummar Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.source: President Gjorge Ivanov has said he will not be voting in the referendum and a boycott campaign has cast doubts on whether turnout will meet the minimum 50 percent required for the referendum to be valid.
rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a zaben ba kuma yunƙurin da aka yi na yin gangami ya haifar da shakkun cewa za a samu isassun kuri'u da ake bukata na 50 cikin 100 na yawan jama'a don a yi la'akari da zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.source: The question on the referendum ballot read: "Are you for NATO and EU membership with acceptance of the agreement with Greece."
rows.output: Tambayar da aka yi a kan kuri'ar referendum ta ce: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.source: Supporters of the name change, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that it is a price worth paying to pursue admission into bodies such as the EU and NATO for Macedonia, one of the countries to emerge from the collapse of Yugoslavia.
rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canjin sunan, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce hakan farashi ne da ya cancanci biyan domin neman shiga cikin jikina kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashe da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.source: "I came today to vote for the future of the country, for young people in Macedonia so they can be live freely under the umbrella of the European Union because it means safer lives for all of us," said Olivera Georgijevska, 79, in Skopje.
rows.output: "Na zo yau ne domin na yi wa makomar kasar, ga matasa a cikin Masedoniya don su sami damar rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga dukkanmu," in ji Olivera Georgijevska, 'yar shekara 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.source: Although not legally binding, enough members of parliament have said they will abide by the vote's outcome to make it decisive.
rows.output: Duk da cewa ba aatar da doka ba, da yawa daga cikin mambobin majalisar dokokin kasar sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon zaben, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama mai tasiri.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.source: The name change would requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.
rows.output: Sake suna zai buƙatar kashi biyu bisa uku na rinjaye a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.source: The state election commission said there had been no reports of irregularities by 1 p.m.
rows.output: Hukumar zaɓe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoton wani rashin daidaito ba da misalin ƙarfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.source: However, turnout stood at only 16 percent, compared to 34 percent in last parliamentary election in 2016 when 66 percent of the registered voters cast their ballot.
rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu zaɓe ta kasance kashi 16%, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34% a zaben majalisar dokokin ƙasar a shekarar 2016, lokacin da kashi 66% na masu rajista suka yi zaɓe.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.source: "I came out to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe," said Gjose Tanevski, 62, a voter in the capital, Skopje.
rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu yana Turai," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.source: Welsh AMs worried about 'looking like muppets'
rows.output: Ndị AM na Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.source: There is consternation among some AMs at a suggestion their title should change to MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro na aha ha ga-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.source: It has arisen because of plans to change the name of the assembly to the Welsh Parliament.
rows.output: Ọ bụ n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.source: AMs across the political spectrum are worried it could invite ridicule.
rows.output: Ndị AM na-agbago n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọasị ha.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.source: One Labour AM said his group was concerned "it rhymes with Twp and Pwp."
rows.output: Otu onye Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-amasị Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.source: For readers outside of Wales: In Welsh twp means daft and pwp means poo.
rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara ara ara na pwp pụtara ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.source: A Plaid AM said the group as a whole was "not happy" and has suggested alternatives.
rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị anụrị" ma tụ aro ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.source: A Welsh Conservative said his group was "open minded" about the name change, but noted it was a short verbal hop from MWP to Muppet.
rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha, mana kwuru na ọ bụ obere okwu okwu site na MWP gaa na Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.source: In this context The Welsh letter w is pronounced similarly to the Yorkshire English pronunciation of the letter u.
rows.output: N'ọnọdụ a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka okwu Yorkshire Bekee nke mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.source: The Assembly Commission, which is currently drafting legislation to introduce the name changes, said: "The final decision on any descriptors of what Assembly Members are called will of course be a matter for the members themselves."
rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-edepụta iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ maka ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Assembly na-akpọ ga-adị n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.source: The Government of Wales Act 2017 gave the Welsh assembly the power to change its name.
rows.output: Iwu Ọchịchị Wales 2017 nyere ndị kansụl Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.source: In June, the Commission published the results of a public consultation on the proposals which found broad support for calling the assembly a Welsh Parliament.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke nyocha ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ dị ka Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.source: On the matter of the AMs' title, the Commission favoured Welsh Parliament Members or WMPs, but the MWP option received the most support in a public consultation.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha ndị AMs, kọmịshọna ahụ kwadoro ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha n'ime nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.source: AMs are apparently suggesting alternative options, but the struggle to reach consensus could be a headache for the Presiding Officer, Elin Jones, who is expected to submit draft legislation on the changes within weeks.
rows.output: Ndị AM na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-esi ike iru nkwekọrịta ga-abụ isi ọwụwa maka Onye isi oche, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebufe akwụkwọ iwu na mgbanwe ndị ahụ n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.source: The legislation on the reforms will include other changes to the way the assembly works, including rules on disqualification of AMs and the design of the committee system.
rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ga-agụnyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otu esi arụ ọrụ ụlọ omebe iwu, gụnyere iwu gbasara nkwusioru nke AMs na nhazi nke usoro kọmiti.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.source: AMs will get the final vote on the question of what they should be called when they debate the legislation.
rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enwe votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha ga-akpọ mgbe ha na-eme ihe gbasara iwu.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.source: Macedonians go to polls in referendum on changing country's name
rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ụlọ ntuli aka na ntuli aka na-agbanwe aha obodo
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.source: Voters will vote Sunday on whether to change their country's name to the "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.output: Ndị na-ahọpụta ndị ga-ahọpụta Sọnde ma ọ bụrụ na ha ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.source: The popular vote was set up in a bid to resolve a decades-long dispute with neighboring Greece, which has its own province called Macedonia.
rows.output: A na-eme ntuli aka nke ndị mmadụ na-achọ ime ka esemokwu ogologo oge na mba dị n'akụkụ ya, nke a na-akpọ Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.source: Athens has long insisted that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has repeatedly objected to its membership bids for the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Ọchichiri Athens na-ekwu na aha onye agbata obi ya na-eweghachi ihe ọ na-ekwu na ya, ma na-emegide ya ugboro ugboro na ọ na-achọ ịbụ onye otu EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.source: Macedonian President Gjorge Ivanov, an opponent of the plebiscite on the name change, has said he will disregard the vote.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha, kwuru na ya gaaghị ele anya na ntuli aka ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.source: However, supporters of the referendum, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that the name change is simply the price to pay to join the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Otu ọ dị, ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-ekwu na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ihe a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.source: The Bells of St. Martin's Fall Silent as Churches in Harlem Struggle
rows.output: Ìgwè Bell nke St. Martin na-ajụ oyi ka ụka na Harlem na-alụ ọgụ
rows.reference: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba

rows.source: "Historically, the old people I've talked to say there was a bar and a church on every corner," Mr. Adams said.
rows.output: "N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, ndị okenye m kwuru na e nwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n'akụkụ ọ bụla," Mazị Adams kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.

rows.source: "Today, there's neither."
rows.output: "Taa, enweghị ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”

rows.source: He said the disappearance of bars was understandable.
rows.output: O kwuru na ịla n'iyi nke ụlọ mmanya bụ ihe a na-anabata.
rows.reference: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.

rows.source: "People socialize in a different way" nowadays, he said.
rows.output: "Ndị mmadụ na-akpakọrịrị n'ụzọ dị iche" ugbu a, o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.

rows.source: "Bars are no longer neighborhood living rooms where people go on a regular basis."
rows.output: "Bars anaghịzi adị ka ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga mgbe niile."
rows.reference: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”

rows.source: As for churches, he worries that the money from selling assets will not last as long as leaders expect it to, "and sooner or later they'll be right back where they started."
rows.output: Maka ụka, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya na ego sitere na ire ihe onwunwe agaghị adịru ogologo oge ka ndị isi na-atụ anya ya, "ma n'oge na-adịghị anya, ha ga-alaghachi ebe ha malitere."
rows.reference: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”

rows.source: Churches, he added, could be replaced by apartment buildings with condominiums filled with the kind of people who will not help the neighborhood's remaining sanctuaries.
rows.output: Ụka, o kwuru, nwere ike dochie ya na ụlọ ụlọ obibi nwere ụlọ obibi jupụtara na ụdị ndị gaaghị enyere ebe nsọ fọdụrụ n'obodo ahụ aka.
rows.reference: Ndị ụlọ ụka, o tinyere, na enwere ike iji nnukwu ụlọ obibi nwere dochie ha, nke eji ụdị ndị mmadụ na agaghị enyere aka n’ebe nsọ nke gburugburu ahụ fọdụrụ.

rows.source: "The overwhelming majority of people who buy condominiums in these buildings will be white," he said, "and therefore will hasten the day that these churches close altogether because it is unlikely that most of these people who move into these condominiums will become members of these churches."
rows.output: "Ndị ka ukwuu n'ime ndị na-azụ ụlọ n'ụlọ n'ime ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha," ka o kwuru, "na ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụlọ ụka ndị a mechie n'ihi na ọ gaghị adị ka ndị a na-aga n'ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị otu n'ime ụlọ ụka ndị a."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu imirikiti ndị mmadụ na azụta nkewa ụlọ n’ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha, “o kwuru, “ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụbọchị nke ndị ụlọ ụka a ga-emechi kpamkpam bịa ngwangwa n’ihi ọ ga-esi ike imirikiti ndị mmadụ na akwabata n’ime ụlọ ndị a bụrụ ndị otu nke ụlọ ụka ndị a.”

rows.source: Both churches were built by white congregations before Harlem became a black metropolis - Metropolitan Community in 1870, St. Martin's a decade later.
rows.output: Ndị ụka abụọ ahụ wuru ndị otu ọcha tupu Harlem bụrụ obodo ojii - Ụlọ Nzukọ Obodo na 1870, St. Martin's afọ iri ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ụka abụọ ahụ bụ ndị mgbakọ ndị ọcha rụrụ ha tupu Harlem abụrụ obodo ndị isi ojii - Ogbe Obodo Ukwuu na 1870, St. Martin bụ afọ iri ka emechara.

rows.source: The original white Methodist congregation moved out in the 1930s.
rows.output: Ndị ụka ọtụtụ ndị ọcha Methodist kwagara n'ebe ọzọ n'afọ 1930.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị Methodist nke izizi pụrụ na 1930.

rows.source: A black congregation that had been worshiping nearby took title to the building.
rows.output: Òtù ụka ojii nke na-efe ofufe n'akụkụ ya weghara ụlọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị isii ojii nọ na efe ofufe n’akụkụ wegara aha n’ụlọ ahụ.

rows.source: St. Martin's was taken over by a black congregation under the Rev. John Howard Johnson, who led a boycott of retailers on 125th Street, a main street for shopping in Harlem, who resisted hiring or promoting blacks.
rows.output: Ntuziaka St. Martin's nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ
rows.reference: Ndị ọgbakọ isi ojii weghara St. Martin n’okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson, onye duru mgbochi nke ndị mgbere ahịa dị na Okporo Ụzọ 125, isi okporo ụzọ maka ịzụ ahịa dị na Harlem, ndị gbochiri ịwere ma ọ bụ ịkwado ndị isi ojii n’ahịa.

rows.source: A fire in 1939 left the building badly damaged, but as Father Johnson's parishioners made plans to rebuild, they commissioned the carillon.
rows.output: Mgbọ na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nke ukwuu, ma ka ndị parish Father Johnson na-eme atụmatụ imeghari ya, ha nyere iwu ka a na-arụ ọrụ carillon.
rows.reference: Ọkụ gbara na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nnukwu, mana ka ndị ụka nke Fada Johnson haziri ịrụgharị ụlọ ahụ, ha rụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ.

rows.source: The Rev. David Johnson, Father Johnson's son and successor at St. Martin's, proudly called the carillon "the poor people's bells."
rows.output: Onye isi David Johnson, nwa nke Onye Nsọ Johnson na onye ga-anọchi ya na St. Martin's, na-enwe obi ụtọ na-akpọpụta carillon "ụmụnna ndị ogbenye."
rows.reference: Rev. David Johnson, nwa Fada Johnson yana onye nọchiri na St. Martin, ji obi aṅụrị kpọọ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ “mgbịrịmgba nke ndị ogbenye.”

rows.source: The expert who played the carillon in July called it something else: "A cultural treasure" and "an irreplaceable historical instrument."
rows.output: Onye ọkachamara nke na-egwu carillon n'ọnwa Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: "ihe nketa omenala" na "ngwongwo akụkọ ihe mere eme na-anọchi anya ya."
rows.reference: Ọkachamara onye kụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ na Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: “Akụ omenala” yana “akụrụngwa akụkọ ihe mere eme enweghị ike idochi.”

rows.source: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.
rows.output: Onye ọkachamara, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum Michigan, kwuru na ọ bụ ụgbọ ala mbụ n'ụwa nke ndị na-egwu egwu ojii na-egwu, Dionisio A. Lind, onye kwagara n'ụgbọala buru ibu n'ụlọ ụka Riverside afọ iri na asatọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọkachamara ahụ, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum nke Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ igwe mgbịrịmgba izizi dị n’ụwa nke onye egwu isi ojii ga-akpọ, Dionisio A. Lind, onye nke gara n’igwe mgbịrịmgba ka ibu dị na Ụlọ Ụka Riverside afọ 18 gara aga.

rows.source: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.
rows.output: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin's emeghị ka ọ dochie ya.
rows.reference: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin anọchighi ya.

rows.source: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.
rows.output: Ihe mere na St. Martin's n'ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga bụ akụkọ mgbagwoju anya nke ndị na-ewu ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ, ụfọdụ ndị e wetere site n'aka ndị isi ụka, ndị ọzọ site n'aka diocese Anglican.
rows.reference: Ihe akpọrọ na St. Martin n’ofe ọnwa ole ma ole gara aga bụ akụkọ nke ndị ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta gbagwojuru anya, ụfọdụ nke ndị ndu nke ụlọ ụka ahụ webatara, ndị ọzọ bụ nke ngalaba ụka dị n’okpuru ọchịchị ndị Bishọpụ.

rows.source: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ vestry - ndị isi ụlọ ụka, nke ndị na-abụghị ndị ụkọchukwu mejupụtaworo - dere n'ụlọ ụka n'ọnwa Julaị na nchegbu na ụlọ ụka ahụ "ga-achọ ịgafe ụgwọ" na vestry, n'agbanyeghị na vestry ahụ etinyeghị aka na ịhọpụta ndị na-ese ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ ụlọ ụka ahụ zigara.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọzụzụ - otu nchịkwa nke ụlọ ụka ahụ, nke ndị ndu juputara - degara ngalaba ụka ahụ na Julaị maka echiche na ngalaba ụka ahụ “ga-achọ ịnyefe ụgwọ ndị ahụ” n’aka ụlọ ozuzu ahụ, ọbụlagodi na ụlọ ozuzu ahụ etinyeghị aka na iwere ndi ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta na ngalaba ụka ahụ ezitere.

rows.source: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị na-aga ụka ekwupụtala enweghị nghọta gbasara akụkụ diocese ahụ.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị ụka kpesara ụkọ nke mkpughe na ngalaba ụka ahụ.

rows.source: Shark injures 13-year-old on lobster dive in California
rows.output: Nkịta ahụ merụrụ nwa afọ iri na atọ ahụ mgbe ọ na-egwu mmiri lobster na California
rows.reference: Shark merụrụ nwa afọ 13 ahụ na mmanye lọbsta dị na California

rows.source: A shark attacked and injured a 13-year-old boy Saturday while he was diving for lobster in California on the opening day of lobster season, officials said.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, otu shark wakporo ma merụọ otu nwa nwoke dị afọ 13 ahụ mgbe ọ na-egwu mmiri maka lobster na California n'ụbọchị mmalite nke oge lobster, ndị ọrụ kwuru.
rows.reference: Shark makpuru ma merụọ nwa nwoke afọ 13 ahụ na Satọde ka ọ na amanye na mmiri maka lọbsta na California n’ụbọchị mmepe nke oge lọbsta, ndị ikike kwuru.

rows.source: The attack occurred just before 7 a.m. near Beacon's Beach in Encinitas.
rows.output: Mwakpo ahụ mere n'oge dị nso na elekere asaa nke ụtụtụ n'akụkụ Beacon's Beach dị na Encinitas.
rows.reference: Mmakpu ahụ mere tupu 7 ụtụtụ n’akụkụ Osimiri nke Beacon na Encinitas.

rows.source: Chad Hammel told KSWB-TV in San Diego he had been diving with friends for about half an hour Saturday morning when he heard the boy screaming for help and then paddled over with a group to help pull him out of the water.
rows.output: Chad Hammel gwara KSWB-TV na San Diego na ya na ndị enyi ya na-egwu mmiri ihe dị ka ọkara awa n'ụbọchị Satọde mgbe ọ nụrụ nwata nwoke na-akwa ákwá maka enyemaka ma mesịa pụọ n'ime mmiri na otu ndị ọzọ na-enyere aka ịdọpụ ya n'ime mmiri.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel gwara KSWB-TV na San Diego na ya na ndị enyi nọ na amanye na mmiri ihe dị ka ọkara aka elekere n’ụtụtụ Satọde mgbe ọ nụrụ ka nwa nwoke ahụ na eti mkpu enyemaka, mgbe ahụ ya na ụfọdụ kworo ụgbọ gafee iji nyere aka dọpụta ya n’ime mmiri.

rows.source: Hammel said at first he thought it was just excitement of catching a lobster, but then he "realized that he was yelling, 'I got bit!
rows.output: Hammel kwuru na mbụ o chere na ọ bụ naanị obi ụtọ nke ijide lobster, ma mgbe ahụ ọ "mata na ọ na-eti mkpu, 'Ejiri m ya!"
rows.reference: Hammel kwuru n’izizi na ọ chere na ọ bụ ihe ọhụụ nke ijide lọbsta, mana mgbe ahụ ọ “chọpụtara na ọ na eti, “atara m!

rows.source: I got bit!'
rows.output: A kụrụ m!
rows.reference: Atara m!'

rows.source: His whole clavicle was ripped open," Hammel said he noticed once he got to the boy.
rows.output: Mkpịsị aka ya niile gbawara agbawa," ka Hammel kwuru na ọ hụrụ mgbe ọ rutere nwa ahụ.
rows.reference: Adọpuru ọkpụkpụ ụkwụ ya niile, “ Hammel kwuru na ọ chọpụtara ozugbo o rutere nwa nwoke ahụ.

rows.source: "I yelled at everyone to get out of the water: 'There's a shark in the water!'" Hammel added.
rows.output: "Agwara m onye ọ bụla ka ọ pụọ n'ime mmiri: 'Enwere shark n'ime mmiri!'" Hammel gbakwunyere.
rows.reference: “Etiri m mkpu ka mmadụ niile pụta na mmiri ahụ: ‘Enwere shark n’ime mmiri ahụ!”” Hammel tinyere.

rows.source: The boy was airlifted to Rady Children's Hospital in San Diego where he is listed in critical condition.
rows.output: Ebuliri nwata nwoke ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe a na-edobe ya n'ọnọdụ dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Eji ụgbọ elu buru nwa nwoke ahụ gaa Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe edebanyere ya n’ọnọdụ ihe egwu.

rows.source: The species of shark responsible for the attack was unknown.
rows.output: Ụdị shark nke na-ahụ maka mwakpo ahụ amabeghị.
rows.reference: Amaghị ụdị nke shark mere mmakpu ahụ.

rows.source: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles said at a media briefing that a shark had been spotted in the area a few weeks earlier, but it was determined not to be a dangerous species of shark.
rows.output: Onye nche mmiri Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nnọkọ mgbasa ozi na a hụrụ shark n'ógbè ahụ izu ole na ole gara aga, mana a chọpụtara na ọ bụghị ụdị shark dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nchịkọta akụkọ na ahụrụ shark na mpaghara ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, mana ekpebiri na ọ bụghị ụdị shark jọrọ njọ.

rows.source: Giles added the victim sustained traumatic injuries to his upper torso area.
rows.output: Giles gbakwunyere na onye ahụ merela ahụ́ nke mere ka ọ bụrụ ihe mgbu n'akụkụ elu ahụ.
rows.reference: Giles tinyere na onye ahụ ihe mere nwere mmerụ ahụ buru ibu n’akụkụ elu ahụ ya.

rows.source: Officials shut down beach access from Ponto Beach in Casablad to Swami's in Ecinitas for 48 hours for investigation and safety purposes.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ mechiri ụzọ ịbata n'ụsọ osimiri site na Ponto Beach na Casablanca ruo Swami's na Encinitas maka awa 48 maka nyocha na nchekwa.
rows.reference: Ndị ikike mechiri osimiri ahụ bido na Akụkụ Osimiri Ponto dị na Casablad ruo Swami dị na Ecinitas n’ime aka elekere 48 maka ebumnuche nnyocha na nchedo.

rows.source: Giles noted that there are more than 135 shark species in the area, but most are not considered dangerous.
rows.output: Giles kwuru na e nwere ihe karịrị ụdị shark 135 n'ógbè ahụ, mana ọtụtụ n’ime ha anaghị ewerekarị na ha dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Giles kwukwara na enwere karịa ụdị shark 135 dị na mpaghara ahụ, mana anaghị ahụta imirikiti ka ndị jọrọ njọ.

rows.source: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market
rows.output: Atụmatụ Sainsbury na-abanye n'ahịa mma UK
rows.reference: Atụmatụ nke Sainbury ịbanye n’ahịa ihe ịchọ mma nke UK

rows.source: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.
rows.output: Sainsbury's na-alụ ọgụ na Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams na ngalabu ụlọ ahịa nke nwere ebe a na-ere ihe ịchọ mma nke ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọrụ na-ahụ maka ya.
rows.reference: Sainbury na eche Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams aka mgba site na iji warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma nwere nka-ụlọ ahịa eji ndị enyemaka ọkachamara kpojuo.

rows.source: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.
