rows.output: Dị ka akụkụ nke mbọ dị ukwuu n'ime ahịa mma UK £2.8bn, nke na-aga n'ihu na-eto eto ebe ahịa ejiji na homeware na-alaghachi azụ, a ga-anwale nnukwu ebe a na-ere mma n'ụlọ ahịa 11 n'ofe obodo ahụ ma were ya na ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n'afọ na-esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-aga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Dị akụkụ nke ọkpụrụkpụ mbanye n’ime ahịa ihe ịchọ mma £2.8n nke UK, nke na aga n’ihu etolite ebe ahịa uwe na ngwa ụlọ na alaghachi, a ga-anwale warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma n’ime ụlọ ahịa 11 na gburugburu obodo ahụ ma buga ya n’ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n’afọ na esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gaa nke ọma.

rows.source: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.
rows.output: Ịzụ ahịa na mma na-abịa n'oge a na-eme ka ụlọ ahịa na-achọ ụzọ iji mee ka oghere shelf ndị a na-eji eme ihe na mbụ maka TV, igwe ọkụ, na ihe ndị dị n'ụlọ.
rows.reference: Nkwanye ego n’ihe ịchọ mma na abịa ka ụlọ ahịa na achụ ụzọ iji mejuo oghere nke edobeburu maka Igwe onyonyoo, mikrowevụ na ngwa ụlọ.

rows.source: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.
rows.output: Sainsbury's kwuru na ọ ga-abụ na ọ ga-abụ okpukpu abụọ nke ngwaahịa ịchọ mma ya ruo ihe ruru 3,000, gụnyere ụdị dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw maka oge mbụ.
rows.reference: Sainsbury kwuru na ọ ga-abasa nha nke ngwaahịa ihe ịchọ mma ya ruo ngwaahịa 3,000, gụnyere ụlọ ọrụ dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw nke izizi.

rows.source: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.
rows.output: Ndị dị adị site na L'Oreal, Maybelline na Burt's Bees ga-enwekwukwa oghere karịa ebe a na-ere ahịa nke yiri nke a na-ahụ n'ụlọ ahịa dị ka Boots.
rows.reference: Oke ndị dị adị malite na L'Oreal, Maybelline na Burt’s Bees ga-enwetakwa oghere na mpaghara nwere akara yitere ndị ahụ ahụrụ n’ụlọ ahịa dị ka Boots.

rows.source: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.
rows.output: Ahịa ahụ na-eme ka ụlọ ahịa ya na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọtụtụ ngwaahịa na-adịghị erigbu - ihe a na-achọkarị site n'aka ndị na-azụ ahịa na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ na amalitegharị ahịa ihe ịchọ mma Ụlọ Ahịa ya ka imirikiti ngwaahịa ahụ bụrụ nke na emejọghị ụmụ anụmanụ - ihe ndị ahịa na etolite na achọ nnukwu ugbu a.

rows.source: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.
rows.output: N'ikwekwa, onye na-ere isi ụtọ, The Fragrance Shop, ga-anwale ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury abụọ, nke mbụ nke mepere emepe na Croydon, London ndịda, n'izu gara aga, ebe nke abụọ ga-emeghe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, n'oge a.
rows.reference: Na mgbakwunye, ndị mgbere isi ụtọ Fragrance Shop ga-anwale ikikere n’ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury abụọ, nke izizi emepere na Croydon, ndịda London, izu gara aga ebe nke abụọ ga-emepe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, emechaa n’afọ a.

rows.source: Online shopping and a shift towards buying small amounts of food daily at local convenience stores means supermarkets are having to do more to persuade people to visit.
rows.output: Ịzụ ahịa n'ịntanetị na mgbanwe n'ịzụta obere nri kwa ụbọchị n'ụlọ ahịa dị n'ógbè na-eme ka ndị na-ere ahịa na-eme ihe ọzọ iji mee ka ndị mmadụ gaa.
rows.reference: Ịzụ ahịa n’ịntanetị na mbugharị gaa na ịzụ obere nri kwa ụbọchị na ntakịrị ụlọ ahịa dị na mpaghara pụtara na ndị nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na enwekwu ọrụ ịrụ iji mee ka ndị mmadụ bịa.

rows.source: Mike Coupe, the chief executive of Sainsbury's, has said the outlets will look increasingly like department stores as the supermarket chain tries to fight back against the discounters Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food.
rows.output: Mike Coupe, onye isi oche nke Sainsbury's, kwuru na ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ ga-adị ka ụlọ ahịa dị ka ụlọ ahịa na-agbalị ịluso ndị na-ebelata ọnụ ahịa Aldi na Lidl ọgụ na ọrụ ndị ọzọ na ihe na-abụghị nri.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, onye isi oche nke Sainsbury, ekwuola na obere ụlọ ahịa ga-aga n’ihu n adịkwa ka nnukwu ụlọ ahịa nke ụlọ ahịa ebe ngalaba nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na anwa ịchụghachi ndị mwepu ego Aldi na Lidl site na ijikwu ọrụ na ihe ndị abụghị nri.

rows.source: Sainsbury's has been putting Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also introduced a number of Habitats since it bought both chains two years ago, which it says has bolstered grocery sales and made the acquisitions more profitable.
rows.output: Sainsbury's etinyewo ụlọ ahịa Argos n'ime ụlọ ahịa narị na iri na abụọ ma webatakwa ọtụtụ ụlọ ahịa Habitat kemgbe ọ zụtara ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ahụ afọ abụọ gara aga, nke ọ na-ekwu na ọ bulitere ahịa nri na ime ka ịzụrụ ụlọ ahịa ahụ bụrụ ihe bara uru.
rows.reference: Sainsbury na etinye obere ụlọ ahịa Argos n’ọtụtụ ọdụ ahịa, o bubatakwara ọnụọgụ Habitats pụtara ihie kemgbe ọ zụtara ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ndị ahụ afọ abụọ gara aga, nke o kwuru bawanyere ahịa nri ma mee ka nzụrụ ahụ mụtakwuo uru.

rows.source: The supermarket's previous attempt to revamp its beauty and pharmacy departments ended in failure.
rows.output: Ntugharị ụlọ ahịa ahụ na mbọ ọ na-agbalị imeghari ngalaba mma na ụlọ ọgwụ ya kwụsịrị n'ụzọ dị iche.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa nnukwu ụlọ ahịa gara aga iji bidogharịa ọdụ ịchọ na ịre ọgwụ agaghị nke ọma.

rows.source: Sainsbury's tested a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the tie-up ended after a row over how to split the revenues from the chemist's stores in its supermarkets.
rows.output: N'afọ 2000, Sainsbury's mere nnwale njikọ aka na Boots, mana njikọ ahụ kwụsịrị mgbe esemokwu dara n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu ego sitere na ụlọ ahịa ọgwụ na ụlọ ahịa ya.
rows.reference: Sainsbury nwalere ahịa njikọta n’etiti Boots na mbido 2000, mana njikọta ahụ jedebere ka enwesịrị esemokwu gbasara otu a ga-esi kee uru si na ọdụ ahịa ndị na ere ọgwụ n’ime nnukwu ụlọ ndị ahịa ya.

rows.source: The new strategy comes after Sainsbury's sold its 281-store pharmacy business to Celesio, the owner of the Lloyds Pharmacy chain, for £125m, three years ago.
rows.output: Nkwekọrịta ọhụrụ ahụ na-abịa mgbe Sainsbury rere azụmahịa ụlọ ọgwụ 281 ya na Celesio, onye nwere Lloyds Pharmacy, maka nde £125, afọ atọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ụkpụrụ ọhụrụ na abịa ka Sainsbury resịrị ahịa ịre ọgwụ dị ọnụọgụ ụlọ ahịa 281 n’aka Celesio, onye nwe ụlọ ọrụ Lloyds Pharmacy, ihe erere ya bụ £125m, afọ atọ gara aga.

rows.source: It said Lloyds would play a role in the plan, by adding an extended range of luxury skincare brands including La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores.
rows.output: Ọ sịrị na Lloyds ga-arụ ọrụ na atụmatụ ahụ, site n'ịgbakwunye ụdị ọgwụ anụ ahụ dị elu dị iche iche gụnyere La Roche-Posay na Vichy n'ime ụlọ ahịa anọ.
rows.reference: O kwuru na Lloyds ga-arụ ọrụ n’atụmatụ ahụ, site na itinye oke nke ụlọ ahịa nlekọta anụahụ ama ama dọtịrị adọtị dị ka La Roche-Posay na Vichy n’ụlọ ahịa anọ.

rows.source: Paul Mills-Hicks, Sainsbury's commercial director, said: "We've transformed the look and feel of our beauty aisles to enhance the environment for our customers.
rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, onye isi azụmahịa Sainsbury, kwuru: "Anyị agbanweela ọdịdị na mmetụta nke ngalabu anyị mara mma iji mee ka ebe obibi maka ndị ahịa anyị dịkwuo mma.
rows.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, onye ndu ọrịre ahịa nke Sainsbury, kwuru: “Anyị agbanweela nhụta na mmetụta nke warawara ụzọ ihe ịchọ mma anyị iji bulite gburugburu maka ndị ahịa anyị.

rows.source: We've also invested in specially trained colleagues who will be on hand to offer advice.
rows.output: Anyị etinyelakwa ego n'ụmụnna ndị a zụrụ n'ụzọ pụrụ iche bụ́ ndị ga-anọnyere gị iji nye ndụmọdụ.
rows.reference: Anyị etinyekwala ego na ndị ọrụ azụrụ iche ndị ga-anọ ozugbo iji nye ndụmọdụ.

rows.source: Our range of brands is designed to suit every need and the alluring environment and convenient locations mean we're now a compelling beauty destination which challenges the old way of shopping."
rows.output: "Ụdị ụdị anyị na-adabara mkpa ọ bụla ma gburugburu ebe obibi na-adọrọ mmasị na ebe dị mma na-eme ka anyị bụrụ ebe mara mma nke na-eme ka ịzụ ahịa dị iche na ụzọ ochie."
rows.reference: Ezubere oke nke akara anyị iji dabaa na mkpa niile, gburugburu mara mma na ọnọdụ dị mma pụtara na anyị na akwalite ebe ịchọ mma nke na ama aka n’etiti ụzọ ochie eji azụ ahịa.

rows.source: Peter Jones 'furious' after Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal
rows.output: Peter Jones na-enwe "iwe" mgbe Holly Willoughby wepụrụ na nkwekọrịta £11million
rows.reference: ‘Iwe’ ji Peter Jones ka Holly Willoughby sepụrụ aka na nkwekọrịta £11million

rows.source: Dragons Den star Peter Jones left 'furious' after TV presenter Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal with his lifestyle brand business to focus on her new contracts with Marks and Spencer and ITV
rows.output: Nkịta Nkịta Peter Jones hapụrụ 'iwe' mgbe onye na-eme ihe nkiri TV Holly Willoughby na-apụ na £11million na-eme ihe nkiri na ụlọ ọrụ ihe nkiri ya iji lekọta nkwekọrịta ọhụrụ ya na Marks and Spencer na ITV.
rows.reference: Onye nke Dragons Den ama ama bụ Peter Jones juputara ‘n’iwe’ ka onye mgbasa ozi TV Holly Willoughby sepụrụ aka na nkwekọrịta £11million dị n’etiti azụmahịa obibi ndụ ya iji gbado anya na nkwekọrịta ọhụrụ ya dị n’etiti Marks and Spencer yana ITV

rows.source: Willoughby has no time for their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: Willoughby enweghị oge maka uwe na ihe ịchọ mma ha nke bụ nke a na-akpọ Truly.
rows.reference: Willoughby enweghị oge maka ahịa uwe ụlọ na akụrụngwa ha bụ Truly.

rows.source: The pair's business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand.
rows.output: Ndị na-eme ihe ọnụ na azụmahịa ha ka a na-atụnyere na akara Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop.
rows.reference: Atụnyela azụmahịa ha abụọ n’ahịa Goop nke Gwyneth Paltrow.

rows.source: This Morning presenter, 37, took to Instagram to announce she is leaving.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe ngosi ụtụtụ a, 37, gara na Instagram ịkọwa na ọ na-apụ.
rows.reference: Onye mgbasa ozi This Morning, 37, gara na Instagram iji kwupute na ọ na apụ.

rows.source: Holly Willoughby has left Dragons" Den star Peter Jones fuming by pulling out of their lucrative lifestyle brand business at the last minute - to focus on her own new bumper contracts with Marks & Spencer and ITV.
rows.output: Holly Willoughby apụọla n'ụlọikwuu Peter Jones site n'ịla n'iyi n'azịza ha na-eme ego na-amasị ha n'oge ikpeazụ - iji lekọta ihe ndị ọzọ na-amasị ya na Marks & Spencer na ITV.
rows.reference: Holly Willoughby ahapụla onye nke eji Dragons” Den mara bụ Peter Jones n’iwe site na ịmapụ n’azụmahịa obibi ndụ ha na aga nke ọma n’oge ikpeazụ - iji gbado anya na nkwekọrịta ọhụrụ nke ya mara oke ọma dị n’etiti Marks & Spencer na ITV.

rows.source: Sources say Jones was "furious" when TV's golden girl admitted during a tense meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of his business empire in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, that her new deals - worth up to £1.5 million - meant she no longer had enough time to devote to their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: Njirimara na-ekwu na Jones "iwe" mgbe TV's golden girl kwuru n'oge nnọkọ na Tuesday na isi ụlọ ọrụ nke azụmahịa ya na Marlow, Buckinghamshire, na nkwekọrita ọhụrụ ya - ruru £1.5 nde - pụtara na ọ nweghịzi oge zuru ezu iji nye ha homewear na accessories brand Truly.
rows.reference: Ndị akụkọ kwuru na Jones were ‘iwe’ mgbe nwata nwanyị nke TV ahụrụ n’anya nke ukwuu kwetere n’oge nzụkọ iwe emere na Tuesday n’isi ụlọ ọrụ nke ụlọ azụmahịa ya dị na Marlow, Buckinghamshire, na nkwekọrịta ọhụrụ ya - ruru £1.5 million - pụtara na ọ nweghịzị oge zuru oke iji tinye uche na ahịa uwe ụlọ na akụrụngwa ha bụ Truly.

rows.source: The business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand and was tipped to double Willoughby's estimated £11 million fortune.
rows.output: Azụmahịa ahụ e ji atụnyere akara Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop na e kwuru na ọ ga-abụriri ego Willoughby ruru nde £11.
rows.reference: Atụnyere azụmahịa ahụ ka ahịa Goop nke Gwyneth Paltrow, eburu amụma na ọ ga-ebuwanye akụ nke Willoughby ekpebiri na £11 million ugboro abụọ.

rows.source: As Willoughby, 37, took to Instagram to announce she was leaving Truly, Jones jetted out of Britain to head for one of his holiday homes.
rows.output: Ka Willoughby, 37, si na Instagram na ọ pụọ na Truly, Jones fepụrụ na Britain gaa n'otu n'ime ụlọ ezumike ya.
rows.reference: Ka Willoughby, 37, gara na Instagram iji kwupute na ọ na apụ Truly, Jones pụrụ na Britain iji gaa n’otu ụlọ ezumike ya.

rows.source: A source said: "Truly was by far the top of Holly's priorities.
rows.output: Otu onye isi kwuru: "N'ezie bụ nke kacha mkpa n'ime ihe ndị Holly na-eme."
rows.reference: Otu isi akụkọ kwuru: “Truly n’ezie kachasị na mkpa nke Holly.

rows.source: It was going to be her long-term future that would see her through the next couple of decades.
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ n'ọdịnihu ogologo oge nke ga-eme ka ọ dị ndụ n'ime afọ ole na ole na-abịa.
rows.reference: Ọ kwesịrị ịbụ ọdịnihu ya n’oteaka nke ga-elekọta ya n’afọ iri ndị na esote n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: Her decision to pull out left everyone involved absolutely stunned.
rows.output: Mkpebi ya ịla n'iyi hapụrụ onye ọ bụla na-etinye aka n'ụjọ.
rows.reference: Mkpebi ya iji pụọ hapụrụ mmadụ niile tinyere aka n’ọgbaghara.

rows.source: Nobody could believe what was happening on Tuesday, it was so close to the launch.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ikwere ihe na-eme na Tuzdee, ọ dị nso nke ukwuu na mmalite.
rows.reference: Ọnweghị onye nwere ike ịkwenye ihe na eme na Tusde, ọ bịara nso nke ukwu na mmalite.

rows.source: There is a warehouse full of goods at the Marlow HQ which are ready to be sold."
rows.output: E nwere ụlọ nchekwa nke ihe dị n'ụlọ ọrụ Marlow nke dị njikere ire ere."
rows.reference: Enwere ụlọ nkwakọba ahịa nke ngwaahịa juputara dị na Isi Ụlọ Ọrụ Marlow nke dị njikere maka ọrịre.”

rows.source: Experts believe the departure of the This Morning presenter, who is among Britain's most bankable stars, could cost the firm millions due to hefty investment in products ranging from cushions and candles to clothing and homewear, and the potential for further delays to its launch.
rows.output: Ndị ọkachamara kwenyere na ọpụpụ onye na-egosi ụtụtụ a, onye bụ otu n'ime kpakpando kacha enwe obi ike na Britain, nwere ike ịkpata ụgwọ ndị na-etinye ego n'ụlọ ọrụ ahụ n'ọtụtụ nde pound n'ihi nnukwu ego e tinyere n'ime ngwaahịa dị iche iche dị ka cushions na kandụl ruo uwe na uwe ụlọ, na ihe ndị nwere ike ime ka a kwụsịtuo mwube ya.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkachamara kwenyere na ọpụpụ nke onye mgbasa ozi This Morning, onye nke so na ndị ama ama na Britain na amịta ego, nwere ike iri ụlọ ahịa ahụ nde ego n’ihi nnukwu nkwanye ego na ngwaahịa sitere na oche yana kandụl ruo n’akwa na uwe ụlọ, yana ohere maka ogbugbu oge ọzọ na mmalite ya.

rows.source: And it could mean the end of a long friendship.
rows.output: Ọ pụkwara ịbụ njedebe nke enyi ogologo oge.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike ịbụ njedebe nke ogologo ọyị ahụ.

rows.source: Mother-of-three Willoughby and husband Dan Baldwin have been close to Jones and his wife Tara Capp for ten years.
rows.output: Nwanyị nke nwere ụmụ atọ, Willoughby na di ya Dan Baldwin, ejirila afọ iri na ndị enyi na ndị nwunye ha bụ Jones na Tara Capp.
rows.reference: Nne nke ụmụ atọ Willoughby na dị ya Dan Baldwin bụ enyi Jones na nwunye ya Tara Capp ihe dị ka afọ iri.

rows.source: Willoughby set up Truly with Capp in 2016 and Jones, 52, joined as chairman in March.
rows.output: Willoughby hiwere Truly na Capp na 2016, Jones, 52, sonyeere dị ka onye isi oche na Maachị.
rows.reference: Willoughby na Capp bidoro Truly na 2016, Jones, 52, sonyere dị ka onye isi na Machị.

rows.source: The couples holiday together and Jones has a 40 per cent stake in Baldwin's TV production firm.
rows.output: Ndị di na nwunye na ezumike ọnụ na Jones nwere pasent 40 na ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta ihe TV Baldwin.
rows.reference: Di na nwunye ndị ahụ na agakọta ego ezumike ọnụ, Jones nwere oke n’akụ pasentị 40 n’ụlọ ọrụ mgbasa ozi TV nke Baldwin.

rows.source: Willoughby is to become a brand ambassador for M&S and will replace Ant McPartlin as host of ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.output: Willoughby ga-abụ onye nnọchi anya ihe nlereanya maka M& S, ọ ga-anọchi anya Ant McPartlin dị ka onye na-eweta ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.reference: Willoughby ga-abụrụ onye nnọchite ụlọ ọrụ nke M&S, ọ ga-anọchi Ant McPartlin dị ka onye nlekọta nke I’m A Celebrity nke ITV.

rows.source: A source close to Jones said last night "We wouldn't comment on his business affairs."
rows.output: Otu onye dị nso na Jones kwuru n'abalị gara aga, "Anyị agaghị ekwupụta ihe gbasara azụmahịa ya."
rows.reference: Otu onye nọketere Jones nso kwuru abalị ụnyahụ “Anyị enwenwughi ike ikwu okwu gbasara azụmahịa ya.”

rows.source: Tough talk 'and then we fell in love'
rows.output: Okwesiri ikwu okwu 'na anyị hụrụ onwe anyị n'anya'
rows.reference: Okwu siri ike ‘mgbe ahụ anyị hụ onwe anyị n’anya’

rows.source: He joked about criticism he would get from the news media for making a comment some would consider "unpresidential" and for being so positive about the North Korean leader.
rows.output: Ọ na-akwa emo banyere nkatọ ọ ga-enweta site n'aka ndị mgbasa ozi maka ikwuputa ihe ụfọdụ ga-ewere dị ka "enweghị onye isi ala" na maka na ọ dị nnọọ mma gbasara onye isi North Korea.
rows.reference: Ọ mara njakịrị maka okwu asị ọ ga-enweta n’aka ndị mgbasa ozi maka ikwu okwu ụfọdụ a ga-ahụta ka nke na adịghị “n’usoro onye isi ala” yana maka ịnwe ezi okwukwe maka onye isi ala nke North Korean.

rows.source: Why has President Trump given up so much?
rows.output: Gịnị mere Onye isi ala Trump ji hapụ ọtụtụ ihe?
rows.reference: Gịnị kpatara Onye Isi Ala Trump ji gbaghara nke ukwuu?

rows.source: Trump said in his mock "news anchor" voice.
rows.output: Trump kwuru n'olu ya "onye na-eme ihe nkiri akụkọ."
rows.reference: Trump kwuru n’olu “onye nta akụkọ” ịkpa amụ ya.

rows.source: "I didn't give up anything."
rows.output: "Anaghị m enyefe ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Enweghi ihe ọ bụla m hapụrụ.”

rows.source: He noted that Kim is interested in a second meeting after their initial meeting in Singapore in June was hailed by Trump as a big step toward denuclearization of North Korea.
rows.output: Ọ kọwara na Kim nwere mmasị na nzukọ nke abụọ ka nzukọ mbụ ha na Singapore na June gasịrị, nke Trump kọwara dị ka nnukwu ihe ịga nke ọma n'ịtụgharị North Korea.
rows.reference: O kwukwara na Kim nwere mmasị na nzụkọ nke abụọ ka ha zutechara izizi na Singapore na Juun nke Trump toro ka nnukwu nzọụkwụ na iwepusi nnukwu ngwa agha nuklịa nke North Korea.

rows.source: But denuclearization negotiations have stalled.
rows.output: Mana mkparịta ụka denuclearization agbachiela.
rows.reference: Mana mkparịta ụka iwepu ngwa agha nuklịa akwụsịtụla.

rows.source: More than three months after the June summit in Singapore, North Korea's top diplomat Ri Yong Ho told world leaders at the U.N. General Assembly Saturday that the North doesn't see a "corresponding response" from the U.S. to North Korea's early disarmament moves.
rows.output: N'ime ọnwa atọ na-erughị eru ka nzukọ June gasịrị na Singapore, onye nnọchi anya North Korea bụ Ri Yong Ho gwara ndị isi ụwa na nzukọ U.N. General Assembly na Satọde na North Korea enweghị "azịza na-akwadebe" site na U.S. na mmegharị ịkwatu ngwugwu North Korea.
rows.reference: Karịa ọnwa atọ ka enwechara nzụkọ Juun na Singapore, onye nnọchite anya nke North Korea dị elu Ri Yong gwara ndị isi ụwa na U.N. Mgbakọ Ezumezu na Satọde na North anaghị ahụ “nzaghachi kwekọrọ” n’aka U.S. maka arụmọrụ gboo na iwepu ngwa agha nke North Korea.

rows.source: Instead, he noted, the U.S. is continuing sanctions aimed at keeping up pressure.
rows.output: Kama, o kwuru, na U.S. na-aga n'ihu na-eweda iwu iwu na-eme ka nrụgide dị.
rows.reference: Kama, o kwukwara, ndị U.S. na aga n’ihu etinye ntaramahụhụ emere iji na akwanye ọkụ.

rows.source: Trump took a much more optimistic view in his rally speech.
rows.output: Trump wepụrụ echiche dị mma n'okwu ya na-eme mkpesa.
rows.reference: Trump soro echiche ezi okwukwe n’okwu nchịkọta ya.

rows.source: "We're doing great with North Korea," he said.
rows.output: Anyị na-eme nke ọma na North Korea, "ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị na eme nnukwu ihe na North Korea,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "We were going to war with North Korea.
rows.output: Anyị na-aga agha na North Korea.
rows.reference: “Anyị na North Korea chọburu ịlụ ọgụ.

rows.source: Millions of people would have been killed.
rows.output: Puku nde mmadụ ga-anwụ.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ nde nke ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịnwụ.

rows.source: Now we have this great relationship."
rows.output: Ugbu a, anyị nwere mmekọrịta dị ukwuu."
rows.reference: Ugbu a anyị nwere nnukwu ezi ọyị”

rows.source: He said his efforts to improve relations with Kim have brought positive results - ending rocket tests, helping free hostages and getting the remains of American servicemen returned home.
rows.output: O kwuru na mbọ ya ime ka ndị Kim na-emekọ ihe ọnụ emela ka ihe dị mma pụta - kwụsị ule rọketi, inye aka ịtọhapụ ndị e ji e ji na iweghachi ihe ndị agha America nwụrụ anwụ n'ụlọ.
rows.reference: O kwuru na mbọ ya iji melite mmerịkọta n’etiti Kim ewetele nsonaazụ ndị mara mma - ịkwụsị nnwale rọketị, ịnyere aka hapụ ndị eji eji yana iweghachite ụlọ ihe ndị fọdụrụ na ndị agha America nwụrụ anwụ.

rows.source: And he defended his unusual approach in talking about relations with Kim.
rows.output: Ọ na-agbachitere ụzọ ya pụrụ iche n'okwu banyere mmekọrịta ya na Kim.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa ọ gbachitere usoro ya dị iche n’ikwu maka mmerịkọta yana Kim.

rows.source: "It's so easy to be presidential, but instead of having 10,000 people outside trying to get into this packed arena, we'd have about 200 people standing right there," Trump said, pointing at the crowd directly in front of him.
rows.output: "Ọ dị mfe ịbụ onye isi ala, mana kama inwe mmadụ 10,000 n'èzí na-agbalị ịbata n'ime ogige a juru eju, anyị ga-enwe ihe dị ka mmadụ 200 guzo n'ebe ahụ."
rows.reference: “Ọ dị mfe ukwuu ịme ka onye isi ala, mana kama ịme ka ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ dị 10,000 nọ n’ilo na anwa ịbata n’ime ebe a juru eju, anyị nwere ihe dị ka ọnụọgụ mmadụ 200 kwụ ebe a, “Trump kwuru, na atụ igwe mmadụ nọ ya n’ihu aka.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami and Quake Devastate an Island, Killing Hundreds
rows.output: Indonesia Tsunami na Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị Mgbụsị
rows.reference: Tsunami na Ala Ọmajijiji nke Indonesia Na Emebi Agwa-etiti, Na Egbu Ọtụtụ

rows.source: In the aftermath of the Lombok earthquake, for instance, foreign nongovernmental organizations were told they were not needed.
rows.output: N'ime ihe si na Lombok, dị ka ọmụmaatụ, a gwara òtù ndị mba ọzọ na ha adịghị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ka ala ọmajijiji Lombok mechara, dịka ọmụmaatụ, agwara ndị nzụkọ mba ofesi na abụghị nke gọọmentị na achọghị ha.

rows.source: Even though more than 10 percent of Lombok's population had been dislocated, no national disaster was declared, a prerequisite for catalyzing international aid.
rows.output: Ọbụna ọ bụ ezie na ihe karịrị pasent 10 nke ndị bi na Lombok ka ebugara, a na-ahọpụta ihe mberede mba, ihe dị mkpa maka ịkpalite enyemaka mba ụwa.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi na achụpụla karịa pasentị 10 nke ọnụọgụgụ nke Lombok n’ụlọ ha, akpọpụtaghị ọdachi mba ọ bụla, ihe izizi maka ịchọ enyemaka ndị mba ofesi.

rows.source: "In many cases, unfortunately, they've been very clear that they're not requesting international assistance, so it's a bit challenging," Ms. Sumbung said.
rows.output: "N'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, n'ụzọ dị mwute, ha egosila n'ụzọ doro anya na ha anaghị arịọ enyemaka mba ụwa, ya mere ọ na-esiri ike." Ms. Sumbung kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’imirikiti okwu, na mwute, ha kwuputere ya ka o doo anya na ha achọghị enyemaka mba ofesi, yabụ ọ bụ ihe aka mgba, “Nw. Sumbung kwuru.

rows.source: While Save the Children is putting together a team to travel to Palu, it is not yet sure whether foreign staff can work on the ground.
rows.output: N'oge a na-eme atụmatụ otu ndị na-ahụ maka nchekwa ụmụaka iji gaa Palu, ọ ka na-enwe nchegbu ma ndị ọrụ mba ọzọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n'ala.
rows.reference: Ebe Save the Children na edekọba otu iji gaa Palu, o doghi ya anya ma ndị ọrụ mba ofesi enwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n’ala ahụ.

rows.source: Mr. Sutopo, the national disaster agency spokesman, said Indonesian officials were assessing the situation in Palu to see whether international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the aid effort.
rows.output: Maazị Sutopo, onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ihe mberede nke mba, kwuru na ndị ọrụ gọọmentị Indonesia na-enyocha ọnọdụ dị na Palu iji hụ ma ndị ọrụ mba ofesi ga-enye aka na mbọ enyemaka.
rows.reference: Maazị Sutopo, onye okwu okwu ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi mba, kwuru ndị ọrụ Indonesia na enyocha ọnọdụ dị na Palu iji hụ ma a ga-ahapụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ mba ofesi ịnyere aka na mbọ enyemaka ahụ.

rows.source: Given the earth shaking that Indonesia constantly endures, the country remains woefully underprepared for nature's wrath.
rows.output: N'ịtụle na Indonesia na-enwe mmetụta ala na-agbawa agbawa mgbe nile, obodo ahụ na-anọgide na-enweghị nkwadebe zuru oke maka iwe nke okike.
rows.reference: Ejide n’aka ala ọmajijiji nke Indonesia na enwe oge niile, obodo ahụ adịghị nkwadobe ma ncha maka iwe nke ekereụwa.

rows.source: While tsunami shelters have been built in Aceh, they are not a common sight on other coastlines.
rows.output: N'oge ahụ, a na-ewu ụlọ nchekwa tsunami na Aceh, ma ha adịghị ahụkebe n'akụkụ osimiri ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ka arụrụ ụlọ nche tsunami na Aceh, ọ bụghị ihe a na ahụ ebe niile n’akụkụ mmiri ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: The apparent lack of a tsunami warning siren in Palu, even though a warning had been in effect, is likely to have contributed to the loss of life.
rows.output: Enweghị ihe na-egosi na a na-enwe ihe ọkụ ọkụ na Palu, n'agbanyeghị na a na-enye ihe ọkụ ọkụ, o yikarịrị ka ọ nyere aka na ọnwụ.
rows.reference: Ihe mgbama nke tsunami na adịghị na Palu, ọbụlagodi na etiri amụma nke ịdọ aka na ntị, nwere ike iso bute ọnwụ ndị mmadụ.

rows.source: At the best of times, traveling between Indonesia's many islands is challenging.
rows.output: N'oge kacha mma, njem n'etiti ọtụtụ agwaetiti Indonesia na-esiri ike.
rows.reference: N’oge kachasị mma, ịga njem n’etiti imirikiti agwaetiti nke Indonesia bụ ihe mgba.

rows.source: Natural disasters make logistics even more complicated.
rows.output: Mmetụta ndị na-emere onwe ha na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme ka
rows.reference: Ọdachi mba na eme ka nhazi gbagwojukwuo anya.

rows.source: A hospital ship that had been stationed in Lombok to treat earthquake victims is making its way to Palu, but it will take at least three days to reach the site of the new calamity.
rows.output: Ụgbọ ọgwụgwụ nke e debere na Lombok iji gwọọ ndị ihe mberede ala ọma jijiji metụrụ aka na-eme njem gaa Palu, ma ọ ga-ewe oge atọ iji ruo ebe ihe mberede ọhụrụ a.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ mmiri ụlọ ọgwụ edowere na Lombok iji lekọta ndị ala ọmajijiji metụtara na aga ugbu a na Palu, mana ọ ga-ewe opekata mpe ụbọchị atọ iji ruo ọnọdụ nke ọdachi ọhụrụ ahụ.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo made improving Indonesia's tattered infrastructure a centerpiece of his election campaign, and he has lavished money on roads and railways.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo mere ka imeziwanye ihe owuwu Indonesia dị n'okéala bụ isi ihe dị na mgbalị ya ịzọ ọkwa, o wee na-etinye ego n'ụzọ na ụgbọ okporo ígwè.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo mere imelite akụrụngwa nke Indonesia mebisiri emebi isiokwu nke mgbasa ozi nhọpụta ya, mana o tufusiela ego n’okporo ụzọ na ụzọ ụgbọ oloko.

rows.source: But funding shortfalls have plagued Mr. Joko's administration as he faces re-election next year.
rows.output: Mana oke ego na-ata ahụhụ na-achịkwa ọchịchị Maazị Joko ka ọ na-eche ntụli aka ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa.
rows.reference: Mana enweghị ego na egbu ọchịchị nke Maazị Joko ka ọ na eche nhọpụtagharị n’afọ na esote.

rows.source: Mr. Joko is also facing pressure from lingering sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have embraced a more conservative form of the faith.
rows.output: Ọkammụta Joko na-eche nrụgide ihu site na esemokwu na-aga n'ihu na Indonesia, ebe ndị otu ndị Alakụba na-achị na mba ahụ na-anabata ụdị okpukpe ndị Alakụba na-eweghachi.
rows.reference: Maazị Joko na echekwa nrụgide n’aka esemokwu ngalaba dị kemgbe na Indonesia, ebe ndị otu nke ọnụọgụgụ Muslim ka ukwuu nabatara ụdị nchekwa nke okwukwe.

rows.source: More than 1,000 people were killed and tens of thousands dislocated from their homes as Christian and Muslim gangs battled on the streets, using machetes, bows and arrows, and other crude weapons.
rows.output: Karịa mmadụ 1,000 nwụrụ, ma e nwere ọtụtụ puku ndị a chụpụrụ n'ụlọ ha ka ndị otu Ndị Kraịst na ndị Alakụba na-alụ ọgụ n'okporo ámá, na-eji mma, mgbọrọgwụ, na mgbọrọgwụ, na ngwa agha ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Egburu karịa ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ 1,000 ma chụpụ iri puku kwụrụ iri puku ndị mmadụ n’ụlọ ha dị ka ndị omempụ Ndị Otu Kraịst na Alakụba na alụ ọgụ n’okporo ụzọ, na eji mma, ụta na ube, yana ngwa-ọgụ ndị ọzọ jọrọ njọ.

rows.source: Watch: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.output: Nleba anya: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.reference: Lelee: Nsaghachi Daniel Sturridge nke Liverpool n’ime ngwụcha oge vs Chelsea

rows.source: Daniel Sturridge saved Liverpool from a Premier League loss to Chelsea with a score in the 89th minute on Saturday at Stamford Bridge in London.
rows.output: Daniel Sturridge zọpụtaziri Liverpool n'agbapụ na Premier League na Chelsea na akara n'ime nkeji iri asatọ na itoolu na Satọde na Stamford Bridge dị na London.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge zọrọ Liverpool n’aka nfụlahụ Premier League n’aka Chelsea site na ịnye goolu na nkeji nke 89 na Satode nke mere na Stamford Bridge dị na London.

rows.source: Sturridge received a pass from Xherdan Shaqiri while about 30 yards out from the Chelsea goal with his team trailing 1-0.
rows.output: Xherdan Shaqiri nyere Sturridge pụọ n'akụkụ 30 n'etiti etiti Chelsea mgbe otu ya dara 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge nwetara pass n’aka Xherdan Shaqiri ka ọ nọ ebe yaadị 30 na mpụga nke goolu Chelsea ka ndị otu ya na achụ 1-0.

rows.source: He tapped the ball to his left before scooping a shot toward the far post.
rows.output: O metụrụ bọọlụ ahụ n'aka ekpe ya tupu ọ na-atụba ya n'ebe dị anya n'osisi.
rows.reference: O tinyere bọọlụ ahụ n’akaekpe ya tupu ọ gbaa shọt n’isi elu postu ahụ.

rows.source: The attempt sailed high above the box as it drifted toward the right top corner of the net.
rows.output: Ọnwụnwa ahụ gafere n'elu igbe ahụ ka ọ na-ese n'elu ala n'akụkụ aka nri elu nke net.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa ahụ gara n’elu bọksị ahụ ka ọ na eselụ aga n’akụkụ elu akanri nke net ahụ.

rows.source: The ball eventually dropped over a leaping Kepa Arrizabalaga and fell into the net.
rows.output: Bọọlụ ahụ mechara daa n'elu Kepa Arrizabalaga na-agba ọsọ ma daa n'ime net.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ ahụ mechara gafee Kepa Arrizabalaga na agbatị aka wee dakpuo n’ime net ahụ.

rows.source: "It was just trying to get into that position, to get on the ball and players like Shaq always play it forward as much as possible, so I just tried to create myself as much time as possible," Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.output: "Ọ na-agbalị naanị ịbata n'ọnọdụ ahụ, ịnweta bọọlụ na ndị egwuregwu dị ka Shaq na-egwu ya n'ihu mgbe niile ka o kwere mee, ya mere, agbalịrụ m ime ka oge m dịkwuo mma ka o kwere mee." Sturridge gwara LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ ịnwa ịbanye n’ọnọdụ ahụ, ijide bọọlụ ma ndi egwu dị ka Shaq na agba ya aga ihu oge niile ole enwenwuru ike, yabụ m onwe m nwara iwepụta onwe m ole m nwenwuru ike, “Sturridge gwara LiverpoolFC.com.

rows.source: "I saw Kante coming and took one touch and didn't think about it too much and just took the shot on."
rows.output: "Ahụrụ m Kante ka ọ na-abịa ma were otu mmetụta ma echeghị m banyere ya nke ukwuu ma were naanị mgbatị ahụ."
rows.reference: “Ahụrụ m Kante ka ọ na abịa, metụ ya otu ugboro, echeghị m maka ya ọtụtụ, gbaa ya ozugbo.”

rows.source: Chelsea led 1-0 at halftime after getting a score in the 25th minute from Belgian star Eden Hazard.
rows.output: Chelsea na-edu 1-0 n'agbata oge, mgbe ha nwetara akara na 25th nke Eden Hazard, onye Belgium.
rows.reference: Chelsea nọ n’ihu 1-0 ka agara ezumike ka enyechara goolu na nkeji 25 site n’aka Eden Hazard nwa Belgium ama ama.

rows.source: The Blues striker heeled a pass back to Mateo Kovacic on that play, before spinning off near midfield and sprinting into the Liverpool half.
rows.output: Onye na-agba bọọlụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ nyere Mateo Kovacic ka ọ laghachikwuru ya n'ọgbọ ahụ, tupu ọ tụgharịa n'akụkụ etiti wee banye n'ime ọkara nke Liverpool.
rows.reference: Onye ihu nke Blues ahụ nyere Mateo Kovacic pass azụ ụkwụ n’egwuregwu ahụ, tupu ọ gbapụ ọsọ n’akụkụ ọkara ama egwuregwu wee gbabanye n’ọkara nke Liverpool.

rows.source: Kovacic did a quick give-and-go at midfield.
rows.output: Kovacic mere ngbanwe ngwa ngwa na etiti.
rows.reference: Kovacic mere wete mara ibe dị ọsọ n’ọkara ama egwuregwu.

rows.source: He then fired a beautiful through ball, leading Hazard into the box.
rows.output: Ọ wee tụba bọọlụ mara mma, na-eduba Hazard n'ime igbe.
rows.reference: Ọ gbara ọmarịcha bọọlụ, nke dubara Hazard n’ime bọksị ahụ.

rows.source: Hazard outran the defense and finished into the far post netting with a left footed shot past Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.output: Hazard gbara ọsọ ọsọ n'ime nchebe ma tinye ya n'ime neti dị anya site na ụkwụ aka ekpe ya, na-efunahụ Liverpool Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard gbafere dịfensị ahụ wee tinye goolu ahụ n’isi net site na iji shọt eji ụkwụ akaekpe gbaa wee gafere Alisson Becker nke Liverpool.

rows.source: Liverpool battles Napoli in the group stage of the Champions League at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.
rows.output: Ndị Liverpool na-agba Napoli n'ụbọchị iri na atọ n'ọnwa Ọktoba n'ehihie elekere atọ nke ụbọchị Wenezde n'ámá egwuregwu San Paolo dị na Naples, Italy.
rows.reference: Liverpool na Napoli ga-aga ọgụ n’ọkwa izizi nke Champions League na elekere 3 nke ehihie na Wenesde na Stadio San Paolo dị na Naples, Italy.

rows.source: Chelsea faces Videoton in the UEFA Europa Leaguge at 3 p.m. on Thursday in London.
rows.output: Chelsea na-echebe Videoton na UEFA Europa League na elekere atọ nke ehihie na Tọzdee na London.
rows.reference: Chelsea na eche Videoton na UEFA Europa League na elekere 3 nke ehihie na Tọsde na London.

rows.source: Death toll from Indonesia tsunami rises to 832
rows.output: Mmụba ndị nwụrụ n'ime tsunami Indonesia ruru 832
rows.reference: Ndị nwụrụ anwụ na tsunami Indonesia eruola 832

rows.source: The death toll in Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami has climbed to 832, the country's disaster agency said early Sunday.
rows.output: Ọnwụnwa ndị nwụrụ n'ime ala ọgbụgba na tsunami nke Indonesia agbawanyela ruo 832, ụlọ ọrụ ihe mberede nke obodo ahụ kwuru n'isi ụtụtụ Sọnde.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ na ala ọmajijiji na tsunami nke Indonesia eruola 832, ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi nke obodo ahụ kwuru na isi ụtụtụ nke Sonde.

rows.source: Many people were reported trapped in the rubble of buildings brought down in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake which struck Friday and triggered waves as high as 20 feet, agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho told a news conference.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ka a na-akọ na ha jidere n'ime ihe ndị dara n'ime ụlọ ndị dara n'ihi ala ọma jijiji nke dị 7.5 nke mere na Fraịde wee kpalie ebili mmiri dị elu nke ụkwụ 20, onye na-ekwu okwu n'ụlọ ọrụ ahụ bụ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho gwara ọgbakọ ndị nta akụkọ.
rows.reference: Ekpesara na ejidere imirikiti ndị mmadụ n’okpuru ụlọ ndị dara ada nke ala ọmajijiji 7.5 butere nke mere na Friday wee kpalite nnukwu ikuku ruru ụkwụ 20, onye okwu okwu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho gwara nzụkọ ndị nchụ nta akụkọ.

rows.source: The city of Palu, which has more than 380,000 people, was strewn with debris from collapsed buildings.
rows.output: Obodo Palu, nke nwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 380,000, juru ebe niile na ihe mkpofu si n'ụlọ ndị dara ada.
rows.reference: Obodo nke Palu, nke nwere karịa ndị mmadụ 380,000, kpojuru n’ibe ahịhịa si na ụlọ ndị dara ada.

rows.source: Police arrest man, 32, on suspicion of murder after woman is stabbed to death
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii jidere nwoke dị afọ iri atọ na abụọ n'ihi ebubo igbu mmadụ mgbe a gbara nwanyị otu mgbọ.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii jidere otu nwoke, 32, na nnyocha nke igbu mmadụ ka eji mma magbuo otu nwanyị

rows.source: A murder investigation has been launched after woman's body was found in Birkenhead, Merseyside this morning.
rows.output: Ewubela nyocha maka igbu ọchụ mgbe a chọtara ozu nwanyị n'Birkenhead, Merseyside n'ụtụtụ a.
rows.reference: Ebidola nnyocha igbu mmadụ ka ahụchara ahụ otu nwanyị na Birkenhard, Merseyside n’ụtụtụ a.

rows.source: The 44-year-old was found at 7.55am with stab wounds on Grayson Mews on John Street, with a 32-year-old man being arrested on suspicion of murder.
rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ iri anọ na anọ a chọtara ya n'ụtụtụ elekere 7:55 n'ụzọ Grayson Mews n'okporo John Street, ebe a na-ejide nwoke dị afọ iri atọ na abụọ n'okwesịrị igbu mmadụ.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ mmadụ afọ 44 ahụ na 7:55 ụtụtụ nwere ọnya mma na Grayson Mews na Okporo Ụzọ John, ejidere otu nwoke dị afọ 32 na nnyocha nke igbu mmadụ.

rows.source: Police have urged people in the area who saw or heard anything to come forward.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii na-agbasi mbọ ike na ndị bi n'ógbè ahụ ka ha bịa.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii na arịọ ndị mmadụ nọ na mpaghara ahụ onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla ka ọ bịa ihu.

rows.source: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation is in the early stages but I would appeal to anyone who was in the vicinity of John Street in Birkenhead who saw or heard anything suspicious to contact us.
rows.output: Onye nchọpụta Inspector Brian O'Hagan kwuru: 'Nnyocha ahụ nọ n'ụzọ mbụ mana m ga-arịọ onye ọ bụla nọ n'ógbè John Street dị na Birkenhead onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla na-enyo enyo ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị.
rows.reference: Onye Uwe Ojii Ịnspektọ Brian O'Hagan kwuru: ‘Nnyocha ahụ nọ na mbido ya mana m ga-arịọ mmadụ ọ bụla nọ n’ogige nke Okporo Ụzọ John dị na Birkenhead onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla a na enyo enyo ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị.

rows.source: I would also appeal to anyone, particularly taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on dashcam footage to contact us as they may have information which is vital to our investigation.'
rows.output: Aga m ekerịta ndị mmadụ, karịsịa ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ ala, ndị nwere ike ịdekọ ihe ọ bụla na igwe igwe ha, ka ha kpọtụrụ anyị ka ha wee nwee ike inye anyị ozi dị mkpa maka nyocha anyị.
rows.reference: M ga-achọ ịrịọ mmadụ ọ bụla, karịchara ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ taksị, onye nwere ike ijide ihe ọ bụla na nseta dashkam ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị n’ihi ha nwere ike ịnwe ozi dị mkpa maka nnyocha anyị.’

rows.source: A police spokesman has confirmed the woman whose body was found is local to Birkenhead and she was found inside a property.
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ndị uwe ojii ekwenyela na nwanyị ahụ nke ahụ ya dị na Birkenhead bụ onye obodo ma hụ ya n'ime ụlọ.
rows.reference: Onye okwu okwu ndị uwe ojii ekwenyela na nwanyị ahụ ahụrụ ahụ bụ onye mpaghara na Birkenhead, ahụrụ ya n’ime otu akụ.

rows.source: This afternoon friends who believe they know the woman have arrived at the scene to ask questions about where she was found this morning.
rows.output: N'ehihie a, ndị enyi ndị kwenyere na ha maara nwanyị ahụ abịala ebe ihe mere iji jụọ ajụjụ gbasara ebe a chọtara ya n'ụtụtụ a.
rows.reference: N’ehihie a ndị enyi kwere na ha ma nwanyị ahụ abịala n’ogige ahụ iji jụọ ajụjụ maka ebe ahụrụ ya n’ụtụtụ a.

rows.source: Investigations are ongoing as police have said they are in the process of informing the victim's next of kin.
rows.output: Nnyocha na-aga n'ihu ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ha na-agbasi mbọ ike ịgwa ndị ikwu onye ahụ nwụrụ anwụ.
rows.reference: A na eme nnyocha ugbu a dị ka ndị uwe ojii si kwuo ha na akwadobe ịgwa osote nke onye ihe ahụ mere.

rows.source: A taxi driver who lives in Grayson Mews has just tried to get back into his flat but is being told by police no one is allowed in or out of the building.
rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala na-azọpụta ndụ na Grayson Mews enwetala mbọ ịlaghachi n'ụlọ ya, mana ndị uwe ojii na-agwa ya na onye ọ bụla anaghị ekwe ka ọ banye ma ọ bụ pụọ n'ụlọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ taksị bi na Grayson Mew nwara ịbanyechi na be ya mana ndị uwe ojii gwara ya na ọ nweghị onye na abanye ma ọ bụ apụ n’ụlọ ahụ.

rows.source: He was speechless when he discovered what happened.
rows.output: Ọ maghị ihe mere mgbe ọ chọpụtara ihe ahụ.
rows.reference: Okwu ekweghị ya mgbe ọ chọpụtara ihe mere.

rows.source: Residents are now being told it will be hours until they are allowed back in.
rows.output: Ndị bi na ya ugbu a na-agwa ha na ọ ga-ewe awa ole na ole tupu ha enwee ike ịlaghachi n'ime.
rows.reference: A na agwa ndị bi ebe ahụ ugbu a, na ọ ga-ewe ogologo oge tupu ahapụ ha ịbanyechi ọzọ.

rows.source: A police officer was heard telling one man that the entire area is now being treated as a crime scene.
rows.output: Onye uwe ojii kwuru otu nwoke na ebe dum dum a na-ewere ugbu a dị ka ebe mpụ.
rows.reference: Anụrụ ka otu onye uwe ojii na agwa otu nwoke na a na ahụta mpaghara ahụ niile ka ogige omekome.

rows.source: A woman appeared at the scene in tears.
rows.output: Nwanyị pụtaworo n'ebe ahụ n'ụjọ.
rows.reference: Otu nwanyị anya mmiri juru bịara n’ogige ahụ.

rows.source: She keeps repeating 'it's so awful'.
rows.output: Ọ na-emegharị ugboro ugboro 'ọ dị oke njọ'.
rows.reference: Ọ nọ na ekwugharị “ọ jọrọ njọ’.

rows.source: At 2pm two police vans were inside the cordon with another van just outside.
rows.output: N'elekere abụọ nke ehihie, ụgbọ ala ndị uwe ojii abụọ nọ n'ime ogwe ahụ na ụgbọ ala ọzọ nọ n'èzí.
rows.reference: Na elekere 2 nke ehihie ụgbọ ala ndị uwe ojii abụọ nọ n’ime eriri ahụ ụgbọ ala ọzọ nọkwa na mpụga.

rows.source: A number of officers were stood inside the cordon monitoring the block of flats.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ nọ n'ime ogwe ahụ na-ele anya n'ime ngọngọ ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị uwe ojii kwụ n’ime eriri ahụ na elele ụlọ ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.
rows.output: Onye ọ bụla nwere ozi a na-arịọ ka o zipu DM na @MerPolCC, kpọọ 101 ma ọ bụ kpọtụrụ Crimestoppers n'amaghị aha na 0800 555 111 na-ekwu log 247 nke 30 Septemba.
rows.reference: A na arịọ mmadụ ọ bụla nwere ozi ka ọ dete ozi na @MerPolCC, kpọọ 101 ma ọ bụ kpọtụrụ Crimestoppers na ejighi aha ya na 0800 555 111 na ekwu ndekọ 247 nke Septemba 30.

rows.source: Parliament's statue of Cromwell becomes latest memorial hit by 'rewriting history' row
rows.output: Ihe oyiyi nke Cromwell na Ụlọ Nzukọ Mba na-aghọ ihe ncheta ọhụrụ na-ata ahụhụ n'oké esemokwu nke 'ịdeghari akụkọ ihe mere eme'
rows.reference: Akpụrụakpụ Cromwell nke nzụkọ omeiwu abụgo ihe ncheta kachasị ọhụrụ dabanyere n’esemokwu ‘ịdegharị akụkọ ochie’.

rows.source: Its banishment would be poetic justice for his Taliban-like destruction of so many of England's cultural and religious artefacts carried out by his fanatical Puritan followers.
rows.output: Ịkpọga ya ga-abụ ikpe ziri ezi maka mbuso agha ya dị ka Taliban nke ọtụtụ ihe nketa omenala na okpukpe nke England, nke ndị na-eso ụzọ ya na-ata ahụhụ.
rows.reference: Nchụpụ ya ga-abụ ntaramahụhụ maka mmebi ya yitere Taliban emere n’ọtụtụ akpụrụakpụ omenala na okpukperechi nke England, nke ndị nsuso Puritan na enye nsogbu mere.

rows.source: But the Cromwell Society described Mr Crick's suggestion as "folly" and "attempting to rewrite history."
rows.output: Mana òtù Cromwell kwuru na ihe Maazị Crick tụrụ aro bụ "nwa amadi" na "na-agbalị ịdeghari akụkọ ihe mere eme."
rows.reference: Mana Otu Cromwell kọwara ntụnye nke Maazị Crick ka ‘ihe njakịrị” yana “ịnwa ịdegharị akụkọ ochie.”

rows.source: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "It was inevitable in the present debate about the removal of statues that the figure of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster would become a target.
rows.output: John Goldsmith, onye isi oche nke Cromwell Society, kwuru: "Ọ bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere n'ime arụmụka dị ugbu a gbasara iwepụ ihe oyiyi, na onye a ma ama bụ Oliver Cromwell n'èzí ụlọ Nzukọ Westminster ga-abụ ihe a na-target.
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, onye isi oche nke Otu Cromwell, kwuru: “Ọ bụ ihe agaghị ezenwu na nrịrụta ụka ugbu a maka mwepu nke akpụrụakpụ na akpụrụakpụ nke Oliver Cromwell dị na mpụga nke Obieze nke Westminster ga-abụ ihe mgbado anya.

rows.source: The iconoclasm of the English civil wars was neither ordered nor carried out by Cromwell.
rows.output: Ihe oyiyi nke agha obodo Bekee bụ nke Cromwell nyere iwu ma ọ bụ mee.
rows.reference: Mmebi akara okpukperechi nke emere n’oge ọgụ ndị England abụghị Cromwell nyere iwu ya ma ọ bụ mee ya n’aka ya.

rows.source: Perhaps the wrong Cromwell would be sacrificed for the actions of his ancestor Thomas in the previous century.
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya, Cromwell na-ezighị ezi ga-atụfu maka omume nke nna nna ya Thomas n'ime narị afọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ikekwe a ga-egbu Cromwell na ezighi ezi maka mmereme nke nna ochie ya Thomas mere na narị afọ gara aga.

rows.source: Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft's magnificent representation of Cromwell is evidence of 19th century opinion and part of the historiography of a figure who many believe is still worth celebrating.
rows.output: Nkowa mara mma nke Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft nke Cromwell na-egosi echiche nke narị afọ nke 19 na akụkụ nke akụkọ ihe mere eme nke onye ọtụtụ ndị kwenyere na ọ ka kwesịrị ịsọpụrụ.
rows.reference: Ọmarịcha ngosipụta nke Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft maka Cromwell pụtara ihie n’echiche narị afọ 19 yana akụkụ nke ndekọ akụkọ nke mmadụ ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ kwenyere na ekwesịrị ị na ebuli elu.

rows.source: Mr Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell is regarded by many, perhaps more in the late 19th century than today, as a defender of parliament against external pressure, in his case of course the monarchy.
rows.output: Ọkammụta Goldsmith gwara Telegraph Sunday: "Cromwell bụ onye a na-ewere dị ka onye na-echebe ndị omebe iwu megide nrụgide si mpụga, n'okwu ya, n'ezie, eze.
rows.reference: Maazị Goldsmith gwara The Sunday Telegraph: “Ọtụtụ na ebuli Cromwell, ikekwe karịa na ngwụcha narị afọ 19 karịa oge a, dị ka onye nchedo nke nzụkọ omeiwu maka nkwanye si na mpụga, n’okwu ya ndị ọchịchị.

rows.source: Whether that is a wholly accurate representation is the subject of continuing historical debate.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na nke ahụ bụ nnọọ ihe nnọchianya ziri ezi bụ isiokwu a na-atụle n'ụzọ dị iche iche n'akụkọ ihe mere eme.
rows.reference: Ma nke ahụ abụ ngosipụta ziri ezi n’uju bụkwazị isiokwu nke nrịrụta ụka akụkọ ochie na aga n’ihu ugbu a.

rows.source: What is certain is that the conflict of the mid 17th century has shaped the subsequent development of our nation, and Cromwell is an individual recognisable figure who represents one side of that divide.
rows.output: Ihe doro anya bụ na esemokwu nke etiti narị afọ nke 17 enyela aka na mmepe nke obodo anyị na-esote, na Cromwell bụ onye a na-ahụ anya nke na-anọchi anya otu akụkụ nke nkewa ahụ.
rows.reference: Ihe doro anya bụ na ọgụ nke etiti narị afọ 17 doziri ntolite nke obodo anyị, Cromwell bụ mmadụ ama ama onye nke na egosi otu akụkụ nke nkewa ahụ.

rows.source: His achievements as Lord Protector are also worth celebrating and commemorating."
rows.output: Ihe ndị ọ rụzuru dị ka Onye Nche Nche ka a ga-eme ememe na ncheta."
rows.reference: Ntozu ya ka Onye Nchedo Kachasị bụ ihe tozuru ibuli elu ma na echeta.”

rows.source: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death
rows.output: Ezi anụ na-egbu mmadụ na-akụ onye ọrụ ugbo China n'ike
rows.reference: Ezi Na Egbu Mmadụ Dọgburu Onye Ọrụ Ubi China

rows.source: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.
rows.output: Onye ọrụ ugbo ka a wụsara ya na ọnwu site n'aka anụ ezi n'ime ahịa na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ China, dị ka akụkọ mpaghara si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ezi makpuru otu onye ọrụ ubi ma gbuo ya n’ahịa dị na akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke China, site na mkpesa mgbasa ozi nke mpaghara.

rows.source: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.
rows.output: Nwoke ahụ, nke a na-akpọ naanị aha ikpeazụ ya "Yuan," bụ onye a hụrụ nwụrụ anwụ na mgbọrọgwụ mgbọrọgwụ, kpuchiri ya na ọbara n'akụkụ ụlọ ahịa na Liupanshui na Guizhou Province, dị ka South China Morning Post si kwuo na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Nwoke ahụ, eji naanị aha nna ya kọwaa “Yaun,” ka ahụrụ ya ebe ọ nwụrụ anwụ, adọrịrị akwara ya, ọbara kpuchiri ya n’akụkụ ụlọ ezi dị n’ahịa ahụ dị na Liupanshui na mpaghara Guizhou, South China Morning Post kpesara na Sọnde.

rows.source: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.
rows.output: Onye na-azụ anụ ezi na-akwadebe iji ọgwụ mgbochi n'ime anụ ezi n'ụlọ ọrụ anụ ezi na May 30, 2005 na Xining nke Qinghai Province, China.
rows.reference: Onye ọrụ ubi na azụ ezi kwadoro ịgbanye ọgwụ mgbochi n’ime ezi ndị dị n’ụlọ ezi n’ụbọchi Meh 30, 2005 na Xining nke Mpaghara Qinghai, China.

rows.source: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu na ya na nwanne ya nwoke si n'obodo ndị agbata obi Yunnan na Wenezde ka ọ ree ezi 15 n'ahịa.
rows.reference: Ekwuru na ya na nwa nwanne ya mere njem bidoro na mpaghara Yunnan nọketere nso na Wenesde iji ree ezi 15 n’ahịa ahụ.

rows.source: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.
rows.output: N'ụtụtụ echi ya, onye ọgbọ ya hụrụ ya nwuuru, ọ hụkwara ụzọ ụzọ na ụlọ anụ ụlọ dị nso ka ọ na-emeghe.
rows.reference: N’ụtụtụ na esote, nwa nwanne ya hụrụ ya ebe ọ nwụrụ anwụ, ma chọpụta otu ụzọ banyere n’otu ụlọ ezi ka ọ mepere emepe.

rows.source: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.
rows.output: O kwuru na n'ime ụlọ ahụ bụ nnukwu ezi nwoke nwere ọbara n'ọnụ ya.
rows.reference: O kwuru n’ime ụlọ ezi ahụ bụ nnukwu oke ezi ọbara dị n’ọnụ ya.

rows.source: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.
rows.output: Nnyocha forensic kwuru na oke oke nke 550 pound ahụ gburu onye ọrụ ugbo ahụ, dị ka akụkọ ahụ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Nnyocha fọrensik kwenyere na ezi ibu 550 ahụ dagburu onye ọrụ ubi ahụ, site na akụkọ ahụ.

rows.source: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.
rows.output: "Ụkwụ nwanne m nwoke bụ ọbara na-egbu egbu ma na-egbu egbu," nwanne m nwoke, onye a na-akpọ aha ya "Wu," kwuru, dị ka akụkọ Guiyang Evening News si kwuo.
rows.reference: “Ọbara na ọnya juru ụkwụ nwa nwanne m,” nwa nwanne ahụ kwuru, nke eji aha nna ya wee na arụtụ aka “Wu,” kwuru, dị ka Guiyan Evening News siri kwuo.

rows.source: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.
rows.output: Nleba anya nke ụlọ ahịa ahụ gosiri na Yuan banyere n'ụlọ ahịa ahụ n'elekere anọ nke ụtụtụ na Tọzdee iji na-eri anụ ya.
rows.reference: Nseta igwefoto nche gosiri ka Yuan na abanye n’ahịa ahụ 4:40 ụtụtụ Tọsde iji nye ezi ndị ahụ nri.

rows.source: His body was found about an hour later.
rows.output: Ahụ ya bụ́ n'ime awá ole na ole ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ ya n’otu aka elekere ka emechara.

rows.source: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.
rows.output: Anụmanụ ahụ gburu nwoke ahụ abụghị nke Yuan ma ọ bụ nke nwanne nna ya.
rows.reference: Anụmanụ gburu nwoke ahụ abụghị nke Yaun ma ọ bụ nwa nwanne ya.

rows.source: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.
rows.output: Onye njikwa ahịa gwara Evening News na a na-ajụ anụ ahụ ka ọ ghara ịwaba onye ọzọ, ebe ndị uwe ojii na-anakọta ihe akaebe n'ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Otu onye nchịkwa ahịa gwara Evening News na akpọchiri ezi ahụ iji gbochie ya na ịmakpu mmadụ ọzọ, ebe ndị uwe ojii na ekpokọta ihe aka n’ogige ahụ.

rows.source: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
rows.output: Ezinụlọ Yuan na ndị ọrụ ahịa na-ekwu na ha na-akparịta ụka maka ụgwọ maka ọnwụ ya.
rows.reference: Ezinụlọ nke Yuan na ndị ikikere ahịa na akparịta ego nkasị obi maka ọnwụ ya.

rows.source: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ na-adịkarị obere, e nwere ihe ndekọ banyere ụmụ anụmanụ na-egbu mmadụ.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị na ọ bụ ihe na anaghị emekarị, ebe ezi ịmakpu mmadụ bụ ihe edekọburu na mbụ.

rows.source: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.
rows.output: N'afọ 2016, otu ezi na-egbu otu nwanyị na di ya n'ụlọ ha na Massachusetts, nke hapụrụ nwoke ahụ na mmerụ ahụ dị oke njọ.
rows.reference: Na 2016, otu ezi makpuru otu nwanyị na dị ya n’ubi ha na Massachusetts, hapụ nwoke ahụ na nnukwu mmerụ ahụ.

rows.source: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.
rows.output: Afọ iri gara aga, otu ezi na-ata 650 pound na-akụ onye ọrụ ugbo Welsh n'ime traktọ ya ruo mgbe nwunye ya tụrụ anụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Afọ iri gara aga, ezi na ada 650 n’ibu kpadoro otu onye ọrụ ubi Welsh na traktọ ya ruo mgbe nwunye ya chụpụrụ anụmanụ ahụ.

rows.source: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."
rows.output: Mgbe onye ọrụ ugbo Oregon riri ya site n'aka anụ ézì ya na 2012, otu onye ọrụ ugbo Manitoba gwara CBC News na ézì anaghị abụ ndị na-awagbu n'ozuzu, ma ụtọ ọbara nwere ike ime ka ọ bụrụ "ihe na-akpali."
rows.reference: Ka ezi nke onye ọrụ ubi Oregon richara ya na 2012, otu onye ọrụ ubi Mantioba gwara CNC News na ezi na emekabe ihe ike mana ụtọ ọbara nwere ike ịbụ “ihe mkpalite.”

rows.source: "They're just being playful.
rows.output: Ha na-eme ihe na-atọ ha ụtọ.
rows.reference: “Naanị egwu ka ha na egu.

rows.source: They're nippers, very inquisitive ... they aren't out to hurt you.
rows.output: Ha bụ ndị na-akụ aka, ndị na-achọsi ike ... ha anaghị agbalị imerụ gị ahụ.
rows.reference: Ha bụ ụmụ ntakịrị, ha nwere nnukwu nchụchọ ... ha apụghị ịmerụ gị ahụ.

rows.source: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.
rows.output: Ị kwesịrị ịkwanyesị ha ùgwù nke ọma," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ị kwesịrị ịnye ya nsọpụrụ ziri ezi, “o kwuru.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US
rows.output: Mgbapụta nke Hurricane Rosa ga-ebute oke mmiri ozuzo n'ofe ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ US
rows.reference: Ihe fọdụrụ na Oke Ifufe Rosa ga-ebute nnukwu mmiri ozizo gbasara agbasa n’akụkụ ọdịda anywa na ndịda nke US

rows.source: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.
rows.output: Dị ka amụma, Hurricane Rosa na-ebelata ka ọ na-aga n'elu mmiri oyi nke ugwu Mexico.
rows.reference: Dị ka amụma ihuigwe, Oke Ifufe Rosa na ada ka ọ agafe n’elu mmiri juru oyi nke akụkụ osimiri n’ebe ugwu nke Mexico.

rows.source: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.
rows.output: Ọbụna, Rosa ga-ebute oke mmiri ozuzo n'ofe ugwu Mexico na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ U.S. n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole na-abịa.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, Rosa ga-ebute mmiri ozizo ga-ebute ide mmiri n’ofe ebe ugwu nke Mexico yana akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke U.S. n’ụbọchị ndị na abia.

rows.source: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.output: Rosa nwere ifufe nke 85 mph, nke bụ Hurricane 1, dị ka elekere 5 nke ụtụtụ Sọnde, ma dị na kilomita 385 n'azụ Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.reference: Rosa nwere ikuku 85 mph, Oke Ifufe nke Otu 1, ebe 5 ụtụtụ. Oge ọwụwa anyanwụ Sọnde, ọ dị na maịlụ 385 nke ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.
rows.output: Rosa na-atụ anya na ọ ga-aga n'ebe ugwu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na Rosa ga-aga n’ebe ugwu na Sọnde.

rows.source: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, oke mmiri na-amalite na-eme ka ọ dị n'elu oke osimiri Pasifik ma na-aga n'ebe ọdịda anyanwụ n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke U.S. Ka Rosa na-eru n'akụkụ Baja California Peninsula na Mọnde dị ka oké ifufe, ọ ga-amalite ịkwaga n'ime mmiri mmiri dị omimi n'ime ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ U.S.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nnukwu oghere ebidola ịchịkọta n’ofe Oke Osimiri Pacific ma gaa ọwụwa anyanwụ na-aga Akụkụ Osimiri Ọdịda Anyanwụ nke U.S. Ka Rosa na erute ala mmiri Baja California na Mọnde ka oke ikuku mmiri, ọ ga-ebido ịkwa oke mmiri miri emi gaa n’ebe ugwu n’ime nke ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke U.S.

rows.source: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.
rows.output: Rosa ga-ebute mmiri ozuzo ruru sentimita iri na-erughị mmiri ozuzo na akụkụ Mexico na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Rosa ga-ebulite mmiri ozizo toruru 10 inchis n’akụkụ nke Mexico na Mọnde.

rows.source: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.
rows.output: Ọzụzụ, mmiri mmiri na-emekọ ihe na mpaghara na-abịaru n'akụkụ ga-emepụta mmiri ozuzo dị arọ n'ofe mpaghara ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ n'ime ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ, oke mmiri na agwakọta n’ime nnukwu oghere na abịa ga-emepụta nnukwu mmiri ozizo gbasara agbasa n’ebe Ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda n’ofe ụbọchị ndị na abịa.

rows.source: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.
rows.output: N'ime obodo, mmiri ozuzo nke sentimita 1 ruo 4 ga-eme ka ọgbaghara na-efe efe na-efe efe, na-efe efe na-efe efe, na oke oke na-efe efe.
rows.reference: Na mpaghara, mmiri ozizo ruru 1 ruo 4 inchis ga-ebute ide mmiri jọrọ njọ, ọsụsọ ahịhịa yana ala ọzịze nwere ike ịdị n’ọzara.

rows.source: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.
rows.output: Mmiri mmiri na-ekpo ọkụ nke ukwuu ga-eme ka ọnụego mmiri ozuzo rute sentimita 2 ruo 3 kwa elekere n'ebe ụfọdụ, karịsịa n'akụkụ ndịda Nevada na Arizona.
rows.reference: Oke mmiri miri emi ga-ebute oke mmiri ozizo irute inchi 2 ruo 3 kwa aka elekere na nkebi, karịchara n’akụkụ nke ndịda Nevada na Arizona.

rows.source: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.
rows.output: N'ime ọkara ruo otu inch nke mmiri ozuzo ka a na-atụ anya na mpaghara ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ, karịsịa n'elu ọtụtụ akụkụ nke Arizona.
rows.reference: Dị ka a na atụ anya inchis 2 ruo 4 nke mmiri ozizo n’ụfọdụ akụkụ nke Ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda, karịchaa n’ofe nke Arizona.

rows.source: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.
rows.output: Mgbapụta nke mmiri ozuzo dị oke egwu nwere ike ime n'ihi ọnọdụ na-adịghị mma na-aga n'ihu n'ihi ọdịdị nke mmiri ozuzo na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Enwere ike ịnwe ide mmiri nwere ọnọdụ na emebi ngwangwa n’ihi ụdịdị nke oke mmiri ozizo fesara efesa.

rows.source: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ ihe na-adịghị mma ịbata n'ime ọhịa n'ụkwụ na ihe egwu nke mmiri ozuzo na-ekpo ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ọ ga-abụ nnukwu ndụmọdụ jọrọ njọ iji ụkwụ gara banye n’ọzara ebe enwere ihe egwu nke oke mmiri ozizo.

rows.source: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.
rows.output: Oyiri mmiri nwere ike ime ka ugwu ghọọ osimiri na-awagharị, oké ifufe ga-ewetara ikuku na-efe efe na uzuzu na-efe.
rows.reference: Nnukwu mmiri ozizo nwere ike ịme ka kanyọns bụrụ osimiri ji iwe yana egbe eluigwe na amụma ga-ebute oke ifufe na aja na efesasị efe.

rows.source: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ na-abịa ga-eweta oke mmiri ozuzo na mpaghara ndịda California.
rows.reference: Nnukwu oghere ahụ na abịarute ga-ebute ụfọdụ nnukwu mmiri ozizo n’ebe akụkụ osimiri Ndịda California.

rows.source: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.
rows.output: Mmiri ozuzo ruru ọkara inch nwere ike ime, nke nwere ike ibute obere ihe mkpofu na okporo ụzọ na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Mgbakọ mmiri ozizo nke gafere ọkara inchi nwere ike ịdị, nke nwere ike ibute obere ọsụsọ ahịhịa yana okporo ụzọ na amị amị.

rows.source: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.
rows.output: Nke a ga-abụ mmiri mbụ nke oge mmiri ozuzo na mpaghara a.
rows.reference: Nke a ga-abụ mmiri ozizi izizi nke mpaghara ahụ nke oge udu mmiri ha.

rows.source: Some scattered tropical rain showers will begin to approach Arizona late Sunday and early Monday, before the rain becomes more widespread late Monday and Tuesday.
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ mmiri ozuzo na-efe efe ga-amalite ịbata Arizona n'oge Sọnde na mmalite Mọnde, tupu mmiri ozuzo ahụ gbasaa n'ụzọ dị ukwuu n'oge Mọnde na Tuzdee.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ nyọsa oke mmiri ozizo fesara efesa ga-ebido irute Arizona na mgbede Sọnde yana n’isi ụtụtụ Mọnde, tupu mmiri ozizo ahụ agbasasịa na mgbede Mọnde na Tusde.

rows.source: Heavy rain will spread into the Four Corners on Tuesday and last through Wednesday.
rows.output: Oyiri mmiri ga-adị n'ime akụkụ anọ ahụ na Tuzdee ma na-adịgide ruo Wenezde.
rows.reference: Nnukwu mmiri ozizo ga-agbasa na Akụkụ Anọ na Tusde ma nọgide ruo Wenesde.

rows.source: October can see some intense temperature swings across the U.S. as the Arctic gets cooler, but the tropics remain quite warm.
rows.output: Ọktoba nwere ike ịhụ mgbanwe okpomọkụ dị egwu n'ofe U.S. ka Arctic na-adị jụụ, mana tropics na-anọgide na-ekpo ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ọktọba nwere ike ịhụ ụfọdụ mgbanwe temprechọ dị ike n’ofe U.S. ka Arctic na ejuwanye oyi, mana ebe okpomọkụ ga-enwe okpomọkụ.

rows.source: Sometimes this leads to dramatic changes in temperature over short distances.
rows.output: Oge ụfọdụ, nke a na-ebute mgbanwe dị egwu na okpomọkụ n'ime obere anya.
rows.reference: Oge ụfọdụ nke a na ebute nnukwu mgbanwe na temprechọ n’ofe obere oge.

rows.source: There is a great example of dramatic temperature differences through the central U.S. on Sunday.
rows.output: Enwere nnukwu ihe atụ nke okpomọkụ dị iche iche site na etiti U.S. na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Enwere nnukwu ịmaatụ nke ndịiche temprechọ dị egwu gafere n’etiti U.S. na Satọde.

rows.source: There is nearly a 20-degree temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.output: Enwere ihe dị ka ọdịiche ogo okpomọkụ 20 degrees n'etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, na n'etiti St. Louis na Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Enwere ihe rutere ndịiche temprechọ digrii-20 n’etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, yana n’etiti St. Louis na Des Moined, Iowa.

rows.source: Over the next few days, lingering summer warmth will try to build and expand again.
rows.output: N'ime ụbọchị ole na ole na-abịa, okpomọkụ nke okpomoku na-adịgide adịgide ga-agbalị ịrụpụta na ịgbasa ọzọ.
rows.reference: N’ụbọchị ole ma ole na abịa, ekpomọkụ ọkọchị ga-anọgide ga-anwa ịkpụkọ ma dọtịa ọzọ.

rows.source: Much of the central and eastern U.S. is expected to see a warm start to October with widespread 80s from the Southern Plains to parts of the Northeast.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. na-atụ anya na ọ ga-amalite n'October na okpomọkụ na-emetụta 80s site na Southern Plains ruo akụkụ nke Northeast.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na imirikiti n’ebe etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. ga-ahụ mbido Ọktọba nwere ekpomọkụ gbasara 80s bido na Ala Ndịda ruo n’akụkụ nke Ọwụwa anyanwụ na ugwu.

rows.source: New York City could reach 80 degrees on Tuesday, which would be approximately 10 degrees above average.
rows.output: Obodo New York nwere ike iru ogo 80 na Tuzdee, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka ogo 10 karịa nke a na-ahụkarị.
rows.reference: New York City nwere ike iru digrii 80 na Tusde, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka digrii 10 karịa nkezi.

rows.source: Our long term climate forecast is indicating high chances for above-average temperatures for the eastern U.S. through the first half of October.
rows.output: Ntuziaka ihu igwe ogologo oge anyị na-egosi oke ohere maka okpomọkụ dị elu maka ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. site na ọkara mbụ nke Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Amụma ihuigwe ogologo oge anyị na egosi nnukwu ohere maka nkezi temprechọ ndị dị n’elu maka akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ nke U.S. gafere ọkara izizi nke Ọktoba.

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh hearing
rows.output: Karịa nde iri abụọ na nde mmadụ iri abụọ na-anọ na-ege ntị na ikpe Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere ọnụnụ Brett Kavanaugh

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Thursday's gripping testimony by Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh and the woman who accused him of a sexual assault that allegedly occurred in the 1980s, Christine Blasey Ford, on six television networks.
rows.output: Karịa nde iri abụọ na nde mmadụ hụrụ nnọkọ ahụ na Tọzdee n'etiti onye a họpụtara maka Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu nke America, Brett Kavanaugh na nwanyị ahụ na-azọ ya ebubo na ọ na-ata ya ahụhụ n'afọ 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọk telivishọn isii.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere nkwupụta akaebe nke Tọsde sitere n’aka Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị yana nwanyị boro ya ebubo nke mwakpo n’ike mere na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọk igwe onyonyoo isi.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the political standoff continued, with broadcasters interrupting regular programming for Friday's last-minute twist: an agreement engineered by Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake for the FBI to conduct a one-week investigation of the charges.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ọgbaghara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-aga n'ihu, ebe ndị na-ebufe ozi na-ebelata mmemme kwa ụbọchị maka ntụgharị ikpeazụ nke Fraịde: nkwekọrịta nke onye omebe iwu Arizona bụ Jeff Flake mere ka ndị FBI mee nyocha otu izu nke ebubo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nkwụsịdo ike ndọrọndọrọ ahụ gara n’ihu, ndị mgbasa ozi nọ na akwụsịbido mmemme ndị kwesịrị ịme maka ntụgharị nkeji ikpeazụ nke Fraịde ahụ: nkwekọrịta nke Onye Ọmeiwu Jeff Flake nke Arizona zubere maka FBI iji mee nnyocha otu-izu maka ebubo ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that she's 100 percent certain that Kavanaugh groped her drunkenly and tried to take off her clothes at a high school party.
rows.output: Ford gwara kọmitii ikpe ikpe nke Senate na ọ bụ 100 pasentị n'ụzọ doro anya na Kavanaugh metụrụ ya aka n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma nwaa ịwepụ uwe ya n'ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Ford gwara Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na Kavanaugh ji anya mmanya pịa ya aka ma nwaa iyipu ya akwa n’emume ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị.

rows.source: Kavanaugh, in impassioned testimony, said he's 100 percent certain that it didn't happen.
rows.output: Kavanaugh, n'okwuchukwu na-enwe mmetụta, kwuru na o nwere 100 pasent nchekwube na ọ bụghị ihe ọ bụla mere.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, na nkwupụta nwere oke mmetụta, kwuru na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na ọ meghị.

rows.source: It's likely that more than the 20.4 million people reported by Nielsen on Friday watched it.
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ na ihe karịrị nde mmadụ iri abụọ na anọ, dị ka Nielsen kwuru na Fraịde, leliri anya na ya.
rows.reference: Enwere ohere na ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ nde ndị mmadụ 20.4 nke Nielsen kwuru na Friday lelere ya.

rows.source: The company was counting average viewership on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agbakọta ndị na-ekiri ihe na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agụ nkezi nlele na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.

rows.source: Figures weren't immediately available for other networks that showed it, including PBS, C-SPAN and the Fox Business Network.
rows.output: Ihe ndị ahụ adịghị ozugbo dị maka netwọk ndị ọzọ na-egosi ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ adịghị ozugbo maka netwọk ndị ọzọ gosiri ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.

rows.source: And Nielsen usually has some trouble measuring people who watch in offices.
rows.output: Na Nielsen na-enwekarị nsogbu na ịtule ndị na-ekiri ihe n'ụlọ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ma Nielsen na enwekarị nsogbu ịha ndị mmadụ lelere n’ụlọ ọrụ ha.

rows.source: To put that in perspective, that's an audience size similar to that for a playoff football game or the Academy Awards.
rows.output: Iji mee ka nke ahụ pụta ìhè, nke ahụ bụ nnukwu ndị na-ege ntị dị ka egwuregwu bọọlụ nke asọmpi ma ọ bụ ihe nrite Academy.
rows.reference: Iji mee ka ịghọta nke ahụ, nke ahụ bụ nha ndị nlele yitere ndị nọ n’ama egwuregwu futbọọlụ onye mmeri ma ọ bụ Academy Awards.

rows.source: Fox News Channel, whose opinion hosts have strongly backed Kavanaugh's appointment, led all networks with an average of 5.69 million viewers during the all-day hearing, Nielsen said.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Fox News Channel, nke ndị na-ekwu okwu ya na-akwado nkwonkwo Kavanaugh nke ukwuu, duuru na netwọkọ niile na ndị na-ekiri nde 5.69 n'ime ụbọchị niile, Nielsen kwuru.
rows.reference: Fox News Channel, ndị nchịkọta ya nwere uche nke ya kwadosiri nhọpụta Kavanaugh ike, gafere netwọk niile site na ịnwe nkezi nke ọnụọgụ ndị nlele nde 5.69 n’oge ọnụnụ ụbọchị-niile ahụ, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.source: ABC was second with 3.26 million viewers.
rows.output: ABC bụ nke abụọ na ndị na-ekiri 3.26 nde.
rows.reference: ABC gbara onye nke abụọ site na ịnwe ndị nlele ọnụọgụ nde 3.26.

rows.source: CBS had 3.1 million, NBC had 2.94 million, MSNBC had 2.89 million and CNN had 2.52 million, Nielsen said.
rows.output: CBS nwere nde 3.1, NBC nwere nde 2.94, MSNBC nwere nde 2.89 na CNN nwere nde 2.52, Nielsen kwuru.
rows.reference: CBS nwere ọnụọgụ nde 3.1, NBC nwere ọnụọgụ nde 2.94, MSNBC nwere ọnụọgụ nde 2.89 yana CNN nwere ọnụọgụ nde 2.52, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.source: Interest remained high after the hearing.
rows.output: Mmasị ka dị elu mgbe a nụrụ okwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Mmasị rịrị elu ka ọnụnụ ahụ gwụchara.

rows.source: Flake was the central figure in Friday's drama.
rows.output: Flake bụ onye bụ isi na ihe nkiri Fraịde.
rows.reference: Flake bụ onye agbadoro anya n’okwu nke Fraịde.

rows.source: After the moderate Republican's office issued a statement that he would be voting in favor of Kavanaugh, he was caught be CNN and CBS cameras Friday morning being shouted at by protesters as he tried to ride an elevator to a Judiciary Committee hearing.
rows.output: Mgbe ụlọ ọrụ Republican na-ekwesịghị ekwesị wepụtara nkwupụta na ọ ga- votu maka Kavanaugh, a hụrụ ya ka CNN na CBS na-ekiri ka ndị na-eme ngagharị iwe na-akwa ya emo n'ụtụtụ Fraịde ka ọ na-agbalị ịnya igwe mbuli elu gaa nnọkọ kọmitii.
rows.reference: Ka ụlọ ọrụ Repọblikan na agafeghị oke wepụtara nkwupute ya na ọ ga-atụnyeere Kavanaugh, igwefoto CNN na CBS jidere ya n’ụtụtụ Fraịde ebe ndị njegharị iwe na akpọ ya asị ka ọ na anwa ịbanye igwe nrigo na aga ọnụnụ Mgbakọ Ndị Ikpe.

rows.source: He stood with eyes downcast for several minutes as he was berated, televised live on CNN.
rows.output: Ọ nọdụrụ ala na-ele anya n'ala ruo ọtụtụ nkeji ka a na-ata ya ahụhụ, a na-agbapụkwa ya n'ihu ọha na CNN.
rows.reference: O ji obi umeala kwụrụ ọtụtụ nkeji ka a na akpọ ya iyi, a na egosi ya ozugbo na CNN.

rows.source: "I'm standing right here in front of you," one woman said.
rows.output: "Ana m nọdụ ala n'ihu gị," otu nwanyị kwuru.
rows.reference: “Akwụ m ebe a n’ihu gị,” otu nwanyị kwuru.

rows.source: "Do you think he's telling the truth to the country?
rows.output: "Ị chere na ọ na-ekwu eziokwu n'ụzọ dị iche n'ụwa?
rows.reference: “Ọ dị gị ka ọ na agwa ndị obodo anyị eziokwu?

rows.source: He was told, "you have power when so many women are powerless.""
rows.output: A gwara ya, "i nwere ike mgbe ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị enweghị ike."
rows.reference: Agwara ya, “ị nwere ikike mgbe ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị enweghị ikike.””

rows.source: Flake said that his office had issued a statement and said, before the elevator closed, that he would have more to say at the committee hearing.
rows.output: Flake kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya ewerela okwu ma kwuo, tupu igwe mbuli ahụ emechaa, na ọ ga-enwekwu okwu n'oge nnọkọ kọmiti.
rows.reference: Flake kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya ewepụtala nkwupute ma kwuo, tupu igwe nrigo ahụ emechie, na ọ ga-enwekwu ihe ndị ọ ga-ekwu n’ọnụnụ mgbakọ ahụ.

rows.source: The cable and broadcast networks were all covering live hours later, when the Judiciary Committee was to vote to advance Kavanaugh's nomination to the full Senate for a vote.
rows.output: Ndị netwọkụ kọbọd na mgbasa ozi na-ekpuchi ndụ awa ndị ọzọ, mgbe kọmitii ikpe ikpe ga-eme ntuli aka ịkwaga nkwado Kavanaugh na Sineti dum maka ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Netwọk kebụl na mgbasa ozi nọ na ekpuchi ihe na eme ozugbo ka emechara, mgbe Mgbakọ Ndị Ikpe kwesịrị ituli aka iji kwagoo nhọpụta Kavanaugh n’aka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu n’uju maka ntuli aka.

rows.source: But Flake said he would only do so with the understanding that the FBI would look into the allegations against the nominee for the next week, which minority Democrats have been urging.
rows.output: Mana Flake kwuru na ya ga-eme ya naanị n'okpuru ọnọdụ na ndị FBI ga-eleba anya n'ebubo e boro onye a na-azọ ọkwa n'ime otu izu na ndị Democrats na-erubeghị eru na-arụrụ ụka.
rows.reference: Mana Flake kwuru na ọ ga-eme nke ahụ naanị na nghọta na FBI ga-elenye anya na ebubo emere onye nhọpụta ahụ n’ime izu na esote, nke ndị Demokrats dị obere nọ na akwanye.

rows.source: Flake was convinced in part by conversations with his friend, Democratic Sen. Chris Coons.
rows.output: Flake kwenyesiri ike n'otu akụkụ site n'okwu ya na enyi ya, onye omebe iwu Democratic bụ Chris Coons.
rows.reference: Agbanwere obi Flake obere na nkata ya na enyi ya, Onye Ọmeiwu Demokrat Chris Coons.

rows.source: After a conversation with Coons and several senators afterwards, Flake made his decision.
rows.output: Mgbe ya na Coons kọwachara okwu na ọtụtụ ndị omebe iwu ndị ọzọ, Flake mere mkpebi ya.
rows.reference: Ka yana nkata Coons gachara, ọtụtụ ndị ọmeiwu mechara, Flake mere mkpebi ya.

rows.source: Flake's choice had power, because it was evident Republicans would not have the votes to approve Kavanaugh without the investigation.
rows.output: Nhọrọ Flake nwere ike, n'ihi na ọ pụtara na ndị Republican agaghị enwe vootu iji kwadoo Kavanaugh na-enweghị nyocha.
rows.reference: Nhọrọ Flake nwere ikike, n’ihi ọ pụtara ihie na ndị Repọblikans enweghị vootu iji kwado Kavanaugh na emeghị nnyocha ahụ.

rows.source: President Trump has opened an FBI investigation into the allegations against Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Trump emelitere nyocha FBI banyere ebubo eboro Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Trump emepeela nnyocha FBI n’ebubo nke emere Kavanaugh.

rows.source: British PM May accuses critics of 'playing politics' over Brexit
rows.output: Onye isi ala Britain May na-akatọ ndị na-emegide ya maka "ịkpọ egwuregwu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị" banyere Brexit.
rows.reference: British PM May na ebubo ndị nkatọ ebubo nke ‘ịme ndọrọndọrọ’ n’elu Brexit

rows.source: Prime Minister Theresa May accused critics of her plans to leave the European Union of "playing politics" with Britain's future and undermining the national interest in an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Theresa May boro ndị na-ekwu okwu banyere atụmatụ ya ịla n'ụwa Europe ebubo na ha na "egwuri egwu" n'ọdịnihu Britain ma na-emebi ihe ọ pụtara n'ajụjụ ọnụ ya na akwụkwọ akụkọ Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Praịm Minista Theresa May boro ndị nkatọ ebubo iji ọdịnihu Britain “eme ndọrọndọrọ” maka atụmatụ ya iji hapụ European Union yana imebi mmasị obodo n’ajụjụ ọnụ emere n’akwụkwọ akụkọ Sunday Times.

rows.source: Britain's Prime Minister Theresa May arrives for the Conservative Party Conference in Birmingham, Britain, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Britain Theresa May rutere maka ọgbakọ Conservative Party na Birmingham, Britain, Septemba 29, 2018.
rows.reference: Praịm Minista Theresa May nke Britain rutere maka Ọgbakọ Conservative Party na Birmingham, Britain, Septemba 29, 2018.

rows.source: In another interview next to the one with her on the newspaper's front page, her former foreign minister Boris Johnson pressed his attack of her so-called Chequers plan for Brexit, saying a proposal that Britain and the EU should collect each other's tariffs was "entirely preposterous."
rows.output: N'ime ajụjụ ọnụ ọzọ dị nso na nke e nwere na mbadamba, onye bụbu onye minista mba ofesi ya bụ Boris Johnson gbara mbọ ịwụpụ atụmatụ ya nke a na-akpọ Chequers plan maka Brexit, na-ekwu na atụmatụ na Britain na EU ga-anakọta ụtụ isi nke ibe ha bụ "ihe na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ọnụ ọzọ dị n’akụkụ nke ya dị n’ihu akwụkwọ nke akwụkwọ akụkọ ahụ, onye bubu minista mba ofesi bụ Boris Johnson guzosiri ike nsogbu ya maka atụmatụ Chequers ya maka Brexit, na ekwu na atụmatụ na Britain na EU kwesịrị ịnakọta ụtụ isi ha abụọ bụ “nnukwu okwu nzuzu.”

rows.source: Wayde Sims shooting: Police arrest suspect Dyteon Simpson in LSU player's death
