rows.output: Ọ gara site na Kanye, nke pụtara naanị otu, gaa na naanị Ye - naanị ịbụ ihe ngosi nke ihe ọma anyị, ihe ọjọọ anyị, ihe mgbagwoju anya anyị, ihe niile.
rows.reference: O si na Kanye, nke pụtara nke ọ bụ naanị ya, ịbụ naanị Ye - nke bụ ngosipụta nke mma anyị, njọ anyị, mgbagwoju anya anyị, ihe niile.

rows.source: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."
rows.output: "Album ahụ bụ ihe na-egosi onye anyị bụ."
rows.reference: Egwu ahụ bụkwa ngosipụta nke onye anyị bụ.”

rows.source: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.
rows.output: Ọ bụ otu n'ime ọtụtụ ndị na-eti egwu ama ama na-agbanwe aha ha.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ otu n’ime rapa ndị ama ama gbanwere aha ha.

rows.source: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.
rows.output: Sean Combs a na-akpọkarị Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ma ọ bụ Diddy, mana n'afọ a, ọ kwuputara mmasị ya maka aha Love na Brother Love.
rows.reference: Amabụ Sean Combs ka Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ma ọ bụ Diddy, mana afọ a kwuru mmasị ya maka aha ndị Love na Brother Love.

rows.source: A former West collaborator, JAY-Z, has also made do with or without a hyphen and capitals.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye na-akwado West, JAY-Z, emewokwa ka ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ma ọ bụ na ọ nwere hyphen na isi.
rows.reference: Onye mmekọ Ọdịda Anyanwụ gara aga, JAY-Z, ejirila ma oge ụfọdụ ejighi akarauhie yana nnukwu mkpụrụedemede.

rows.source: Mexico's AMLO vows not to use military against civilians
rows.output: Onye isi ala Mexico, AMLO, ekwe nkwa na ọ gaghị eji ndị agha eme ihe megide ndị nkịtị.
rows.reference: AMLO nke Mexico anwụọla iyi na ha agaghị eji ndị agha maka ndị nkịtị

rows.source: Mexican President-elect Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has vowed to never use military force against civilians as the country approaches the 50th anniversary of a bloody reprisal against students.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Mexico na-abata Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ekweela nkwa na ọ gaghị eji ike agha eme ihe megide ndị nkịtị ka obodo ahụ na-eru afọ iri ise nke ogbugbu a na-eme n'ike megide ụmụ akwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala nke Mexico ahọpụtara ọhụrụ Manuel Lopez Obrador anwụọla iyi na ọ gaghị eji ndị agha ma ncha maka ndị nkịtị ka obodo ahụ na erute ụbọchị ncheta nke 50 maka omume ọjọọ emekwasara ụmụ akwụkwọ.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador promised Saturday at Tlatelolco Plaza to "never ever use the military to repress the Mexican people."
rows.output: Lopez Obrador kwere nkwa na Satọde na Tlatelolco Plaza na "agaghị eji ndị agha na-emegbu ndị Mexico."
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador kwere nkwa na Satọde na Nnukwu Ụlọ Ahịa Tlatelolco na “ọ gaghị eji ndị agha iji megbuo ndị amaala Mexico.”

rows.source: Troops fired on a peaceful demonstration at the plaza on Oct. 2, 1968, killing as many as 300 people at a time when leftist student movements were taking root throughout Latin America.
rows.output: Ndị agha gbara égbè n’ìgwè ndị na-eme ihe n’udo n’ámá egwurewgu na Ọktoba 2, 1968, gbuo ihe ruru mmadụ 300 n’oge ahụ mgbe ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado
rows.reference: Ndị agha gbara egbe na ngagharị juru oyi a na eme na nnukwu ụlọ ahịa ahụ na Ọktoba 2, 1968, na egbu ruo ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ 300 n’oge mmemme ụmụ akwụkwọ onye akaekpe na amalite na Latin America niile.

rows.source: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support young Mexicans by giving monthly subsidies to those who study and opening more free public universities.
rows.output: Lopez Obrador ekweela nkwa ịkwado ndị na-eto eto Mexico site n'inye ego kwa ọnwa nye ndị na-amụ ihe na imeghe ụlọ akwụkwọ ọha na eze ndị ọzọ n'efu.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador kwere nkwa ịkwado ndị ntorobịa Mexico site na ịnye ihe enyemaka kwa ọnwa maka ndị na agụ akwụkwọ ma mepekwuo mahadum ọhaneze bụ n’efu.

rows.source: He has said that unemployment and a lack of educational opportunities draws youth to criminal gangs.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu na enweghị ọrụ na enweghị ohere agụmakwụkwọ na-adọta ndị na-eto eto n'ime òtù ndị omekome.
rows.reference: O kwuola na enweghị ọrụ yana enweghị ohere agụmakwụkwọ na adọba ndị ntorobịa n’otu ndị omekome.

rows.source: U.S. should double A.I. funding
rows.output: U.S. kwesịrị ibuli ego A.I.
rows.reference: U.S. kwesịrị iwegote ego A.I. ugboro abụọ

rows.source: As China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount it spends on research in the field, says investor and AI practitioner Kai-Fu Lee, who has worked for Google, Microsoft and Apple.
rows.output: Ka China na-arụsi ọrụ ike na ọgụgụ isi, ka U.S. na-eme ka ego a na-emefu na nyocha n'ubi ahụ dị okpukpu abụọ, ka onye na-etinye ego na onye na-eme ihe na AI, Kai-Fu Lee, onye na-arụ ọrụ maka Google, Microsoft na Apple.
rows.reference: Ka China na adịkwu ire n’amamịghe echiche, ndị U.S. kwesịrị iwegotekwu ego ọ na emefu na nnyocha n’ogige ahụ, nke onye nkwado na onye na amụ AI bu Kai-Fu Lee kwuru, onye rugoro ọrụ na Google Microsoft na Apple.

rows.source: The comments come after various parts of the U.S. government have made AI announcements, even as the U.S. overall lacks a formal AI strategy.
rows.output: Nkwuputa ndị a na-abịa mgbe ụfọdụ akụkụ nke gọọmentị U.S. mere ọtụtụ ọtụtụ okwu gbasara AI, ọ bụ ezie na U.S. n'ozuzu enweghị atụmatụ AI gọọmentị.
rows.reference: Okwu ntụkwasa ahụ bịara ka ọtụtụ akụkụ nke gọọmentị U.S. mere nkwupute AI, ọbụlagodi na U.S. niile enweghị atụmatụ AI ama ama.

rows.source: Meanwhile, China introduced its plan last year: it's aiming to be No.1 in AI innovation by 2030.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, China webatara atụmatụ ya n'afọ gara aga: ọ na-achọ ịbụ No.1 na ihe ọhụrụ AI site na 2030.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, China bubatara atụmatụ ya n’afọ gara aga: ọ na achọ ịbụ onye nke 1 na mweputa ọhụrụ AI tupu 2030.

rows.source: "Double the AI research budget would be a good start, given that all other countries are so much farther behind U.S., and we're looking for the next breakthrough in AI," said Lee.
rows.output: "Ugbu a, ego a na-etinye n'ụlụ AI ga-adị mma, na-atụ anya na mba ndị ọzọ niile na-eso U.S. n'azụ, na anyị na-achọ ihe ọhụrụ na AI," ka Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: “Iwegote ego nnyocha AI ugboro abụọ ga-abụ ezigbo mbido, ejiri n’aka na ndị obodo ndị ọzọ niile agateela aka ebe U.S. nọ, ma anyị na achọ ihe ịtụnanya na esote na AI,” Lee kwuru.

rows.source: Doubling funding could double the chances that the next big AI achievement will be made in the U.S., Lee told CNBC in an interview this week.
rows.output: Ịba ụba ego nwere ike ime ka ohere dịkwuo elu na ihe ịga nke ọma AI na-esote ga-eme na U.S., Lee gwara CNBC n'ajụjụ ọnụ a n'izu a.
rows.reference: Iwegote ego ugboro abụọ nwere ike iwegote ohere na ntozu AI buru ibu na esote ga-abụ na U.S., Lee gwara CNBC n’ajụjụ ọnụ n’izu a.

rows.source: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is CEO of Sinovation Ventures, which has invested in one of the most prominent AI companies in China, Face++.
rows.output: Lee, onye akwụkwọ ya bụ "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley na New World Order" ka e bipụtara na ọnwa a site na Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, bụ onye isi oche nke Sinovation Ventures, nke itinye ego na otu n'ime ụlọ ọrụ AI kacha mara amara na China, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, onye akwụkwọ ya “AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order” nke ebipụtara n’ọnwa a site n’aka Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, bụ CEO nke Sinovation Ventures, nke tinyegoro ego n’ụlọ ọrụ AI akachasị mara na China, Face++.

rows.source: In the 1980s at Carnegie Mellon University he worked on an AI system that beat the highest-ranked American Othello player, and later he was an executive at Microsoft Research and president of Google's China branch.
rows.output: N'afọ 1980 na Mahadum Carnegie Mellon, o rụrụ ọrụ na usoro AI nke meriri onye na-egwu Othello kacha elu nke America, ma emesịa ọ bụ onye isi na Microsoft Research na onye isi ala nke ngalaba Google nke China.
rows.reference: Na 1980 na Mahadum Carnegie Mellon ọ rụrụ ọrụ na sistemụ AI nke meriri onye egwu Othello kachasị n’ọkwa na America, emechara ọ bụrụ onye isi oche na Microsoft Research yana onye isi nke ngalaba Google dị na China.

rows.source: Lee acknowledged previous U.S. government technology competitions like the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge and asked when the next one would be, in order to help identify the next visionaries.
rows.output: Lee kwetara na asọmpi teknụzụ gọọmentị U.S. gara aga dị ka Robotics Challenge nke Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency na jụọ mgbe nke ọzọ ga-abụ, iji nyere aka chọpụta ndị na-ahụ maka echiche.
rows.reference: Lee kwenyere na asọmpi teknụzụ nke gọọmentị ndị U.S. dị ka Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency’s Robotics Challenge ma jụọ mgbe nke na esote ga-abụ, iji nyere aka chọpụta ndị agba ọhụụ na esote.

rows.source: Researchers in the U.S. often have to work hard in order to win government grants, Lee said.
rows.output: Ndị nchọpụta na U.S. na-arụkarị ọrụ ike iji nweta ego gọọmentị, Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: Ndị nyocha nọ na U.S. oge ụfọdụ na arụsị ọrụ ike iji rite elele ndị gọọmentị, Lee kwuru.

rows.source: "It's not China that is taking away the academic leaders; it's the corporates," Lee said.
rows.output: "Ọ bụghị China naeweghachi ndị isi ụlọ akwụkwọ; ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ." Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọbụghị China na eweghara ndị isi agụmakwụkwọ; ọ bụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ,” Lee kwuru.

rows.source: Facebook, Google and other technology companies have hired luminaries from universities to work on AI in recent years.
rows.output: Facebook, Google na ndị ọzọ na-emepụta ihe na-ahụ maka teknụzụ enwetala ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị si n'ụlọ akwụkwọ ka ha rụọ ọrụ na AI n'afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google na ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ ndị ọzọ na ewere ndị ọkachamara na mahadum iji rụọ ọrụ na AI n’afọ nso nso a.

rows.source: Lee said immigration policy changes could also help the U.S. bolster its AI efforts.
rows.output: Lee kwuru na mgbanwe amụma mbata na ọpụpụ nwere ike inye aka n'ibelata mbọ ndị U.S. na-eme n'ịzụlite AI.
rows.reference: Lee kwuru na mgbanwe iwu mbata na ọpụpụ nwekwara ike ịnyere U.S. aka ịkwado mbọ AI ya.

rows.source: "I think green cards should automatically be offered to PhD's in AI," he said.
rows.output: "Ekwenyesiri m na kaadị ndị na-acha akwụkwọ ndụ akwukwọ ndụ kwesịrị inye ndị PhD na AI," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Echere m na ekwesịrị ịnye ndị nwere PhD na AI kaadị akwụkwọ ndụ na akpaghị aka,” ka o kwuru.

rows.source: China's State Council issued its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan in July 2017.
rows.output: Ndị kansụl steeti China wepụtara atụmatụ mmepe nke Artificial Intelligence nke ọzọ na Julaị 2017.
rows.reference: Nzụkọ Steeti nke China nyere Atụmatụ Ntolite Amamịghe Echiche Agbụrụ Na Esote na Julaị 2017.

rows.source: China's National Natural Science Foundation provides funding to people at academic institutions similar to the way that the National Science Foundation and other government organizations dole out money to U.S. researchers, but the quality of academic work is lower in China, Lee said.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ sayensị nke China na-enye ego maka ndị mmadụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ dị ka National Science Foundation na ndị otu gọọmentị ndị ọzọ na-enye ego maka ndị nchọpụta US, mana àgwà ọrụ agụmakwụkwọ dị ala na China, Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: National Natural Science Foundation nke China na enye ndị mmadụ nọ n’ewumewu agụmakwụkwọ ego otu ụzọ nke National Science Foundation na ọgbakọ gọọmentị ndị ọzọ si enye ndị nyocha U.S. ego, mana ogo nke ọrụ agụmakwụkwọ dị ala na China, Lee kwuru.

rows.source: Earlier this year the U.S. Defense Department established a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which is meant to involve partners from industry and academia, and the White House announced the formation of Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
rows.output: N'oge gara aga n'afọ a, ndị agha nchekwa U.S. hiwere ebe a na-eme ihe n'ụzọ nkịtị, nke e bu n'obi itinye ndị mmekọ site na ụlọ ọrụ na mahadum, na White House kwuputara nhọpụta kọmiti na-ahụ maka ihe ọmụma.
rows.reference: Na mbido afọ a ndị U.S. Ngalaba Nchedo mepụtara Njikọ Ọdụ Amamịghe Echiche, nke kwesịrị ijikọta ndị mmekọ si na ụlọ ọrụ yana agụmakwụkwọ, ndị White House kwuputere nhazi nke Ọgbakọ Ahọpụtara na Amamịghe Echiche.

rows.source: And this month DARPA announced a $2 billion investment in an initiative called AI Next.
rows.output: Na ọnwa a, DARPA kwuputara itinye ego $2 ijeri na atụmatụ a na-akpọ AI Next.
rows.reference: N’ọnwa a DARPA kwuputere ntinye ego ijeri $2 n’ihe ọhụrụ akpọrọ AI Next.

rows.source: As for the NSF, it currently invests more than $100 million per year in AI research.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara NSF, ọ na-etinye ihe karịrị nde $100 kwa afọ na nyocha AI.
rows.reference: Maka NSF, ugbu a ọ na etinye karịa nde $100 kwa afọ na nyocha AI.

rows.source: Meanwhile, U.S. legislation that sought to create a National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence has not seen action in months.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, iwu U.S. nke bu n'obi imepụta National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence enweghị ihe omume n'ime ọnwa ole na ole.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, iwu U.S. chọrọ ịmepụta Ọgbakọ Nchedo Mba maka Amamịghe Echiche arụbeghị ọrụ ọ bụla n’ọtụtụ ọnwa.

rows.source: Macedonians vote in referendum on whether to change country's name
rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-eme ntuli aka na ntuli aka na ma ha ga-agbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia na atuli aka na nhọpụta ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ya

rows.source: The people of Macedonia voted in a referendum on Sunday on whether to change its name to "Republic of North Macedonia," a move that would resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece which had blocked its membership bids for the European Union and NATO.
rows.output: Ndị Macedonia mere ntụli aka na Sọnde na ha ga-agbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia," nke ga-edozigharị esemokwu dị ogologo oge na Gris nke gọnahụrụ ndị a na-achọ maka otu European Union na NATO.
rows.reference: Ndị nke Macedonia tulili aka na nhọpụta na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha ya ka ọ bụrụ “Repọblik nke North Macedonia,” ihe ga-ekpezi esemokwu nọgoro ọtụtụ afọ n’etiti Greece ndị gbochigoro arịrịọ nsonye ya maka European Union na NATO.

rows.source: Greece, which has a province called Macedonia, maintains that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has vetoed its entrance into NATO and the EU.
rows.output: Greece, nke nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia, na-ekwu na aha ógbè ya na-anọchi anya ihe na-achọ ala ya, ma na-egbochi ya ịbata NATO na EU.
rows.reference: Greece, nke nwere ogige akpọrọ Macedonia, na ekwusi ike na aha agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, o gbochiela mbanye ya na NATO yana EU.

rows.source: The two governments struck a deal in June based on the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents argue the change would undermine the ethnic identity of Macedonia's Slavic majority population.
rows.output: Ndị ọchịchị abụọ ahụere nkwekọrịta n'ọnwa June dabere na aha ọhụrụ a tụrụ aro, mana ndị na-emegide ya na-emegide na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emebi njirimara agbụrụ nke ndị Slavs bụ́ isi na Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ rutere nkwekọrịta na Juun dabere na aha ọhụrụ atụnyere, mana ndị iro bụ obodo n’isi na arụrịta ụka na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emebi njirimara agbụrụ nke ọnụọgụgụ ndị Slavic kachasị nke Macedonia.

rows.source: President Gjorge Ivanov has said he will not be voting in the referendum and a boycott campaign has cast doubts on whether turnout will meet the minimum 50 percent required for the referendum to be valid.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwupụtala na ọ gaghị eme ntuli aka na ntuli aka ahụ, na mgbasa ozi na-eme ka a na-enwe obi abịaghị nke ọma ma ọ bụrụ na ntụli aka ga-ezute ihe kacha nta 50 pasentị achọrọ ka ntuli aka ahụ wee bụrụ nke ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwuola na ọ gaghị atuli aka na nhọpụta ahụ, ọzọkwa mgbasa ozi mgbochi etinyela obi mgbagha ma ndị ga-apụta a ga-erukwa pasentị 50 achọrọ pekarịsịrị maka nhọpụta ahụ ịdị ire.

rows.source: The question on the referendum ballot read: "Are you for NATO and EU membership with acceptance of the agreement with Greece."
rows.output: Ajụjụ n'akwụkwọ ntụli aka nke ntuli aka bụ: "Ị na-akwado NATO na EU na nnabata nkwekọrịta na Gris."
rows.reference: Ajụjụ dị n’akwụkwọ nhọpụta ahụ gụrụ: “Ị kwụnyere nsonye NATO na EU site na ịnabata nkwekọrịta dị n’etiti Greece.”

rows.source: Supporters of the name change, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that it is a price worth paying to pursue admission into bodies such as the EU and NATO for Macedonia, one of the countries to emerge from the collapse of Yugoslavia.
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado mgbanwe aha, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-ekwu na ọ bụ ụgwọ dị mma ịkwaga n'ịgbaso nnabata n'ime ahụ́ dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n'ime mba ndị pụtara site na ịda nke Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Ndị na akwado mgbanwe aha ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrịta ụka na ọ bụ ụgwọ ekwesịrị ịkwụ iji sochie nnabata n’ewumewu ndị dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n’ime obodo ndị pụtara n’ọdịda nke Yugoslavia.

rows.source: "I came today to vote for the future of the country, for young people in Macedonia so they can be live freely under the umbrella of the European Union because it means safer lives for all of us," said Olivera Georgijevska, 79, in Skopje.
rows.output: "Abịara m taa ịtụ vootu maka ọdịnihu obodo, maka ndị na-eto eto na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibikọ n'efu n'okpuru umbrella nke European Union n'ihi na ọ pụtara ndụ ndị dị nche maka anyị niile," ka Olivera Georgijevska, 79, kwuru na Skopje.
rows.reference: “Abịara m taa ituli aka maka ọdịnihu nke obodo anyị, maka ndị ntorobịa nọ na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi ndụ otu ha chọrọ n’okpuru nche nke European Union n’ihi ọ pụtara ndụ ka mma maka anyị niile,” nke Olivera Georgijevska kwuru, 79, na Skopje.

rows.source: Although not legally binding, enough members of parliament have said they will abide by the vote's outcome to make it decisive.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụghị iwu iwu, ndị omeiwu zuru oke ekwupụtala na ha ga-azọpụta nsonaazụ nke votu ahụ, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọdịghị n’okpuru iwu, ndị otu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu zuru oke ekwuola na ha ga-asọpụrụ ndapụta nke ntuli aka ahụ iji mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị mkpa.

rows.source: The name change would requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.
rows.output: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ọtụtụ ndị omebe iwu abụọ n'ụlọomeiwu.
rows.reference: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ụzọ abụọ n’ọkara ụzọ atọ nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu dị ukwuu.

rows.source: The state election commission said there had been no reports of irregularities by 1 p.m.
rows.output: Kansul steeti ahụ kwuru na ọ nweghị akụkọ banyere ihe na-adịghị mma n'oge elekere 1 nke ehihie.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ntuli aka steeti kwuru na enwebeghị mkpesa nke mpụ n’ebe 1 ehihie.

rows.source: However, turnout stood at only 16 percent, compared to 34 percent in last parliamentary election in 2016 when 66 percent of the registered voters cast their ballot.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị, ntụli aka bụ naanị pasent 16, ma e jiri ya tụnyere pasent 34 na ntuli aka nke ndị omebe iwu n'afọ 2016 mgbe pasent 66 nke ndị debanyere aha ha mere ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mpụta dị naanị na pasentị 16, tụlee pasentị 34 na ntuli aka nzụkọ ọmeiwu gara aga na 2016 mgbe pasentị 66 nke ndị ntuli aka edebanyere n’akwụkwọ tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha.

rows.source: "I came out to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe," said Gjose Tanevski, 62, a voter in the capital, Skopje.
rows.output: "Agara m na-eme ntuli aka n'ihi ụmụaka m, ebe anyị nọ na Europe," Gjose Tanevski, 62, onye na-eme ntuli aka na isi obodo, Skopje, kwuru.
rows.reference: “Apụtara m ituli aka n’ihi ụmụaka m, ọnọdụ anyị bụ na Europe,” ka Gjose Tanevski kwuru, 62, onye ntuli aka n’isi ala, Skopje.
